55!> Options and diagnostic switches used by the horizontal viscosity kernels.
56type :: hv_opts_CS
57 logical :: Laplacian !< Use a Laplacian horizontal viscosity if true.
58 logical :: biharmonic !< Use a biharmonic horizontal viscosity if true.
59 logical :: debug !< If true, write verbose checksums for debugging purposes.
60 logical :: no_slip !< If true, no slip boundary conditions are used.
61 !! Otherwise free slip boundary conditions are assumed.
62 !! The implementation of the free slip boundary
63 !! conditions on a C-grid is much cleaner than the
64 !! no slip boundary conditions. The use of free slip
65 !! b.c.s is strongly encouraged. The no slip b.c.s
66 !! are not implemented with the biharmonic viscosity.
67 logical :: bound_Kh !< If true, the Laplacian coefficient is locally
68 !! limited to guarantee stability.
69 logical :: EY24_EBT_BS !! If true, use an equivalent barotropic backscatter
70 !! with a stabilizing kill switch in MEKE,
71 !< developed by Yankovsky et al. 2024
72 logical :: bound_Ah !< If true, the biharmonic coefficient is locally
73 !! limited to guarantee stability.
74 real :: Re_Ah !! If nonzero, the biharmonic coefficient is scaled
75 !< so that the biharmonic Reynolds number is equal to this [nondim].
76 real :: KS_coef !< A nondimensional coefficient on the biharmonic viscosity that sets the
77 !! kill switch for backscatter. Default is 1.0 [nondim].
78 logical :: backscatter_underbound !< If true, the bounds on the biharmonic viscosity are allowed
79 !! to increase where the Laplacian viscosity is negative (due to
80 !! backscatter parameterizations) beyond the largest timestep-dependent
81 !! stable values of biharmonic viscosity when no Laplacian viscosity is
82 !! applied. The default is true for historical reasons, but this option
83 !! probably should not be used as it can lead to numerical instabilities.
84 logical :: Smagorinsky_Kh !< If true, use Smagorinsky nonlinear eddy
85 !! viscosity. KH is the background value.
86 logical :: Smagorinsky_Ah !< If true, use a biharmonic form of Smagorinsky
87 !! nonlinear eddy viscosity. AH is the background.
88 logical :: Leith_Kh !< If true, use 2D Leith nonlinear eddy
89 !! viscosity. KH is the background value.
90 logical :: Modified_Leith !< If true, use extra component of Leith viscosity
91 !! to damp divergent flow. To use, still set Leith_Kh=.TRUE.
92 logical :: use_beta_in_Leith !< If true, includes the beta term in the Leith viscosity
93 logical :: Leith_Ah !< If true, use a biharmonic form of 2D Leith
94 !! nonlinear eddy viscosity. AH is the background.
95 logical :: use_Leithy !< If true, use a biharmonic form of 2D Leith
96 !! nonlinear eddy viscosity with harmonic backscatter.
97 !! Ah is the background. Leithy = Leith+E
98 real :: c_K !< Fraction of energy dissipated by the biharmonic term
99 !! that gets backscattered in the Leith+E scheme. [nondim]
100 logical :: smooth_Ah !< If true (default), then Ah and m_leithy are smoothed.
101 !! This smoothing requires a lot of blocking communication.
102 logical :: use_QG_Leith_visc !< If true, use QG Leith nonlinear eddy viscosity.
103 !! KH is the background value.
104 logical :: bound_Coriolis !< If true & SMAGORINSKY_AH is used, the biharmonic
105 !! viscosity is modified to include a term that
106 !! scales quadratically with the velocity shears.
107 real :: Kh_bg_min !< The minimum value allowed for Laplacian horizontal
108 !! viscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]. The default is 0.0.
109 logical :: FrictWork_bug !< If true, retain an answer-changing bug in calculating FrictWork,
110 !! which cancels the h in thickness flux and the h at velocity point.
111 logical :: OBC_strain_bug !< If true, recover a bug that specified shear strain option at open
112 !! boundaries cannot be applied.
113 logical :: use_land_mask !< Use the land mask for the computation of thicknesses
114 !! at velocity locations. This eliminates the dependence on
115 !! arbitrary values over land or outside of the domain.
116 !! Default is False to maintain answers with legacy experiments
117 !! but should be changed to True for new experiments.
118 logical :: anisotropic !< If true, allow anisotropic component to the viscosity.
119 logical :: add_LES_viscosity!< If true, adds the viscosity from Smagorinsky and Leith to
120 !! the background viscosity instead of taking the maximum.
121 real :: Kh_aniso !< The anisotropic viscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1].
122 logical :: res_scale_MEKE !< If true, the viscosity contribution from MEKE is scaled by
123 !! the resolution function.
124 logical :: use_GME !< If true, use GME backscatter scheme.
125 integer :: answer_date !< The vintage of the order of arithmetic and expressions in the
126 !! horizontal viscosity calculations. Values below 20190101 recover
127 !! the answers from the end of 2018, while higher values use updated
128 !! and more robust forms of the same expressions.
129 real :: GME_h0 !< The strength of GME tapers quadratically to zero when the bathymetric
130 !! total water column thickness is less than GME_H0 [H ~> m or kg m-2]
131 real :: GME_efficiency !< The nondimensional prefactor multiplying the GME coefficient [nondim]
132 real :: GME_limiter !< The absolute maximum value the GME coefficient is allowed to take [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1].
133 real :: min_grid_Kh !< Minimum horizontal Laplacian viscosity used to
134 !! limit the grid Reynolds number [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
135 real :: min_grid_Ah !< Minimun horizontal biharmonic viscosity used to
136 !! limit grid Reynolds number [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
137 logical :: use_cont_thick !< If true, thickness at velocity points adopts h[uv] in BT_cont from continuity solver.
138 logical :: use_ZB2020 !< If true, use Zanna-Bolton 2020 parameterization.
139 logical :: use_circulation !< If true, use circulation theorem to compute vorticity (for ZB20 or Leith)
140 logical :: do_grid_Re_Ah = .false. !< If true, the grid_Re_Ah diagnostic is requested.
141 logical :: do_grid_Re_Kh = .false. !< If true, the grid_Re_Kh diagnostic is requested.
142 logical :: do_Ah_h = .false. !< If true, the Ah_h diagnostic is requested.
143 logical :: do_Ah_q = .false. !< If true, the Ah_q diagnostic is requested.
144 logical :: do_Kh_h = .false. !< If true, the Kh_h diagnostic is requested.
145 logical :: do_Kh_q = .false. !< If true, the Kh_q diagnostic is requested.
146 logical :: do_GME_coeff_h = .false. !< If true, the GME_coeff_h diagnostic is requested.
147 logical :: do_GME_coeff_q = .false. !< If true, the GME_coeff_q diagnostic is requested.
148 logical :: do_vort_xy_q = .false. !< If true, the vort_xy_q diagnostic is requested.
149 logical :: do_div_xx_h = .false. !< If true, the div_xx_h diagnostic is requested.
150 logical :: do_sh_xy_q = .false. !< If true, the sh_xy_q diagnostic is requested.
151 logical :: do_sh_xx_h = .false. !< If true, the sh_xx_h diagnostic is requested.
152 logical :: do_FrictWork = .false. !< If true, the FrictWork diagnostic is requested.
153 logical :: do_FrictWorkIntz = .false. !< If true, the FrictWorkIntz diagnostic is requested.
154 logical :: do_FrictWork_bh = .false. !< If true, the FrictWork_bh diagnostic is requested.
155 logical :: do_FrictWorkIntz_bh = .false. !< If true, the FrictWorkIntz_bh diagnostic is requested.
156 logical :: do_normstress = .false. !< If true, the normstress diagnostic is requested.
157 logical :: do_shearstress = .false. !< If true, the shearstress diagnostic is requested.
158 logical :: do_BS_coeff_h = .false. !< If true, the BS_coeff_h diagnostic is requested.
159 logical :: do_BS_coeff_q = .false. !< If true, the BS_coeff_q diagnostic is requested.
160end type hv_opts_CS

266!> Persistent copies of the horizontal viscosity metric and coefficient arrays, set once
267!! when the horizontal viscosity is initialized.
268type :: hv_metrics_CS
269 type(RealArray_t) :: Kh_bg_xx !< The background Laplacian viscosity at h points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1].
270 !! The actual viscosity may be the larger of this
271 !! viscosity and the Smagorinsky and Leith viscosities.
272 type(RealArray_t) :: Ah_bg_xx !< The background biharmonic viscosity at h points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
273 !! The actual viscosity may be the larger of this
274 !! viscosity and the Smagorinsky and Leith viscosities.
275 type(RealArray_t) :: reduction_xx !< The amount by which stresses through h points are reduced
276 !! due to partial barriers [nondim].
277 type(RealArray_t) :: Kh_Max_xx !< The maximum permitted Laplacian viscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1].
278 type(RealArray_t) :: Ah_Max_xx !< The maximum permitted biharmonic viscosity [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
279 type(RealArray_t) :: Ah_Max_xx_KS !< The maximum permitted biharmonic viscosity for
280 !! the kill switch [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
281 type(RealArray_t) :: n1n2_h !< Factor n1*n2 in the anisotropic direction tensor at h-points [nondim]
282 type(RealArray_t) :: n1n1_m_n2n2_h !< Factor n1**2-n2**2 in the anisotropic direction tensor at h-points [nondim]
283 type(RealArray_t) :: grid_sp_h2 !< Harmonic mean of the squares of the grid [L2 ~> m2]
284 type(RealArray_t) :: grid_sp_h3 !< Harmonic mean of the squares of the grid^(3/2) [L3 ~> m3]
285 type(RealArray_t) :: Kh_bg_xy !< The background Laplacian viscosity at q points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1].
286 !! The actual viscosity may be the larger of this
287 !! viscosity and the Smagorinsky and Leith viscosities.
288 type(RealArray_t) :: Ah_bg_xy !< The background biharmonic viscosity at q points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
289 !! The actual viscosity may be the larger of this
290 !! viscosity and the Smagorinsky and Leith viscosities.
291 type(RealArray_t) :: reduction_xy !< The amount by which stresses through q points are reduced
292 !! due to partial barriers [nondim].
293 type(RealArray_t) :: Kh_Max_xy !< The maximum permitted Laplacian viscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1].
294 type(RealArray_t) :: Ah_Max_xy !< The maximum permitted biharmonic viscosity [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
295 type(RealArray_t) :: Ah_Max_xy_KS !< The maximum permitted biharmonic viscosity for
296 !! the kill switch [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
297 type(RealArray_t) :: n1n2_q !< Factor n1*n2 in the anisotropic direction tensor at q-points [nondim]
298 type(RealArray_t) :: n1n1_m_n2n2_q !< Factor n1**2-n2**2 in the anisotropic direction tensor at q-points [nondim]
299 type(RealArray_t) :: dx2h !< Pre-calculated dx^2 at h points [L2 ~> m2]
300 type(RealArray_t) :: dy2h !< Pre-calculated dy^2 at h points [L2 ~> m2]
301 type(RealArray_t) :: dx_dyT !< Pre-calculated dx/dy at h points [nondim]
302 type(RealArray_t) :: dy_dxT !< Pre-calculated dy/dx at h points [nondim]
303 type(RealArray_t) :: m_const_leithy !< Pre-calculated .5*sqrt(c_K)*max{dx,dy} [L ~> m]
304 type(RealArray_t) :: m_leithy_max !< Pre-calculated 4./max(dx,dy)^2 at h points [L-2 ~> m-2]
305 type(RealArray_t) :: dx2q !< Pre-calculated dx^2 at q points [L2 ~> m2]
306 type(RealArray_t) :: dy2q !< Pre-calculated dy^2 at q points [L2 ~> m2]
307 type(RealArray_t) :: dx_dyBu !< Pre-calculated dx/dy at q points [nondim]
308 type(RealArray_t) :: dy_dxBu !< Pre-calculated dy/dx at q points [nondim]
309 type(RealArray_t) :: Idx2dyCu !< 1/(dx^2 dy) at u points [L-3 ~> m-3]
310 type(RealArray_t) :: Idxdy2u !< 1/(dx dy^2) at u points [L-3 ~> m-3]
311 type(RealArray_t) :: Idx2dyCv !< 1/(dx^2 dy) at v points [L-3 ~> m-3]
312 type(RealArray_t) :: Idxdy2v !< 1/(dx dy^2) at v points [L-3 ~> m-3]
313 type(RealArray_t) :: Laplac2_const_xx !< Laplacian metric-dependent constants [L2 ~> m2]
314 type(RealArray_t) :: Biharm6_const_xx !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [L6 ~> m6]
315 type(RealArray_t) :: Laplac3_const_xx !< Laplacian metric-dependent constants [L3 ~> m3]
316 type(RealArray_t) :: Biharm_const_xx !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [L4 ~> m4]
317 type(RealArray_t) :: Biharm_const2_xx !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [T L4 ~> s m4]
318 type(RealArray_t) :: Re_Ah_const_xx !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [L3 ~> m3]
319 type(RealArray_t) :: Laplac2_const_xy !< Laplacian metric-dependent constants [L2 ~> m2]
320 type(RealArray_t) :: Biharm6_const_xy !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [L6 ~> m6]
321 type(RealArray_t) :: Laplac3_const_xy !< Laplacian metric-dependent constants [L3 ~> m3]
322 type(RealArray_t) :: Biharm_const_xy !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [L4 ~> m4]
323 type(RealArray_t) :: Biharm_const2_xy !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [T L4 ~> s m4]
324 type(RealArray_t) :: Re_Ah_const_xy !< Biharmonic metric-dependent constants [L3 ~> m3]

533!> A container-based shadow of the MEKE_type fields used within the horizontal_viscosity call
534!! tree, so that they can be bridge-ready without converting the shared MEKE_type itself.
535type :: hor_visc_MEKE_type
536 type(RealArray_t) :: Ku_a !< The MEKE-derived lateral viscosity coefficient
537 !! [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]. This viscosity can be negative when representing
538 !! backscatter from unresolved eddies (see Jansen and Held, 2014).
539 type(RealArray_t) :: Au_a !< The MEKE-derived lateral biharmonic viscosity
540 !! coefficient [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1].
541 type(RealArray_t) :: mom_src_a !< MEKE source from lateral friction in the
542 !! momentum equations [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2].
543 type(RealArray_t) :: mom_src_bh_a !< MEKE source from the biharmonic part of the lateral friction in the
544 !! momentum equations [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2].
545 type(RealArray_t) :: GME_snk_a !< MEKE sink from GME backscatter in the momentum equations
546 !! [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2].
547 real :: backscatter_Ro_pow = 0.0 !< Power in Rossby number function for backscatter [nondim].
548 real :: backscatter_Ro_c = 0.0 !< Coefficient in Rossby number function for backscatter [nondim].
549contains
550 procedure :: build_from => hor_visc_MEKE_build_from !< Copy in the allocated fields
551 procedure :: copy_back => hor_visc_MEKE_copy_back !< Copy out the source and sink fields and free
552end type hor_visc_MEKE_type

554!> A container-based shadow of the VarMix_CS fields used within the horizontal_viscosity call
555!! tree, so that they can be bridge-ready without converting the shared VarMix_CS itself.
556type :: hor_visc_VarMix_type

558 !! deformation radius to the grid spacing at h points [nondim].
559 type(RealArray_t) :: Res_fn_q_a !< Non-dimensional function of the ratio the first baroclinic
560 !! deformation radius to the grid spacing at q points [nondim].
561 type(RealArray_t) :: BS_struct_a !< Vertical structure function used in backscatter [nondim]
562 logical :: use_variable_mixing = .false. !< If true, use the variable mixing.
563 logical :: Resoln_scaled_Kh = .false. !< If true, scale away the Laplacian viscosity
564 !! when the deformation radius is well resolved.
565contains
566 procedure :: build_from => hor_visc_VarMix_build_from !< Copy in the allocated fields
567 procedure :: free => hor_visc_VarMix_free !< Free every allocated field
568end type hor_visc_VarMix_type

626 !> Bridge for the smooth_x9_h subroutine
627 subroutine turbotmp_smooth_x9_h_bridge(Gcore, bxH0, field_h, zero_land) bind(C)
628 use iso_c_binding, only : c_bool
629 use array_mod, only : RealArray_C
630 use box_mod, only : Box_C
631 use MOM_grid_containers, only : grid_core_C
632 implicit none
633 type(grid_core_C), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
634 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column, [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
635 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: field_h !< h-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
636 logical(c_bool), intent(in), value :: zero_land !< If present and false, return the average of the surrounding
637 !! ocean points when smoothing, otherwise use a value of 0 for
638 !! land points and include them in the averages.
639 end subroutine turbotmp_smooth_x9_h_bridge

930 subroutine turbotmp_hor_visc_strain_bridge(Gcore, CS, metrics, OBC, bxH, bxQ, bxU, bxV, bxKh, bxHstr, bxQstr, &
931 bxHgrad, bxQshear, bxQvsmooth, nkblock, kstart, use_vort_xy, apply_OBC, &
932 apply_OBC_strain, use_cont_huv, u, v, h, hu_cont, hv_cont, u_smooth, &
933 v_smooth, NoSt, ShSt, Del2u, h_u, Del2v, h_v, sh_xx, sh_xx_smooth, &
934 dudx, dvdy, dvdx, dudy, dvdx_smooth, dudy_smooth, sh_xy, sh_xy_smooth, &

943 type(hv_opts_CS_C), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
944 type(hv_metrics_CS_C), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal viscosity metric and
945 !! coefficient arrays
946 type(c_ptr), intent(in), value :: OBC !< Pointer to an open boundary condition type
947 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
948 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
949 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxQ !< The B-grid-index iteration box of this tile,
950 !! [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
951 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxU !< The u-point iteration box of this tile,
952 !! [IscB:IecB, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
953 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxV !< The v-point iteration box of this tile,
954 !! [isc:iec, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
955 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this tile,
956 !! [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
957 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
958 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
959 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
960 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
961 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxHgrad !< The h points of this tile where the velocity gradients
962 !! are computed, [IscB-1:IecB+2, JscB-1:JecB+2, 1:kmax]
963 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxQshear !< The q points of this tile where the shearing strain is
964 !! computed, [isc-2:iec+1, jsc-2:jec+1, 1:kmax]
965 type(Box_C), intent(in) :: bxQvsmooth !< The q points of this tile where the smoothed vorticity
966 !! terms are computed,
967 !! [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh, js_Kh-1:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
968 integer(c_int), intent(in), value :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
969 integer(c_int), intent(in), value :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
970 logical(c_bool), intent(in), value :: use_vort_xy !< True if vort_xy must be computed
971 logical(c_bool), intent(in), value :: apply_OBC !< If true, open boundary conditions are applied on this PE
972 logical(c_bool), intent(in), value :: apply_OBC_strain !< If true, the specified open boundary strain
973 !! configuration is applied
974 logical(c_bool), intent(in), value :: use_cont_huv !< If true, use the continuity solver thicknesses at
975 !! velocity points

977 type(RealArray_C), intent(in) :: v !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
978 type(RealArray_C), intent(in) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
979 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: hu_cont !< Layer thickness at u-points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
980 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: hv_cont !< Layer thickness at v-points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
981 type(RealArray_C), intent(in) :: u_smooth !< Zonal velocity, smoothed with a spatial low-pass filter
982 !! [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
983 type(RealArray_C), intent(in) :: v_smooth !< Meridional velocity, smoothed with a spatial low-pass
984 !! filter [L T-1 ~> m s-1]

1291 GME_effic_q, KH_u_GME, KH_v_GME, GME_coeff_h, GME_coeff_q, &

1293 visc_limit_q, visc_limit_q_flag, visc_limit_q_frac, BS_coeff_q, &
1294 sh_xx, str_xx, dDel2vdx, dDel2udy, sh_xy, sh_xy_smooth, str_xy, &
1295 bhstr_xy, vort_xy, grad_vort_mag_q, grad_vort_mag_q_2d, Del2vort_q, &

1297 visc_bound_rem) bind(C)

1299 use array_mod, only : RealArray_C
1300 use box_mod, only : Box_C

1307 type(grid_core_C), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
1308 type(hv_opts_CS_C), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
1309 type(hv_metrics_CS_C), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal viscosity
1310 !! metric and coefficient arrays

1315 !! [IscB-1:IecB+2, JscB-1:JecB+2, 1:kmax]

1337 type(RealArray_C), intent(in) :: sh_xy_bt !< barotropic horizontal shearing strain (du/dy +

1371 !! [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]

1378 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: dDel2vdx !< Components in the biharmonic equivalent of the
1379 !! shearing strain [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
1380 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: dDel2udy !< Components in the biharmonic equivalent of the
1381 !! shearing strain [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]

1383 !! including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]

1385 !! including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
1386 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: str_xy !< str_xy is the cross term in the stress tensor
1387 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2], but at some points
1388 !! in the code it is not yet layer integrated, so is
1389 !! in [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].
1390 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: bhstr_xy !< A copy of str_xy that only contains the biharmonic

1394 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q !< Magnitude of vorticity gradient at q-points
1395 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
1396 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q_2d !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient at q-points
1397 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
1398 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: Del2vort_q !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points
1399 !! [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
1400 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_q !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at q-points
1401 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
1402 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: hq !< harmonic mean of the harmonic means of the u- & v

1404 !! guarantees that hq/hu < 4.
1405 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: Ah !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
1406 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: Kh !< Laplacian viscosity (h or q) [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
1407 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: Shear_mag !< magnitude of the shear (h or q) [T-1 ~> s-1]
1408 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: vert_vort_mag !< magnitude of the vertical vorticity gradient (h or
1409 !! q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
1410 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: hrat_min !< h_min divided by the thickness at the stress point
1411 !! (h or q) [nondim]
1412 type(RealArray_C), intent(inout) :: visc_bound_rem !< fraction of overall viscous bounds that remain to
1413 !! be applied (h or q) [nondim]
1414 end subroutine turbotmp_hor_visc_q_coeffs_bridge

1537contains
1538
1539!> Calculates the acceleration due to the horizontal viscosity.
1540!!
1541!! A combination of biharmonic and Laplacian forms can be used. The coefficient
1542!! may either be a constant or a shear-dependent form. The biharmonic is
1543!! determined by twice taking the divergence of an appropriately defined stress
1544!! tensor. The Laplacian is determined by doing so once.
1545!!
1546!! To work, the following fields must be set outside of the usual
1547!! is:ie range before this subroutine is called:
1548!! u(is-2:ie+2,js-2:je+2)
1549!! v(is-2:ie+2,js-2:je+2)
1550!! h(is-1:ie+1,js-1:je+1) or up to h(is-2:ie+2,js-2:je+2) with some Leith options.
155150subroutine horizontal_viscosity(u, v, h, uh, vh, diffu, diffv, MEKE, VarMix, G, GV, US, &
155250 CS, nkblock, tv, dt, OBC, BT, TD, ADp, hu_cont, hv_cont, STOCH)
1553 type(ocean_grid_type), target, intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
1554 type(verticalGrid_type), target, intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
1555 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1556 intent(in) :: u !< The zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
1557 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1558 intent(in) :: v !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
1559 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1560 intent(inout) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
1561 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1562 intent(in) :: uh !< The zonal volume transport [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1].
1563 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1564 intent(in) :: vh !< The meridional volume transport [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1].
1565 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1566 intent(out) :: diffu !< Zonal acceleration due to convergence of
1567 !! along-coordinate stress tensor [L T-2 ~> m s-2]
1568 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1569 intent(out) :: diffv !< Meridional acceleration due to convergence
1570 !! of along-coordinate stress tensor [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
1571 type(MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: MEKE !< MEKE fields
1572 !! related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
1573 type(VarMix_CS), target, intent(inout) :: VarMix !< Variable mixing control structure
1574 type(unit_scale_type), target, intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
1575 type(hor_visc_CS), target, intent(inout) :: CS !< Horizontal viscosity control structure
1576 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
1577 type(thermo_var_ptrs), intent(in) :: tv !< A structure pointing to various
1578 !! thermodynamic variables
1579 real, intent(in) :: dt !< Time increment [T ~> s]
1580 type(ocean_OBC_type), optional, pointer :: OBC !< Pointer to an open boundary condition type
1581 type(barotropic_CS), optional, intent(in) :: BT !< Barotropic control structure
1582 type(thickness_diffuse_CS), optional, intent(in) :: TD !< Thickness diffusion control structure
1583 type(accel_diag_ptrs), optional, intent(in) :: ADp !< Acceleration diagnostics
1584 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1585 optional, intent(inout) :: hu_cont !< Layer thickness at u-points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
1586 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
1587 optional, intent(inout) :: hv_cont !< Layer thickness at v-points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
1588 type(stochastic_CS), intent(inout), optional :: STOCH !< Stochastic control structure
1589
1590 ! Local variables

2942!> Calculates the horizontal tension and shearing strain, the thicknesses at velocity points,
2943!! the Laplacian of velocity, and the vorticity for one tile of horizontal_viscosity.
29441875subroutine hor_visc_strain_fortran(Gcore, CS, metrics, OBC, bxH, bxQ, bxU, bxV, bxKh, bxHstr, bxQstr, bxHgrad, &
2945 bxQshear, bxQvsmooth, nkblock, kstart, use_vort_xy, apply_OBC, apply_OBC_strain, &
2946 use_cont_huv, u_a, v_a, h_a, hu_cont_a, hv_cont_a, u_smooth_a, v_smooth_a, NoSt_a, &
2947 ShSt_a, Del2u_a, h_u_a, Del2v_a, h_v_a, sh_xx_a, sh_xx_smooth_a, dudx_a, dvdy_a, &
2948 dvdx_a, dudy_a, dvdx_smooth_a, dudy_smooth_a, sh_xy_a, sh_xy_smooth_a, vort_xy_a, &
2949 vort_xy_smooth_a)
2950 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
2951 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
2952 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
2953 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
2954 type(ocean_OBC_type), optional, pointer :: OBC !< Pointer to an open boundary condition type
2955 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
2956 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
2957 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ !< The B-grid-index iteration box of this
2958 !! tile, [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
2959 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxU !< The u-point iteration box of this tile,
2960 !! [IscB:IecB, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
2961 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxV !< The v-point iteration box of this tile,
2962 !! [isc:iec, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
2963 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
2964 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
2965 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
2966 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
2967 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
2968 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
2969 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHgrad !< The h points of this tile where the velocity gradients are
2970 !! computed, [IscB-1:IecB+2, JscB-1:JecB+2, 1:kmax]
2971 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQshear !< The q points of this tile where the shearing strain is
2972 !! computed, [isc-2:iec+1, jsc-2:jec+1, 1:kmax]
2973 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQvsmooth !< The q points of this tile where the smoothed vorticity
2974 !! terms are computed,
2975 !! [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh, js_Kh-1:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
2976 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
2977 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
2978 logical, intent(in) :: use_vort_xy !< True if vort_xy must be computed
2979 logical, intent(in) :: apply_OBC !< If true, open boundary conditions are applied on this PE
2980 logical, intent(in) :: apply_OBC_strain !< If true, the specified open boundary strain configuration is applied
2981 logical, intent(in) :: use_cont_huv !< If true, use the continuity solver thicknesses at velocity points
2982 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: u_a !< The zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
2983 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: v_a !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
2984 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
2985 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hu_cont_a !< Layer thickness at u-points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
2986 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hv_cont_a !< Layer thickness at v-points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
2987 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: u_smooth_a !< Zonal velocity, smoothed with a spatial low-pass filter
2988 !! [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
2989 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: v_smooth_a !< Meridional velocity, smoothed with a spatial low-pass
2990 !! filter [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
2991 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: NoSt_a !< A diagnostic array of normal stress [T-1 ~> s-1].
2992 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: ShSt_a !< A diagnostic array of shear stress [T-1 ~> s-1].
2993 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2u_a !< The u-component of the Laplacian of velocity
2994 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
2995 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_u_a !< Thickness interpolated to u points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
2996 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2v_a !< The v-component of the Laplacian of velocity
2997 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
2998 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_v_a !< Thickness interpolated to v points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
2999 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
3000 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
3001 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_smooth_a !< horizontal tension from smoothed velocity including
3002 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
3003 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudx_a !< components in the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
3004 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdy_a !< components in the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
3005 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdx_a !< components in the shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
3006 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudy_a !< components in the shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
3007 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdx_smooth_a !< components in the shearing strain from smoothed
3008 !! velocity [T-1 ~> s-1]
3009 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudy_smooth_a !< components in the shearing strain from smoothed
3010 !! velocity [T-1 ~> s-1]
3011 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric
3012 !! terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
3013 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_smooth_a !< horizontal shearing strain from smoothed velocity
3014 !! including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
3015 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_a !< Vertical vorticity (dv/dx - du/dy) including metric terms
3016 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
3017 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_smooth_a !< Vertical vorticity including metric terms, smoothed
3018 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
3019
3020 ! Local variables
30211875 type(Box_t) :: bxUdel2 ! u points [Isq-1:Ieq+1, js-1:je+1] where Del2u is computed: one point beyond bxU,
3022 ! because the biharmonic pass in hor_visc_h_coeffs_b differences Del2u between neighbours
30231875 type(Box_t) :: bxUhcont ! u points [Isq-1:Ieq+1, js-2:je+2] where h_u is copied from hu_cont; two
3024 ! points out in j for the OBC cross-corner projections
30251875 type(Box_t) :: bxVdel2 ! v points [is-1:ie+1, Jsq-1:Jeq+1] where Del2v is computed: one point beyond bxV,
3026 ! because the biharmonic pass in hor_visc_h_coeffs_b differences Del2v between neighbours
30271875 type(Box_t) :: bxVhcont ! v points [is-2:ie+2, Jsq-1:Jeq+1] where h_v is copied from hv_cont; two
3028 ! points out in i for the OBC cross-corner projections
30291875 type(Box_t) :: bxVhavg ! v points [is-2:ie+2, js-2:Jeq+1] where h_v is averaged from h; built from bxH
3030 ! because the range starts at js-2 in both memory modes
30311875 type(Box_t) :: bxUhavg ! u points [is-2:Ieq+1, js-2:je+2] where h_u is averaged from h; built from bxH
3032 ! because the range starts at is-2 in both memory modes
30331875 type(Box_t) :: bxVort ! q points of this tile where dudy, dvdx and vort_xy are computed,
3034 ! [is_vort:ie_vort, js_vort:je_vort, 1:kmax]: two points below and one above the h points; with
3035 ! a Leith scheme, around bxKh instead, because Leith takes gradients of the vorticity
3036 integer :: is_vort, ie_vort, js_vort, je_vort ! Loop ranges for vorticity terms
30371875 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: vort_xy_smooth, vort_xy, sh_xy_smooth, sh_xy, &
30381875 dudy_smooth, dvdx_smooth, dudy, dvdx, dvdy, dudx, sh_xx_smooth, sh_xx, h_v, Del2v, h_u, Del2u, &
30391875 ShSt, NoSt, v_smooth, u_smooth, hv_cont, hu_cont, h, v, u
30401875 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: IdyCu, IdxCv, IdyCv, IdxCu, mask2dT, dxBu, &
30411875 mask2dBu, IareaBu, dyCv, dxCu
30421875 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: dx2h, dy2h, dx_dyT, dy_dxT, dx2q, dy2q, dx_dyBu, dy_dxBu, &
30431875 Idx2dyCu, Idxdy2u, Idx2dyCv, Idxdy2v
3044 real :: dudx_smooth, dvdy_smooth ! components in the horizontal tension from smoothed velocity [T-1 ~> s-1]
3045 integer :: i, j, k, kk, n, is, ie, js, je, Isq, Ieq, Jsq, Jeq, kmax
3046
30471875 nullify(hv_cont, hu_cont)
30481875 if (hv_cont_a%associated()) call hv_cont_a%view(hv_cont)
30491875 if (hu_cont_a%associated()) call hu_cont_a%view(hu_cont)
30501875 call vort_xy_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_smooth) ; call vort_xy_a%view(vort_xy)
30511875 call sh_xy_smooth_a%view(sh_xy_smooth) ; call sh_xy_a%view(sh_xy)
30521875 call dudy_smooth_a%view(dudy_smooth) ; call dvdx_smooth_a%view(dvdx_smooth)
30531875 call dudy_a%view(dudy) ; call dvdx_a%view(dvdx) ; call dvdy_a%view(dvdy)
30541875 call dudx_a%view(dudx) ; call sh_xx_smooth_a%view(sh_xx_smooth) ; call sh_xx_a%view(sh_xx)
30551875 call h_v_a%view(h_v) ; call Del2v_a%view(Del2v) ; call h_u_a%view(h_u)
30561875 call Del2u_a%view(Del2u) ; call ShSt_a%view(ShSt) ; call NoSt_a%view(NoSt)
30571875 call v_smooth_a%view(v_smooth) ; call u_smooth_a%view(u_smooth) ; call h_a%view(h)
30581875 call v_a%view(v) ; call u_a%view(u)
30591875 call Gcore%IdyCu%view(IdyCu) ; call Gcore%IdxCv%view(IdxCv) ; call Gcore%IdyCv%view(IdyCv)
30601875 call Gcore%IdxCu%view(IdxCu) ; call Gcore%mask2dT%view(mask2dT) ; call Gcore%dxBu%view(dxBu)
30611875 call Gcore%mask2dBu%view(mask2dBu) ; call Gcore%IareaBu%view(IareaBu)
30621875 call Gcore%dyCv%view(dyCv) ; call Gcore%dxCu%view(dxCu)
3063
30641875 nullify(dx2h, dy2h, dx_dyT, dy_dxT, dx2q, dy2q, dx_dyBu, dy_dxBu, Idx2dyCu, Idxdy2u, Idx2dyCv, Idxdy2v)
30651875 if (metrics%dx2h%associated()) call metrics%dx2h%view(dx2h)
30661875 if (metrics%dy2h%associated()) call metrics%dy2h%view(dy2h)
30671875 if (metrics%dx_dyT%associated()) call metrics%dx_dyT%view(dx_dyT)
30681875 if (metrics%dy_dxT%associated()) call metrics%dy_dxT%view(dy_dxT)
30691875 if (metrics%dx2q%associated()) call metrics%dx2q%view(dx2q)
30701875 if (metrics%dy2q%associated()) call metrics%dy2q%view(dy2q)
30711875 if (metrics%dx_dyBu%associated()) call metrics%dx_dyBu%view(dx_dyBu)
30721875 if (metrics%dy_dxBu%associated()) call metrics%dy_dxBu%view(dy_dxBu)
30731875 if (metrics%Idx2dyCu%associated()) call metrics%Idx2dyCu%view(Idx2dyCu)
30741875 if (metrics%Idxdy2u%associated()) call metrics%Idxdy2u%view(Idxdy2u)
30751875 if (metrics%Idx2dyCv%associated()) call metrics%Idx2dyCv%view(Idx2dyCv)
30761875 if (metrics%Idxdy2v%associated()) call metrics%Idxdy2v%view(Idxdy2v)
3077
30781875 is = bxH%idxS(1) ; ie = bxH%idxE(1) ; js = bxH%idxS(2) ; je = bxH%idxE(2)
30791875 Isq = bxQ%idxS(1) ; Ieq = bxQ%idxE(1) ; Jsq = bxQ%idxS(2) ; Jeq = bxQ%idxE(2)
30801875 kmax = bxH%idxE(3) - bxH%idxS(3) + 1
30811875 bxUdel2 = bxU%growBy(lo=[1,1,0], hi=[1,1,0])
30821875 bxUhcont = bxU%growBy(lo=[1,2,0], hi=[1,2,0])
30831875 bxVdel2 = bxV%growBy(lo=[1,1,0], hi=[1,1,0])
30841875 bxVhcont = bxV%growBy(lo=[2,1,0], hi=[2,1,0])
30851875 bxVhavg = bxH%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[2,1,0])
30861875 bxUhavg = bxH%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[1,2,0])
3087 ! Set the halo sizes used for the vorticity calculations.
30881875 if ((CS%Leith_Kh) .or. (CS%Leith_Ah) .or. (CS%use_Leithy)) then
30890 bxVort = bxKh%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[1,1,0])
3090 else
30911875 bxVort = bxH%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[1,1,0])
3092 endif
30931875 is_vort = bxVort%idxS(1) ; ie_vort = bxVort%idxE(1)
30941875 js_vort = bxVort%idxS(2) ; je_vort = bxVort%idxE(2)
3095
30961875 k=kstart
3097
3098 ! The following are the forms of the horizontal tension and horizontal
3099 ! shearing strain advocated by Smagorinsky (1993) and discussed in
3100 ! Griffies and Hallberg (2000).
3101
3102 ! Calculate horizontal tension
3103 do concurrent (kk=bxHgrad%idxS(3):bxHgrad%idxE(3), j=bxHgrad%idxS(2):bxHgrad%idxE(2), &
310415114375 i=bxHgrad%idxS(1):bxHgrad%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
310514880000 k = kstart + kk - 1
3106 dudx(i,j,kk) = DY_dxT(i,j)*((IdyCu(I,j) * u(I,j,k)) - &
310714880000 (IdyCu(I-1,j) * u(I-1,j,k)))
3108 dvdy(i,j,kk) = DX_dyT(i,j)*((IdxCv(i,J) * v(i,J,k)) - &
310914880000 (IdxCv(i,J-1) * v(i,J-1,k)))
311029994375 sh_xx(i,j,kk) = dudx(i,j,kk) - dvdy(i,j,kk)
3111 enddo
3112
3113 ! Components for the shearing strain
3114 do concurrent (kk=bxVort%idxS(3):bxVort%idxE(3), J=bxVort%idxS(2):bxVort%idxE(2), &
311514761875 I=bxVort%idxS(1):bxVort%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
311614529375 k = kstart + kk - 1
311714529375 dvdx(I,J,kk) = DY_dxBu(I,J)*((v(i+1,J,k)*IdyCv(i+1,J)) - (v(i,J,k)*IdyCv(i,J)))
311829291250 dudy(I,J,kk) = DX_dyBu(I,J)*((u(I,j+1,k)*IdxCu(I,j+1)) - (u(I,j,k)*IdxCu(I,j)))
3119 enddo
3120
31211875 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
3122 ! Calculate horizontal tension from smoothed velocity
3123 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
31240 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k, dudx_smooth, dvdy_smooth))
31250 k = kstart + kk - 1
3126 dudx_smooth = DY_dxT(i,j)*((IdyCu(I,j) * u_smooth(I,j,k)) - &
31270 (IdyCu(I-1,j) * u_smooth(I-1,j,k)))
3128 dvdy_smooth = DX_dyT(i,j)*((IdxCv(i,J) * v_smooth(i,J,k)) - &
31290 (IdxCv(i,J-1) * v_smooth(i,J-1,k)))
31300 sh_xx_smooth(i,j,kk) = dudx_smooth - dvdy_smooth
3131 enddo
3132
3133 ! Components for the shearing strain from smoothed velocity
3134 do concurrent (kk=bxQvsmooth%idxS(3):bxQvsmooth%idxE(3), J=bxQvsmooth%idxS(2):bxQvsmooth%idxE(2), &
31350 I=bxQvsmooth%idxS(1):bxQvsmooth%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
31360 k = kstart + kk - 1
3137 dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) = DY_dxBu(I,J) * &
31380 ((v_smooth(i+1,J,k)*IdyCv(i+1,J)) - (v_smooth(i,J,k)*IdyCv(i,J)))
3139 dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) = DX_dyBu(I,J) * &
31400 ((u_smooth(I,j+1,k)*IdxCu(I,j+1)) - (u_smooth(I,j,k)*IdxCu(I,j)))
3141 enddo
3142 endif ! use Leith+E
3143
31441875 if (CS%do_normstress) then
3145 do concurrent (kk=bxH%idxS(3):bxH%idxE(3), j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), &
31460 i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
31470 k = kstart + kk - 1
31480 NoSt(i,j,k) = sh_xx(i,j,kk)
3149 enddo
3150 endif
3151
3152 ! Interpolate the thicknesses to velocity points.
3153 ! The extra wide halos are to accommodate the cross-corner-point projections
3154 ! in OBCs, which are not ordinarily be necessary, and might not be necessary
3155 ! even with OBCs if the accelerations are zeroed at OBC points, in which
3156 ! case the j-loop for h_u could collapse to j=js=1,je+1. -RWH
31571875 if (use_cont_huv) then
3158 do concurrent (kk=bxUhcont%idxS(3):bxUhcont%idxE(3), &
3159 j=bxUhcont%idxS(2):bxUhcont%idxE(2), &
31600 I=bxUhcont%idxS(1):bxUhcont%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
31610 k = kstart + kk - 1
31620 h_u(I,j,kk) = hu_cont(I,j,k)
3163 enddo
3164 do concurrent (kk=bxVhcont%idxS(3):bxVhcont%idxE(3), &
3165 J=bxVhcont%idxS(2):bxVhcont%idxE(2), &
31660 i=bxVhcont%idxS(1):bxVhcont%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
31670 k = kstart + kk - 1
31680 h_v(i,J,kk) = hv_cont(i,J,k)
3169 enddo
31701875 elseif (CS%use_land_mask) then
3171 do concurrent (kk=bxUhavg%idxS(3):bxUhavg%idxE(3), &
3172 j=bxUhavg%idxS(2):bxUhavg%idxE(2), &
31730 I=bxUhavg%idxS(1):bxUhavg%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
31740 k = kstart + kk - 1
31750 h_u(I,j,kk) = 0.5 * (mask2dT(i,j)*h(i,j,k) + mask2dT(i+1,j)*h(i+1,j,k))
3176 enddo
3177 do concurrent (kk=bxVhavg%idxS(3):bxVhavg%idxE(3), &
3178 J=bxVhavg%idxS(2):bxVhavg%idxE(2), &
31790 i=bxVhavg%idxS(1):bxVhavg%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
31800 k = kstart + kk - 1
31810 h_v(i,J,kk) = 0.5 * (mask2dT(i,j)*h(i,j,k) + mask2dT(i,j+1)*h(i,j+1,k))
3182 enddo
3183 else
3184 do concurrent (kk=bxUhavg%idxS(3):bxUhavg%idxE(3), &
3185 j=bxUhavg%idxS(2):bxUhavg%idxE(2), &
318614992500 I=bxUhavg%idxS(1):bxUhavg%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
318714760000 k = kstart + kk - 1
318829752500 h_u(I,j,kk) = 0.5 * (h(i,j,k) + h(i+1,j,k))
3189 enddo
3190 do concurrent (kk=bxVhavg%idxS(3):bxVhavg%idxE(3), &
3191 J=bxVhavg%idxS(2):bxVhavg%idxE(2), &
319214881875 i=bxVhavg%idxS(1):bxVhavg%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
319314647500 k = kstart + kk - 1
319429529375 h_v(i,J,kk) = 0.5 * (h(i,j,k) + h(i,j+1,k))
3195 enddo
3196 endif
3197
3198 ! Adjust contributions to shearing strain and interpolated values of
3199 ! thicknesses on open boundaries.
32001875 if (apply_OBC) then
3201 ! TODO: Reindent this later
32020 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
3203
32040 J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB ; I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB
32050 if (apply_OBC_strain) then
32060 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_N_or_S .and. (J >= Js_vort) .and. (J <= Je_vort)) then
3207 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, &
3208 I=max(OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB,Is_vort):min(OBC%segment(n)%HI%IedB,Ie_vort)) &
32090 DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
32100 k = kstart + kk - 1
32110 select case (OBC%strain_config)
3212 case (OBC_STRAIN_ZERO)
32130 dvdx(I,J,kk) = 0. ; dudy(I,J,kk) = 0.
3214 case (OBC_STRAIN_FREESLIP)
32150 dudy(I,J,kk) = 0.
3216 case (OBC_STRAIN_COMPUTED)
32170 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
3218 dudy(I,J,kk) = 2.0*DX_dyBu(I,J)* &
32190 (OBC%segment(n)%tangential_vel(I,J,k) - u(I,j,k))*IdxCu(I,j)
3220 else
3221 dudy(I,J,kk) = 2.0*DX_dyBu(I,J)* &
32220 (u(I,j+1,k) - OBC%segment(n)%tangential_vel(I,J,k))*IdxCu(I,j+1)
3223 endif
3224 case (OBC_STRAIN_SPECIFIED)
32250 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
32260 dudy(I,J,kk) = DX_dyBu(I,J)*OBC%segment(n)%tangential_grad(I,J,k)*IdxCu(I,j)*dxBu(I,J)
3227 else
32280 dudy(I,J,kk) = DX_dyBu(I,J)*OBC%segment(n)%tangential_grad(I,J,k)*IdxCu(I,j+1)*dxBu(I,J)
3229 endif
3230 end select
32310 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
32320 dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) = dvdx(I,J,kk)
32330 dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) = dudy(I,J,kk)
3234 endif
3235 enddo
32360 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W .and. (I >= is_vort) .and. (I <= ie_vort)) then
3237 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, &
3238 J=max(OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB,js_vort):min(OBC%segment(n)%HI%JedB,je_vort)) &
32390 DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
32400 k = kstart + kk - 1
32410 select case (OBC%strain_config)
3242 case (OBC_STRAIN_ZERO)
32430 dvdx(I,J,kk) = 0. ; dudy(I,J,kk) = 0.
3244 case (OBC_STRAIN_FREESLIP)
32450 dvdx(I,J,kk) = 0.
3246 case (OBC_STRAIN_COMPUTED)
32470 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
3248 dvdx(I,J,kk) = 2.0*DY_dxBu(I,J)* &
32490 (OBC%segment(n)%tangential_vel(I,J,k) - v(i,J,k))*IdyCv(i,J)
3250 else
3251 dvdx(I,J,kk) = 2.0*DY_dxBu(I,J)* &
32520 (v(i+1,J,k) - OBC%segment(n)%tangential_vel(I,J,k))*IdyCv(i+1,J)
3253 endif
3254 case (OBC_STRAIN_SPECIFIED)
32550 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
32560 dvdx(I,J,kk) = DY_dxBu(I,J)*OBC%segment(n)%tangential_grad(I,J,k)*IdyCv(i,J)*dxBu(I,J)
3257 else
32580 dvdx(I,J,kk) = DY_dxBu(I,J)*OBC%segment(n)%tangential_grad(I,J,k)*IdyCv(i+1,J)*dxBu(I,J)
3259 endif
3260 end select
32610 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
32620 dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) = dvdx(I,J,kk)
32630 dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) = dudy(I,J,kk)
3264 endif
3265 enddo
3266 endif
3267 endif
3268
32690 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
3270 ! There are extra wide halos here to accommodate the cross-corner-point
3271 ! OBC projections, but they might not be necessary if the accelerations
3272 ! are always zeroed out at OBC points, in which case the i-loop below
3273 ! becomes do i=is-1,ie+1. -RWH
32740 if ((J >= js-2) .and. (J <= Jeq+1)) then
3275 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, &
32760 i=max(is-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%isd):min(ie+2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%ied)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
32770 k = kstart + kk - 1
32780 h_v(i,J,kk) = h(i,j,k)
3279 enddo
3280 endif
32810 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
32820 if ((J >= js-2) .and. (J <= Jeq+1)) then
3283 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, &
32840 i=max(is-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%isd):min(ie+2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%ied)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
32850 k = kstart + kk - 1
32860 h_v(i,J,kk) = h(i,j+1,k)
3287 enddo
3288 endif
32890 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
32900 if ((I >= is-2) .and. (I <= Ieq+1)) then
3291 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, &
32920 j=max(js-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd):min(je+2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
32930 k = kstart + kk - 1
32940 h_u(I,j,kk) = h(i,j,k)
3295 enddo
3296 endif
32970 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
32980 if ((I >= is-2) .and. (I <= Ieq+1)) then
3299 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, &
33000 j=max(js-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd):min(je+2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
33010 k = kstart + kk - 1
33020 h_u(I,j,kk) = h(i+1,j,k)
3303 enddo
3304 endif
3305 endif
3306 enddo ; endif
3307 ! Now project thicknesses across corner points on OBCs.
33081875 if (apply_OBC) then ; do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
33090 J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB ; I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB
33100 if (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_N) then
33110 if ((J >= js-2) .and. (J <= je)) then
33120 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, I=max(is-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB):min(Ieq+1,OBC%segment(n)%HI%IedB))
33130 h_u(I,j+1,kk) = h_u(I,j,kk)
3314 enddo
3315 endif
33160 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_S) then
33170 if ((J >= js-1) .and. (J <= je+1)) then
33180 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, I=max(is-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%isd):min(Ieq+1,OBC%segment(n)%HI%ied))
33190 h_u(I,j,kk) = h_u(I,j+1,kk)
3320 enddo
3321 endif
33220 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_E) then
33230 if ((I >= is-2) .and. (I <= ie)) then
33240 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, J=max(js-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd):min(Jeq+1,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed))
33250 h_v(i+1,J,kk) = h_v(i,J,kk)
3326 enddo
3327 endif
33280 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%direction == OBC_DIRECTION_W) then
33290 if ((I >= is-1) .and. (I <= ie+1)) then
33300 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, J=max(js-2,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd):min(Jeq+1,OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed))
33310 h_v(i,J,kk) = h_v(i+1,J,kk)
3332 enddo
3333 endif
3334 endif
3335 enddo
3336 ! TODO: Fix indentation
3337 endif
3338
3339 ! Shearing strain (including no-slip boundary conditions at the 2-D land-sea mask).
3340 ! dudy and dvdx include modifications at OBCs from above.
33411875 if (CS%no_slip) then
3342 do concurrent (kk=bxQshear%idxS(3):bxQshear%idxE(3), J=bxQshear%idxS(2):bxQshear%idxE(2), &
33430 I=bxQshear%idxS(1):bxQshear%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
33440 k = kstart + kk - 1
33450 sh_xy(I,J,kk) = (2.0-mask2dBu(I,J)) * ( dvdx(I,J,kk) + dudy(I,J,kk) )
33460 if (CS%do_shearstress) ShSt(I,J,k) = sh_xy(I,J,kk)
3347 enddo
3348 else
3349 do concurrent (kk=bxQshear%idxS(3):bxQshear%idxE(3), J=bxQshear%idxS(2):bxQshear%idxE(2), &
335014761875 I=bxQshear%idxS(1):bxQshear%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
335114529375 k = kstart + kk - 1
335214529375 sh_xy(I,J,kk) = mask2dBu(I,J) * ( dvdx(I,J,kk) + dudy(I,J,kk) )
335329291250 if (CS%do_shearstress) ShSt(I,J,k) = sh_xy(I,J,kk)
3354 enddo
3355 endif
3356
33571875 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
3358 ! Shearing strain (including no-slip boundary conditions at the 2-D land-sea mask).
3359 ! dudy_smooth and dvdx_smooth do not (yet) include modifications at OBCs from above.
33600 if (CS%no_slip) then
3361 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
33620 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
33630 sh_xy_smooth(I,J,kk) = (2.0-mask2dBu(I,J)) * ( dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) + dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) )
3364 enddo
3365 else
3366 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
33670 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
33680 sh_xy_smooth(I,J,kk) = mask2dBu(I,J) * ( dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) + dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) )
3369 enddo
3370 endif
3371 endif ! use Leith+E
3372
3373 ! Evaluate Del2u = x.Div(Grad u) and Del2v = y.Div( Grad u)
33741875 if (CS%biharmonic) then
3375 do concurrent (kk=bxUdel2%idxS(3):bxUdel2%idxE(3), j=bxUdel2%idxS(2):bxUdel2%idxE(2), &
337614531250 I=bxUdel2%idxS(1):bxUdel2%idxE(1))
3377 Del2u(I,j,kk) = Idx2dyCu(I,j) * ((dx2q(I,J)*sh_xy(I,J,kk)) - (dx2q(I,J-1)*sh_xy(I,J-1,kk))) + &
337828830000 Idxdy2u(I,j) * ((dy2h(i+1,j)*sh_xx(i+1,j,kk)) - (dy2h(i,j)*sh_xx(i,j,kk)))
3379 enddo
3380 do concurrent (kk=bxVdel2%idxS(3):bxVdel2%idxE(3), J=bxVdel2%idxS(2):bxVdel2%idxE(2), &
338114641875 i=bxVdel2%idxS(1):bxVdel2%idxE(1))
3382 Del2v(i,J,kk) = Idxdy2v(i,J) * ((dy2q(I,J)*sh_xy(I,J,kk)) - (dy2q(I-1,J)*sh_xy(I-1,J,kk))) - &
338329053125 Idx2dyCv(i,J) * ((dx2h(i,j+1)*sh_xx(i,j+1,kk)) - (dx2h(i,j)*sh_xx(i,j,kk)))
3384 enddo
33851875 if (apply_OBC) then ; if (OBC%zero_biharmonic) then
33860 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
33870 I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB ; J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB
33880 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_N_or_S .and. (J >= Jsq-1) .and. (J <= Jeq+1)) then
33890 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, I=OBC%segment(n)%HI%isd:OBC%segment(n)%HI%ied)
33900 Del2v(i,J,kk) = 0.
3391 enddo
33920 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W .and. (I >= Isq-1) .and. (I <= Ieq+1)) then
33930 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, j=OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd:OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed)
33940 Del2u(I,j,kk) = 0.
3395 enddo
3396 endif
3397 enddo
3398 endif ; endif
3399 endif
3400
3401 ! Vorticity
34021875 if (use_vort_xy) then
34030 if (CS%no_slip) then
34040 do concurrent (kk=bxVort%idxS(3):bxVort%idxE(3), J=bxVort%idxS(2):bxVort%idxE(2), I=bxVort%idxS(1):bxVort%idxE(1))
34050 vort_xy(I,J,kk) = (2.0-mask2dBu(I,J)) * ( dvdx(I,J,kk) - dudy(I,J,kk) )
3406 enddo
3407 else
34080 if (CS%use_circulation) then
3409 do concurrent (kk=bxVort%idxS(3):bxVort%idxE(3), J=bxVort%idxS(2):bxVort%idxE(2), &
34100 I=bxVort%idxS(1):bxVort%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
34110 k = kstart + kk - 1
3412 vort_xy(I,J,kk) = mask2dBu(I,J) * IareaBu(I,J) * ( &
3413 ((v(i+1,J,k)*dyCv(i+1,J)) - (v(i,J,k)*dyCv(i,J))) &
3414 - ((u(I,j+1,k)*dxCu(I,j+1)) - (u(I,j,k)*dxCu(I,j))) &
34150 )
3416 enddo
3417 else
3418 do concurrent (kk=bxVort%idxS(3):bxVort%idxE(3), J=bxVort%idxS(2):bxVort%idxE(2), &
34190 I=bxVort%idxS(1):bxVort%idxE(1))
34200 vort_xy(I,J,kk) = mask2dBu(I,J) * ( dvdx(I,J,kk) - dudy(I,J,kk) )
3421 enddo
3422 endif
3423 endif
3424 endif
3425
34261875 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
34270 if (CS%no_slip) then
3428 do concurrent (kk=bxQvsmooth%idxS(3):bxQvsmooth%idxE(3), J=bxQvsmooth%idxS(2):bxQvsmooth%idxE(2), &
34290 I=bxQvsmooth%idxS(1):bxQvsmooth%idxE(1))
34300 vort_xy_smooth(I,J,kk) = (2.0-mask2dBu(I,J)) * ( dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) - dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) )
3431 enddo
3432 else
3433 do concurrent (kk=bxQvsmooth%idxS(3):bxQvsmooth%idxE(3), J=bxQvsmooth%idxS(2):bxQvsmooth%idxE(2), &
34340 I=bxQvsmooth%idxS(1):bxQvsmooth%idxE(1))
34350 vort_xy_smooth(I,J,kk) = mask2dBu(I,J) * ( dvdx_smooth(I,J,kk) - dudy_smooth(I,J,kk) )
3436 enddo
3437 endif
3438 endif

3756 Kh_h_a, grid_Re_Kh_a, div_xx_h_a, sh_xx_h_a, h_u_a, h_v_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, &

3765 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays

3890
38911875 if (CS%Laplacian) then
3892 ! Determine the Laplacian viscosity at h points, using the
3893 ! largest value from several parameterizations. Also get
3894 ! the Laplacian component of str_xx.
3895
38961875 if ((CS%Leith_Kh) .or. (CS%Leith_Ah) .or. (CS%use_Leithy)) then
38970 if (CS%use_QG_Leith_visc) then
3898 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
38990 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(grad_vort, grad_vort_qg))
39000 grad_vort = grad_vort_mag_h(i,j,kk) + grad_div_mag_h(i,j,kk)
39010 grad_vort_qg = 3. * grad_vort_mag_h_2d(i,j,kk)
39020 vert_vort_mag(i,j,kk) = min(grad_vort, grad_vort_qg)
3903 enddo
3904 else
39050 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
39060 vert_vort_mag(i,j,kk) = grad_vort_mag_h(i,j,kk) + grad_div_mag_h(i,j,kk)
3907 enddo
3908 endif
3909 endif
3910
3911 ! Static (pre-computed) background viscosity
391214413125 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
391328595625 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh_bg_xx(i,j)
3914 enddo
3915
3916 ! NOTE: The following do-block can be decomposed and vectorized after the
3917 ! stack size has been reduced.
391814413125 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
391928595625 if (CS%add_LES_viscosity) then
39200 if (CS%Smagorinsky_Kh) &
39210 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + Laplac2_const_xx(i,j) * Shear_mag(i,j,kk)
39220 if (CS%Leith_Kh) &
39230 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + Laplac3_const_xx(i,j) * vert_vort_mag(i,j,kk) * inv_PI3
3924 else
392514182500 if (CS%Smagorinsky_Kh) &
39260 Kh(i,j,kk) = max(Kh(i,j,kk), Laplac2_const_xx(i,j) * Shear_mag(i,j,kk))
392714182500 if (CS%Leith_Kh) &
39280 Kh(i,j,kk) = max(Kh(i,j,kk), Laplac3_const_xx(i,j) * vert_vort_mag(i,j,kk) * inv_PI3)
3929 endif
3930 enddo
3931
3932 ! All viscosity contributions above are subject to resolution scaling
3933
39341875 if (rescale_Kh) then
393514413125 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
393628595625 Kh(i,j,kk) = Res_fn_h(i,j) * Kh(i,j,kk)
3937 enddo
3938 endif
3939
3940 ! Place a floor on the viscosity, if desired.
394114413125 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
394228595625 Kh(i,j,kk) = max(Kh(i,j,kk), CS%Kh_bg_min)
3943 enddo
3944
39451875 if (use_MEKE_Ku .and. .not. CS%EY24_EBT_BS) then
3946 ! *Add* the MEKE contribution (which might be negative)
39470 if (use_kh_struct) then
39480 if (CS%res_scale_MEKE) then
3949 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
39500 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
39510 k = kstart + kk - 1
39520 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + MEKE_Ku(i,j) * Res_fn_h(i,j) * BS_struct(i,j,k)
3953 enddo
3954 else
3955 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
39560 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
39570 k = kstart + kk - 1
39580 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + MEKE_Ku(i,j) * BS_struct(i,j,k)
3959 enddo
3960 endif
3961 else
39620 if (CS%res_scale_MEKE) then
39630 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
39640 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + MEKE_Ku(i,j) * Res_fn_h(i,j)
3965 enddo
3966 else
39670 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
39680 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + MEKE_Ku(i,j)
3969 enddo
3970 endif
3971 endif
3972 endif
3973
39741875 if (CS%anisotropic) then
39750 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
3976 ! *Add* the tension component of anisotropic viscosity
39770 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh(i,j,kk) + CS%Kh_aniso * (1. - n1n2_h(i,j)**2)
3978 enddo
3979 endif
3980
3981
3982 ! Newer method of bounding for stability
39831875 if ((CS%bound_Kh) .and. (CS%bound_Ah)) then
3984 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
398514413125 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Kh_max_here))
398614182500 visc_bound_rem(i,j,kk) = 1.0
398714182500 Kh_max_here = hrat_min(i,j,kk) * Kh_Max_xx(i,j)
398828595625 if (Kh(i,j,kk) >= Kh_max_here) then
39894713750 visc_bound_rem(i,j,kk) = 0.0
39904713750 Kh(i,j,kk) = Kh_max_here
39919468750 elseif ((Kh(i,j,kk) > 0.0) .or. (CS%backscatter_underbound .and. (Kh_max_here > 0.0))) then
39920 visc_bound_rem(i,j,kk) = 1.0 - Kh(i,j,kk) / Kh_max_here
3993 endif
3994 enddo
39950 elseif (CS%bound_Kh) then
39960 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
39970 Kh(i,j,kk) = min(Kh(i,j,kk), hrat_min(i,j,kk) * Kh_Max_xx(i,j))
3998 enddo
3999 endif
4000
4001 ! In Leith+E parameterization Kh is computed after Ah in the biharmonic loop.
4002 ! The harmonic component of str_xx is added in the biharmonic loop.
40031875 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
40040 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
40050 Kh(i,j,kk) = 0.
4006 enddo
4007 endif
4008
40091875 if (CS%do_Kh_h .or. CS%debug) then
4010 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
40110 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
40120 k = kstart + kk - 1
40130 Kh_h(i,j,k) = Kh(i,j,kk)
4014 enddo
4015 endif
4016
40171875 if (CS%do_grid_Re_Kh) then
4018 do concurrent (kk=bxH%idxS(3):bxH%idxE(3), j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), &
40190 i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k, KE, grid_Kh))
40200 k = kstart + kk - 1
40210 KE = 0.125*(((u(I,j,k)+u(I-1,j,k))**2) + ((v(i,J,k)+v(i,J-1,k))**2))
40220 grid_Kh = max(Kh(i,j,kk), CS%min_grid_Kh)
40230 grid_Re_Kh(i,j,k) = (sqrt(KE) * sqrt(grid_sp_h2(i,j))) / grid_Kh
4024 enddo
4025 endif
4026
40271875 if (CS%do_div_xx_h) then
4028 do concurrent (kk=bxH%idxS(3):bxH%idxE(3), j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), &
40290 i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
40300 k = kstart + kk - 1
40310 div_xx_h(i,j,k) = dudx(i,j,kk) + dvdy(i,j,kk)
4032 enddo
4033 endif
4034
40351875 if (CS%do_sh_xx_h) then
4036 do concurrent (kk=bxH%idxS(3):bxH%idxE(3), j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), &
40370 i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
40380 k = kstart + kk - 1
40390 sh_xx_h(i,j,k) = sh_xx(i,j,kk)
4040 enddo
4041 endif
4042
4043 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
404414413125 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1))
404528595625 str_xx(i,j,kk) = -Kh(i,j,kk) * sh_xx(i,j,kk)
4046 enddo
4047 else
4048 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
40490 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1))
40500 str_xx(i,j,kk) = 0.0
4051 enddo
4052 endif ! Get Kh at h points and get Laplacian component of str_xx
4053
40541875 if (CS%anisotropic) then
4055 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
40560 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(local_strain))
4057 ! Shearing-strain averaged to h-points
40580 local_strain = 0.25 * ( (sh_xy(I,J,kk) + sh_xy(I-1,J-1,kk)) + (sh_xy(I-1,J,kk) + sh_xy(I,J-1,kk)) )
4059 ! *Add* the shear-strain contribution to the xx-component of stress
40600 str_xx(i,j,kk) = str_xx(i,j,kk) - CS%Kh_aniso * n1n2_h(i,j) * n1n1_m_n2n2_h(i,j) * local_strain
4061 enddo
4062 endif
4063
40641875 if (CS%biharmonic) then
4065 ! Determine the biharmonic viscosity at h points, using the
4066 ! largest value from several parameterizations. Also get the
4067 ! biharmonic component of str_xx.
406814413125 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
406928595625 Ah(i,j,kk) = Ah_bg_xx(i,j)
4070 enddo
4071
40721875 if ((CS%Smagorinsky_Ah) .or. (CS%Leith_Ah) .or. (CS%use_Leithy)) then
40731875 if (CS%Smagorinsky_Ah) then
40741875 if (CS%bound_Coriolis) then
4075 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
407614413125 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(AhSm))
4077 AhSm = Shear_mag(i,j,kk) * (Biharm_const_xx(i,j) &
407814182500 + Biharm_const2_xx(i,j) * Shear_mag(i,j,kk))
407928595625 Ah(i,j,kk) = max(Ah(i,j,kk), AhSm)
4080 enddo
4081 else
4082 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
40830 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(AhSm))
40840 AhSm = Biharm_const_xx(i,j) * Shear_mag(i,j,kk)
40850 Ah(i,j,kk) = max(Ah(i,j,kk), AhSm)
4086 enddo
4087 endif
4088 endif
4089
40901875 if (CS%Leith_Ah) then
4091 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
40920 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Del2vort_h, AhLth))
4093 Del2vort_h = 0.25 * ((Del2vort_q(I,J,kk) + Del2vort_q(I-1,J-1,kk)) + &
40940 (Del2vort_q(I-1,J,kk) + Del2vort_q(I,J-1,kk)))
40950 AhLth = Biharm6_const_xx(i,j) * abs(Del2vort_h) * inv_PI6
40960 Ah(i,j,kk) = max(Ah(i,j,kk), AhLth)
4097 enddo
4098 endif
4099 endif ! Smagorinsky_Ah or Leith_Ah or Leith+E
4100 endif
4101
41021875end subroutine hor_visc_h_coeffs_a_fortran
4103
4104!> Dispatches hor_visc_h_coeffs_a to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
4105!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by HOR_VISC_H_COEFFS_A_MODE.
41061875subroutine hor_visc_h_coeffs_a(MEKE_a, VarMix_a, CS, metrics, bxH, bxKh, bxHstr, nkblock, kstart, h_neglect, inv_PI3, &
4107 inv_PI6, use_kh_struct, use_MEKE_Ku, rescale_Kh, u_a, v_a, h_a, Kh_h_a, grid_Re_Kh_a, &
4108 div_xx_h_a, sh_xx_h_a, h_u_a, h_v_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, grad_vort_mag_h_a, &
4109 grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a, grad_div_mag_h_a, dudx_a, dvdy_a, sh_xy_a, Del2vort_q_a, Ah_a, &
4110 Kh_a, Shear_mag_a, vert_vort_mag_a, hrat_min_a, visc_bound_rem_a)
4111 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields
4112 !! related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
4113 type(hor_visc_VarMix_type), intent(inout) :: VarMix_a !< Variable mixing control structure
4114 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
4115 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
4116 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
4117 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
4118 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
4119 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
4120 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
4121 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
4122 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
4123 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
4124 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
4125 real, intent(in) :: h_neglect !< thickness so small it can be lost in roundoff and so neglected
4126 !! [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4127 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI3 !< Powers of the inverse of pi [nondim]
4128 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI6 !< Powers of the inverse of pi [nondim]
4129 logical, intent(in) :: use_kh_struct !< If true, the MEKE viscosity contributions are shaped with VarMix%BS_struct
4130 logical, intent(in) :: use_MEKE_Ku !< If true, add the Laplacian viscosity derived from MEKE
4131 logical, intent(in) :: rescale_Kh !< If true, the Laplacian viscosity is scaled by the resolution function
4132 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: u_a !< The zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4133 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: v_a !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4134 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4135 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Kh_h_a !< Laplacian viscosity at thickness points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
4136 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grid_Re_Kh_a !< Grid Reynolds number for Laplacian horizontal viscosity
4137 !! at h points [nondim]
4138 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: div_xx_h_a !< horizontal divergence [T-1 ~> s-1]
4139 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_h_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
4140 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
4141 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_u_a !< Thickness interpolated to u points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4142 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_v_a !< Thickness interpolated to v points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4143 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
4144 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
4145 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xx_a !< str_xx is the diagonal term in the stress tensor
4146 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2], but at some points in the
4147 !! code it is not yet layer integrated, so is in
4148 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].
4149 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_h_a !< Magnitude of vorticity gradient at h-points
4150 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
4151 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient at h-points
4152 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
4153 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_h_a !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at h-points
4154 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
4155 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudx_a !< components in the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
4156 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdy_a !< components in the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
4157 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric
4158 !! terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
4159 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
4160 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_a !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
4161 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Kh_a !< Laplacian viscosity (h or q) [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
4162 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Shear_mag_a !< magnitude of the shear (h or q) [T-1 ~> s-1]
4163 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vert_vort_mag_a !< magnitude of the vertical vorticity gradient (h or q)
4164 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
4165 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hrat_min_a !< h_min divided by the thickness at the stress point (h or
4166 !! q) [nondim]
4167 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: visc_bound_rem_a !< fraction of overall viscous bounds that remain to be
4168 !! applied (h or q) [nondim]
4169
4170 ! Local variables
4171 integer :: mode, rc
41721875 type(io_recorder) :: rec
4173 logical :: capture
4174 character(len=80) :: kernel
4175 character(len=100) :: dir
4176 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
4177 type(hor_visc_MEKE_C) :: MEKE_c
4178 type(hor_visc_VarMix_C) :: VarMix_c
4179 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
4180 type(hv_metrics_CS_C) :: metrics_c
4181 type(Box_C) :: bxH_c
4182 type(Box_C) :: bxKh_c
4183 type(Box_C) :: bxHstr_c
4184 logical(c_bool) :: use_kh_struct_c
4185 logical(c_bool) :: use_MEKE_Ku_c
4186 logical(c_bool) :: rescale_Kh_c
4187 type(RealArray_C) :: u_c
4188 type(RealArray_C) :: v_c
4189 type(RealArray_C) :: h_c
4190 type(RealArray_C) :: Kh_h_c
4191 type(RealArray_C) :: grid_Re_Kh_c
4192 type(RealArray_C) :: div_xx_h_c
4193 type(RealArray_C) :: sh_xx_h_c
4194 type(RealArray_C) :: h_u_c
4195 type(RealArray_C) :: h_v_c
4196 type(RealArray_C) :: sh_xx_c
4197 type(RealArray_C) :: str_xx_c
4198 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_vort_mag_h_c
4199 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_vort_mag_h_2d_c
4200 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_div_mag_h_c
4201 type(RealArray_C) :: dudx_c
4202 type(RealArray_C) :: dvdy_c
4203 type(RealArray_C) :: sh_xy_c
4204 type(RealArray_C) :: Del2vort_q_c
4205 type(RealArray_C) :: Ah_c
4206 type(RealArray_C) :: Kh_c
4207 type(RealArray_C) :: Shear_mag_c
4208 type(RealArray_C) :: vert_vort_mag_c
4209 type(RealArray_C) :: hrat_min_c
4210 type(RealArray_C) :: visc_bound_rem_c
4211
42121875 kernel = "hor_visc_h_coeffs_a"
42131875 mode = getenv_mode("HOR_VISC_H_COEFFS_A_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
4214
42150 select case (mode)
4216
4217 case (TIMH_capture)
42180 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
42190 if (capture) then
42200 dir = "capture"
42210 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
42220 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
42230 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
42240 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
42250 call record_hor_visc_MEKE(rec, "_MEKE", MEKE_a, "")
42260 call record_hor_visc_MEKE(rec, "_MEKE", MEKE_a, "_before")
42270 call record_hor_visc_VarMix(rec, "_VarMix", VarMix_a, "")
42280 call record_hor_visc_VarMix(rec, "_VarMix", VarMix_a, "_before")
42290 call record_hv_opts_CS(rec, "_CS", CS)
42300 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "")
42310 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "_before")
42320 call rec%add("_bxH", bxH)
42330 call rec%add("_bxKh", bxKh)
42340 call rec%add("_bxHstr", bxHstr)
42350 call rec%add("_nkblock", nkblock)
42360 call rec%add("_kstart", kstart)
42370 call rec%add("_h_neglect", h_neglect)
42380 call rec%add("_inv_PI3", inv_PI3)
42390 call rec%add("_inv_PI6", inv_PI6)

45360 tmp = CS%KS_coef * hrat_min(i,j,kk) * Ah_Max_xx_KS(i,j)
45370 visc_limit_h(i,j,k) = tmp
45380 visc_limit_h_frac(i,j,k) = Ah(i,j,kk) / (CS%KS_coef * hrat_min(i,j,kk) * Ah_Max_xx_KS(i,j))
45390 if (Ah(i,j,kk) >= tmp) then
45400 visc_limit_h_flag(i,j,k) = 1.
4541 endif
4542 enddo
4543 endif
4544
45451875 if ((CS%do_Ah_h) .or. CS%debug .or. CS%use_Leithy) then
4546 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
45470 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
45480 k = kstart + kk - 1
45490 Ah_h(i,j,k) = Ah(i,j,kk)
4550 enddo
4551 endif
4552
45531875 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
4554 ! Compute Leith+E Kh after bounds have been applied to Ah
4555 ! and after it has been smoothed. Kh = -m_leithy * Ah
4556 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
45570 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
45580 k = kstart + kk - 1
45590 Kh(i,j,kk) = -m_leithy(i,j,kk) * Ah(i,j,kk)
45600 Kh_h(i,j,k) = Kh(i,j,kk)
4561 enddo
4562 endif
4563
45641875 if (CS%do_grid_Re_Ah) then
4565 do concurrent (kk=bxH%idxS(3):bxH%idxE(3), j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), &
45660 i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k, KE, grid_Ah))
45670 k = kstart + kk - 1
45680 KE = 0.125 * (((u(I,j,k) + u(I-1,j,k))**2) + ((v(i,J,k) + v(i,J-1,k))**2))
45690 grid_Ah = max(Ah(i,j,kk), CS%min_grid_Ah)
45700 grid_Re_Ah(i,j,k) = (sqrt(KE) * grid_sp_h3(i,j)) / grid_Ah
4571 enddo
4572 endif
4573
4574 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
457514413125 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k, d_del2u, d_del2v, d_str))
457614182500 k = kstart + kk - 1
457714182500 d_del2u = (IdyCu(I,j) * Del2u(I,j,kk)) - (IdyCu(I-1,j) * Del2u(I-1,j,kk))
457814182500 d_del2v = (IdxCv(i,J) * Del2v(i,J,kk)) - (IdxCv(i,J-1) * Del2v(i,J-1,kk))
457914182500 d_str = Ah(i,j,kk) * ((DY_dxT(i,j) * d_del2u) - (DX_dyT(i,j) * d_del2v))
4580
458114182500 str_xx(i,j,kk) = str_xx(i,j,kk) + d_str
4582
458314182500 if (CS%use_Leithy) str_xx(i,j,kk) = str_xx(i,j,kk) - Kh(i,j,kk) * sh_xx_smooth(i,j,kk)
4584
4585 ! Keep a copy of the biharmonic contribution for backscatter parameterization
458628595625 bhstr_xx(i,j,kk) = d_str * (h(i,j,k) * reduction_xx(i,j))
4587 enddo
4588 endif ! Get biharmonic coefficient at h points and biharmonic part of str_xx
4589
4590 ! Backscatter using MEKE
45911875 if (CS%EY24_EBT_BS) then
4592 call hor_visc_backscatter_h(bxHstr, CS, MEKE_a, VarMix_a, use_kh_struct, nkblock, kstart, visc_limit_h_flag_a, &
45930 sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, BS_coeff_h_a)
4594 endif ! Backscatter
4595
45961875 if (CS%biharmonic) then
4597 ! Gradient of Laplacian, for use in bi-harmonic term
4598 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
459914068125 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
460013839375 dDel2vdx(I,J,kk) = DY_dxBu(I,J)*((Del2v(i+1,J,kk)*IdyCv(i+1,J)) - (Del2v(i,J,kk)*IdyCv(i,J)))
460127907500 dDel2udy(I,J,kk) = DX_dyBu(I,J)*((Del2u(I,j+1,kk)*IdxCu(I,j+1)) - (Del2u(I,j,kk)*IdxCu(I,j)))
4602 enddo
4603 ! Adjust contributions to shearing strain on open boundaries.
46041875 if (apply_OBC) then ; if ((OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_ZERO) .or. &
4605 (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_FREESLIP)) then
46060 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
46070 J = OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB ; I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB
46080 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_N_or_S .and. (J >= js-1) .and. (J <= Jeq)) then
46090 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, I=OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB:OBC%segment(n)%HI%IedB)
46100 if (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_ZERO) then
46110 dDel2vdx(I,J,kk) = 0. ; dDel2udy(I,J,kk) = 0.
46120 elseif (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_FREESLIP) then
46130 dDel2udy(I,J,kk) = 0.
4614 endif
4615 enddo
46160 elseif (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W .and. (I >= is-1) .and. (I <= Ieq)) then
46170 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, J=OBC%segment(n)%HI%JsdB:OBC%segment(n)%HI%JedB)
46180 if (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_ZERO) then
46190 dDel2vdx(I,J,kk) = 0. ; dDel2udy(I,J,kk) = 0.
46200 elseif (OBC%strain_config == OBC_STRAIN_FREESLIP) then
46210 dDel2vdx(I,J,kk) = 0.
4622 endif
4623 enddo
4624 endif
4625 enddo
4626 endif ; endif
4627 endif
4628
46291875 if ((CS%Smagorinsky_Kh) .or. (CS%Smagorinsky_Ah)) then
4630 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
463114068125 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(sh_xy_sq, sh_xx_sq))
463213839375 sh_xy_sq = sh_xy(I,J,kk)**2
4633 sh_xx_sq = 0.25 * ( ((sh_xx(i,j,kk)**2) + (sh_xx(i+1,j+1,kk)**2)) &
463413839375 + ((sh_xx(i,j+1,kk)**2) + (sh_xx(i+1,j,kk)**2)) )
463527907500 Shear_mag(I,J,kk) = sqrt(sh_xy_sq + sh_xx_sq)
4636 enddo
4637 endif
4638
4639 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
464014068125 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(h2uq, h2vq))
464113839375 h2uq = 4.0 * (h_u(I,j,kk) * h_u(I,j+1,kk))
464213839375 h2vq = 4.0 * (h_v(i,J,kk) * h_v(i+1,J,kk))
4643 hq(I,J,kk) = (2.0 * (h2uq * h2vq)) &
464427907500 / (h_neglect3 + (h2uq + h2vq) * ((h_u(I,j,kk) + h_u(I,j+1,kk)) + (h_v(i,J,kk) + h_v(i+1,J,kk))))
4645 enddo
4646
46471875 if (CS%bound_Ah .or. CS%bound_Kh) then
4648 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
464914068125 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(h_min))
465013839375 h_min = min(h_u(I,j,kk), h_u(I,j+1,kk), h_v(i,J,kk), h_v(i+1,J,kk))
465127907500 hrat_min(I,J,kk) = min(1.0, h_min / (hq(I,J,kk) + h_neglect))
4652 enddo
4653
4654 endif
4655
4656 ! TODO: GPU?? Are h_[uv] on CPU? update to hrat_min?
46571875 if (CS%no_slip) then
4658 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
46590 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(hu, hv))
46600 if (CS%no_slip .and. (mask2dBu(I,J) < 0.5)) then
46610 if ((mask2dCu(I,j) + mask2dCu(I,j+1)) + &
4662 (mask2dCv(i,J) + mask2dCv(i+1,J)) > 0.0) then
4663 ! This is a coastal vorticity point, so modify hq and hrat_min.
4664
46650 hu = mask2dCu(I,j) * h_u(I,j,kk) + mask2dCu(I,j+1) * h_u(I,j+1,kk)
46660 hv = mask2dCv(i,J) * h_v(i,J,kk) + mask2dCv(i+1,J) * h_v(i+1,J,kk)
46670 if ((mask2dCu(I,j) + mask2dCu(I,j+1)) * &
4668 (mask2dCv(i,J) + mask2dCv(i+1,J)) == 0.0) then
4669 ! Only one of hu and hv is nonzero, so just add them.
46700 hq(I,J,kk) = hu + hv
46710 hrat_min(I,J,kk) = 1.0
4672 else
4673 ! Both hu and hv are nonzero, so take the harmonic mean.
46740 hq(I,J,kk) = 2.0 * (hu * hv) / ((hu + hv) + h_neglect)
46750 hrat_min(I,J,kk) = min(1.0, min(hu, hv) / (hq(I,J,kk) + h_neglect) )
4676 endif
4677 endif
4678 endif
4679 enddo
4680 endif
4681
46821875end subroutine hor_visc_h_coeffs_b_fortran
4683
4684!> Dispatches hor_visc_h_coeffs_b to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
4685!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by HOR_VISC_H_COEFFS_B_MODE.
46861875subroutine hor_visc_h_coeffs_b(MEKE_a, VarMix_a, Gcore, CS, metrics, OBC, bxH, bxQ, bxKh, bxHstr, bxQstr, nkblock, &
4687 kstart, h_neglect, h_neglect3, apply_OBC, use_kh_struct, use_MEKE_Au, u_a, v_a, h_a, &
4688 Ah_h_a, Kh_h_a, grid_Re_Ah_a, visc_limit_h_a, visc_limit_h_flag_a, visc_limit_h_frac_a, &
4689 BS_coeff_h_a, Del2u_a, h_u_a, Del2v_a, h_v_a, sh_xx_a, sh_xx_smooth_a, str_xx_a, &
4690 bhstr_xx_a, m_leithy_a, dDel2vdx_a, dDel2udy_a, sh_xy_a, hq_a, Ah_a, Kh_a, Shear_mag_a, &
4691 hrat_min_a, visc_bound_rem_a)
4692 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields
4693 !! related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
4694 type(hor_visc_VarMix_type), intent(inout) :: VarMix_a !< Variable mixing control structure
4695 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
4696 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
4697 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
4698 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
4699 type(ocean_OBC_type), optional, pointer :: OBC !< Pointer to an open boundary condition type
4700 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
4701 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
4702 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ !< The B-grid-index iteration box of this
4703 !! tile, [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
4704 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
4705 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
4706 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
4707 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
4708 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
4709 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
4710 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
4711 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
4712 real, intent(in) :: h_neglect !< thickness so small it can be lost in roundoff and so neglected
4713 !! [H ~> m or kg m-2]
4714 real, intent(in) :: h_neglect3 !< h_neglect^3 [H3 ~> m3 or kg3 m-6]
4715 logical, intent(in) :: apply_OBC !< If true, open boundary conditions are applied on this PE

4717 logical, intent(in) :: use_MEKE_Au !< If true, add the biharmonic viscosity derived from MEKE
4718 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: u_a !< The zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4719 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: v_a !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
4720 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4721 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_h_a !< biharmonic viscosity at thickness points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
4722 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Kh_h_a !< Laplacian viscosity at thickness points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
4723 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grid_Re_Ah_a !< Grid Reynolds number for Biharmonic horizontal viscosity
4724 !! at h points [nondim]
4725 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: visc_limit_h_a !< Used to stabilize the EY24_EBT_BS backscatter [nondim]
4726 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: visc_limit_h_flag_a !< determines whether backscatter is shut off
4727 !! [nondim]

4729 !! off [nondim]
4730 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: BS_coeff_h_a !< A diagnostic array of the backscatter coefficient
4731 !! [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
4732 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2u_a !< The u-component of the Laplacian of velocity
4733 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
4734 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_u_a !< Thickness interpolated to u points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4735 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2v_a !< The v-component of the Laplacian of velocity
4736 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
4737 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_v_a !< Thickness interpolated to v points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
4738 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
4739 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
4740 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_smooth_a !< horizontal tension from smoothed velocity including
4741 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]

4743 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2], but at some points in the

4745 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].

4747 !! contribution [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
