4749 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dDel2vdx_a !< Components in the biharmonic equivalent of the shearing
4750 !! strain [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
4751 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dDel2udy_a !< Components in the biharmonic equivalent of the shearing
4752 !! strain [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
4753 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric
4754 !! terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
4755 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hq_a !< harmonic mean of the harmonic means of the u- & v point
4756 !! thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2] This form guarantees that hq/hu <
4757 !! 4.
4758 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_a !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
4759 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Kh_a !< Laplacian viscosity (h or q) [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
4760 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Shear_mag_a !< magnitude of the shear (h or q) [T-1 ~> s-1]
4761 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hrat_min_a !< h_min divided by the thickness at the stress point (h or
4762 !! q) [nondim]
4763 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: visc_bound_rem_a !< fraction of overall viscous bounds that remain to be
4764 !! applied (h or q) [nondim]

4789 type(RealArray_C) :: Kh_h_c

4798 type(RealArray_C) :: h_v_c

5494
54950 if ((CS%do_GME_coeff_h) .or. find_FrictWork) GME_coeff_h(i,j,k) = GME_coeff
54960 str_xx_GME(i,j,kk) = GME_coeff * sh_xx_bt(i,j)
5497 enddo
5498
5499 ! The wider halo here is to permit one pass of smoothing without a halo update.
5500 do concurrent (kk=bxQshear%idxS(3):bxQshear%idxE(3), J=bxQshear%idxS(2):bxQshear%idxE(2), &
55010 I=bxQshear%idxS(1):bxQshear%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k, GME_coeff))
55020 k = kstart + kk - 1
5503 GME_coeff = GME_effic_q(I,J) * 0.25 * &
55040 ((KH_u_GME(I,j,k)+KH_u_GME(I,j+1,k)) + (KH_v_GME(i,J,k)+KH_v_GME(i+1,J,k)))
55050 GME_coeff = MIN(GME_coeff, CS%GME_limiter)
5506
55070 if (CS%do_GME_coeff_q) GME_coeff_q(I,J,k) = GME_coeff
55080 str_xy_GME(I,J,kk) = GME_coeff * sh_xy_bt(I,J)
5509 enddo
5510 endif
5511
55121875end subroutine hor_visc_q_coeffs_fortran

5529 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels

5531 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays

5541 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI6 !< Powers of the inverse of pi [nondim]
5542 logical, intent(in) :: find_FrictWork !< If true, the work done by lateral friction is calculated
5543 logical, intent(in) :: use_kh_struct !< If true, the MEKE viscosity contributions are shaped with VarMix%BS_struct
5544 logical, intent(in) :: use_MEKE_Ku !< If true, add the Laplacian viscosity derived from MEKE
5545 logical, intent(in) :: use_MEKE_Au !< If true, add the biharmonic viscosity derived from MEKE
5546 logical, intent(in) :: rescale_Kh !< If true, the Laplacian viscosity is scaled by the resolution function

5559 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: KH_v_GME_a !< Isopycnal height diffusivities in v-columns

5562 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_coeff_q_a !< GME coeff. at q-points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]

5564 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]

5566 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
5567 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_h_a !< biharmonic viscosity at thickness points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
5568 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_q_a !< biharmonic viscosity at corner points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
5569 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Kh_h_a !< Laplacian viscosity at thickness points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
5570 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Kh_q_a !< Laplacian viscosity at corner points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]

5572 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_q_a !< horizontal shearing strain at corner points [T-1 ~> s-1]

5578 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: BS_coeff_q_a !< A diagnostic array of the backscatter coefficient
5579 !! [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
5580 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
5581 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]

5586 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dDel2vdx_a !< Components in the biharmonic equivalent of the shearing

5588 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dDel2udy_a !< Components in the biharmonic equivalent of the shearing
5589 !! strain [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
5590 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric
5591 !! terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
5592 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_smooth_a !< horizontal shearing strain from smoothed velocity
5593 !! including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
5594 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xy_a !< str_xy is the cross term in the stress tensor
5595 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2], but at some points in the
5596 !! code it is not yet layer integrated, so is in
5597 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].
5598 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: bhstr_xy_a !< A copy of str_xy that only contains the biharmonic
5599 !! contribution [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
5600 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_a !< Vertical vorticity (dv/dx - du/dy) including metric terms
5601 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
5602 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q_a !< Magnitude of vorticity gradient at q-points
5603 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
5604 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q_2d_a !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient at q-points
5605 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
5606 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
5607 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_q_a !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at q-points
5608 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
5609 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hq_a !< harmonic mean of the harmonic means of the u- & v point

5611 !! 4.

5614 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Shear_mag_a !< magnitude of the shear (h or q) [T-1 ~> s-1]
5615 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vert_vort_mag_a !< magnitude of the vertical vorticity gradient (h or q)
5616 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
5617 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hrat_min_a !< h_min divided by the thickness at the stress point (h or
5618 !! q) [nondim]

5896!> Converts the stresses to layer-integrated form, takes their divergence to get the
5897!! viscous accelerations, and accumulates the frictional work for one tile of
5898!! horizontal_viscosity.
58991875subroutine hor_visc_stress_div_fortran(MEKE_a, Gcore, CS, metrics, OBC, STOCH_a, bxH, bxU, bxV, bxHstr, bxQstr, &
5900 nkblock, kstart, h_neglect, apply_OBC, find_FrictWork, find_FrictWork_bh, &
5901 backscat_subround, skeb_use_frict, u_a, v_a, h_a, uh_a, vh_a, diffu_a, diffv_a, &
5902 str_xx_GME_a, str_xy_GME_a, FrictWork_a, FrictWork_bh_a, FrictWork_GME_a, &
5903 visc_limit_h_flag_a, h_u_a, h_v_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, bhstr_xx_a, sh_xy_a, &
5904 str_xy_a, bhstr_xy_a, hq_a, H_to_RZ, s_to_T)
5905 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields
5906 !! related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
5907 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
5908 real, intent(in) :: H_to_RZ !< A constant that translates thickness units to the units
5909 !! of mass per unit area [R Z H-1 ~> kg m-3 or 1]
5910 real, intent(in) :: s_to_T !< A constant that translates time intervals in seconds to
5911 !! the units of time [T s-1 ~> 1]
5912 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
5913 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
5914 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
5915 type(ocean_OBC_type), optional, pointer :: OBC !< Pointer to an open boundary condition type
5916 type(hor_visc_STOCH_type), intent(inout) :: STOCH_a !< Stochastic control structure
5917 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
5918 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
5919 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxU !< The u-point iteration box of this tile,
5920 !! [IscB:IecB, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
5921 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxV !< The v-point iteration box of this tile,
5922 !! [isc:iec, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
5923 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
5924 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
5925 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
5926 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
5927 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
5928 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
5929 real, intent(in) :: h_neglect !< thickness so small it can be lost in roundoff and so neglected
5930 !! [H ~> m or kg m-2]
5931 logical, intent(in) :: apply_OBC !< If true, open boundary conditions are applied on this PE
5932 logical, intent(in) :: find_FrictWork !< If true, the work done by lateral friction is calculated
5933 logical, intent(in) :: find_FrictWork_bh !< If true, the work done by biharmonic lateral friction is calculated
5934 real, intent(in) :: backscat_subround !< The ratio of f over Shear_mag that is so small that the backscatter
5935 !! calculation gives the same value as if f were 0 [nondim].
5936 logical, intent(in) :: skeb_use_frict !< If true, accumulate the frictional dissipation for stochastic backscatter
5937 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: u_a !< The zonal velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
5938 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: v_a !< The meridional velocity [L T-1 ~> m s-1].
5939 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5940 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: uh_a !< The zonal volume transport [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1].
5941 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vh_a !< The meridional volume transport [H L2 T-1 ~> m3 s-1].
5942 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: diffu_a !< Zonal acceleration due to convergence of along-coordinate
5943 !! stress tensor [L T-2 ~> m s-2]
5944 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: diffv_a !< Meridional acceleration due to convergence of
5945 !! along-coordinate stress tensor [L T-2 ~> m s-2].
5946 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xx_GME_a !< smoothed diagonal term in the stress tensor from GME
5947 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
5948 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xy_GME_a !< smoothed cross term in the stress tensor from GME
5949 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
5950 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: FrictWork_a !< work done by MKE dissipation mechanisms
5951 !! [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2]
5952 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: FrictWork_bh_a !< work done by the biharmonic MKE dissipation mechanisms
5953 !! [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2]
5954 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: FrictWork_GME_a !< work done by GME [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2]
5955 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: visc_limit_h_flag_a !< determines whether backscatter is shut off
5956 !! [nondim]
5957 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_u_a !< Thickness interpolated to u points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5958 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_v_a !< Thickness interpolated to v points [H ~> m or kg m-2].
5959 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
5960 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
5961 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xx_a !< str_xx is the diagonal term in the stress tensor
5962 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2], but at some points in the
5963 !! code it is not yet layer integrated, so is in
5964 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].
5965 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: bhstr_xx_a !< A copy of str_xx that only contains the biharmonic
5966 !! contribution [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
5967 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric
5968 !! terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
5969 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xy_a !< str_xy is the cross term in the stress tensor
5970 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2], but at some points in the
5971 !! code it is not yet layer integrated, so is in
5972 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2].
5973 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: bhstr_xy_a !< A copy of str_xy that only contains the biharmonic
5974 !! contribution [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
5975 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: hq_a !< harmonic mean of the harmonic means of the u- & v point
5976 !! thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2] This form guarantees that hq/hu <
5977 !! 4.
5978
5979 ! Local variables
59801875 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: hq, bhstr_xy, str_xy, sh_xy, bhstr_xx, str_xx, &
59811875 sh_xx, h_v, h_u, visc_limit_h_flag, FrictWork_GME, FrictWork_bh, FrictWork, str_xy_GME, &
59821875 str_xx_GME, diffv, diffu, vh, uh, h, v, u
59831875 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: mask2dBu, IdxCu, IdyCu, IareaCu, IdyCv, IdxCv, &
59841875 IareaCv, IdxT, IdyT, IdyBu, IdxBu, IareaT, dxCu, dyCv, CoriolisBu
59851875 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: reduction_xx, reduction_xy, dx2h, dy2h, dx2q, dy2q
59861875 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: MEKE_mom_src, MEKE_mom_src_bh, MEKE_GME_snk
59871875 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: skeb_diss
5988 real :: Shear_mag_bc ! Shear_mag value in backscatter [T-1 ~> s-1]
5989 real :: RoScl ! The scaling function for MEKE source term [nondim]
5990 real :: FatH ! abs(f) at h-point for MEKE source term [T-1 ~> s-1]
5991 real :: Sh_F_pow ! The ratio of shear over the absolute value of f raised to some power and rescaled [nondim]
5992 integer :: i, j, k, kk, n, kmax
5993
59941875 call hq_a%view(hq) ; call bhstr_xy_a%view(bhstr_xy) ; call str_xy_a%view(str_xy)
59951875 call sh_xy_a%view(sh_xy) ; call bhstr_xx_a%view(bhstr_xx) ; call str_xx_a%view(str_xx)
59961875 call sh_xx_a%view(sh_xx) ; call h_v_a%view(h_v) ; call h_u_a%view(h_u)
59971875 call visc_limit_h_flag_a%view(visc_limit_h_flag) ; call FrictWork_GME_a%view(FrictWork_GME)
59981875 call FrictWork_bh_a%view(FrictWork_bh) ; call FrictWork_a%view(FrictWork)
59991875 call str_xy_GME_a%view(str_xy_GME) ; call str_xx_GME_a%view(str_xx_GME)
60001875 call diffv_a%view(diffv) ; call diffu_a%view(diffu) ; call vh_a%view(vh) ; call uh_a%view(uh)
60011875 call h_a%view(h) ; call v_a%view(v) ; call u_a%view(u)
60021875 call Gcore%mask2dBu%view(mask2dBu) ; call Gcore%IdxCu%view(IdxCu) ; call Gcore%IdyCu%view(IdyCu)
60031875 call Gcore%IareaCu%view(IareaCu) ; call Gcore%IdyCv%view(IdyCv) ; call Gcore%IdxCv%view(IdxCv)
60041875 call Gcore%IareaCv%view(IareaCv) ; call Gcore%IdxT%view(IdxT) ; call Gcore%IdyT%view(IdyT)
60051875 call Gcore%IdyBu%view(IdyBu) ; call Gcore%IdxBu%view(IdxBu) ; call Gcore%IareaT%view(IareaT)
60061875 call Gcore%dxCu%view(dxCu) ; call Gcore%dyCv%view(dyCv) ; call Gcore%CoriolisBu%view(CoriolisBu)
6007
60081875 nullify(reduction_xx, reduction_xy, dx2h, dy2h, dx2q, dy2q)
60091875 if (metrics%reduction_xx%associated()) call metrics%reduction_xx%view(reduction_xx)
60101875 if (metrics%reduction_xy%associated()) call metrics%reduction_xy%view(reduction_xy)
60111875 if (metrics%dx2h%associated()) call metrics%dx2h%view(dx2h)
60121875 if (metrics%dy2h%associated()) call metrics%dy2h%view(dy2h)
60131875 if (metrics%dx2q%associated()) call metrics%dx2q%view(dx2q)
60141875 if (metrics%dy2q%associated()) call metrics%dy2q%view(dy2q)
6015
60161875 nullify(MEKE_mom_src, MEKE_mom_src_bh, MEKE_GME_snk, skeb_diss)
60171875 if (MEKE_a%mom_src_a%associated()) call MEKE_a%mom_src_a%view(MEKE_mom_src)
60181875 if (MEKE_a%mom_src_bh_a%associated()) call MEKE_a%mom_src_bh_a%view(MEKE_mom_src_bh)
60191875 if (MEKE_a%GME_snk_a%associated()) call MEKE_a%GME_snk_a%view(MEKE_GME_snk)
60201875 if (STOCH_a%skeb_diss_a%associated()) call STOCH_a%skeb_diss_a%view(skeb_diss)
6021
60221875 kmax = bxH%idxE(3) - bxH%idxS(3) + 1
6023
60241875 if (CS%use_GME) then
6025
6026 ! This changes the units of str_xx from [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2] to [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2].
6027 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
60280 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
60290 k = kstart + kk - 1
60300 str_xx(i,j,kk) = (str_xx(i,j,kk) + str_xx_GME(i,j,kk)) * (h(i,j,k) * reduction_xx(i,j))
6031 enddo
6032
6033 ! This adds in GME and changes the units of str_xx from [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2] to [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2].
60340 if (CS%no_slip) then
6035 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
60360 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
60370 str_xy(I,J,kk) = (str_xy(I,J,kk) + str_xy_GME(I,J,kk)) * (hq(I,J,kk) * reduction_xy(I,J))
6038 enddo
6039 else
6040 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
60410 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
60420 str_xy(I,J,kk) = (str_xy(I,J,kk) + str_xy_GME(I,J,kk)) * (hq(I,J,kk) * mask2dBu(I,J) * reduction_xy(I,J))
6043 enddo
6044 endif
6045 else ! .not. use_GME
6046 ! This changes the units of str_xx from [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2] to [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2].
6047 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
604814413125 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
604914182500 k = kstart + kk - 1
605028595625 str_xx(i,j,kk) = str_xx(i,j,kk) * (h(i,j,k) * reduction_xx(i,j))
6051 enddo
6052
6053 ! This changes the units of str_xy from [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2] to [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2].
60541875 if (CS%no_slip) then
6055 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
60560 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
60570 str_xy(I,J,kk) = str_xy(I,J,kk) * (hq(I,J,kk) * reduction_xy(I,J))
6058 enddo
6059 else
6060 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
606114068125 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
606227907500 str_xy(I,J,kk) = str_xy(I,J,kk) * (hq(I,J,kk) * mask2dBu(I,J) * reduction_xy(I,J))
6063 enddo
6064 endif
6065 endif ! use_GME
6066
6067 ! Evaluate 1/h x.Div(h Grad u) or the biharmonic equivalent.
606813841250 do concurrent (kk=bxU%idxS(3):bxU%idxE(3), j=bxU%idxS(2):bxU%idxE(2), I=bxU%idxS(1):bxU%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
606913612500 k = kstart + kk - 1
6070 diffu(I,j,k) = ((IdxCu(I,j)*((dx2q(I,J-1)*str_xy(I,J-1,kk)) - (dx2q(I,J)*str_xy(I,J,kk))) + &
6071 IdyCu(I,j)*((dy2h(i,j)*str_xx(i,j,kk)) - (dy2h(i+1,j)*str_xx(i+1,j,kk)))) * &
607227453750 IareaCu(I,j)) / (h_u(I,j,kk) + h_neglect)
6073 enddo
6074
60751875 if (apply_OBC) then
6076 ! This is not the right boundary condition. If all the masking of tendencies are done
6077 ! correctly later then eliminating this block should not change answers.
60780 do n=1,OBC%number_of_segments
60790 if (OBC%segment(n)%is_E_or_W) then
60800 I = OBC%segment(n)%HI%IsdB
60810 do concurrent (kk=1:kmax, j=OBC%segment(n)%HI%jsd:OBC%segment(n)%HI%jed) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
60820 k = kstart + kk - 1
60830 diffu(I,j,k) = 0.
6084 enddo
6085 endif
6086 enddo
6087 endif
6088
6089 ! Evaluate 1/h y.Div(h Grad u) or the biharmonic equivalent.

6348
63490 MEKE_mom_src(i,j) = MEKE_mom_src(i,j) + (FrictWork(i,j,k) - RoScl*FrictWork_bh(i,j,k))
6350
63510 if (MEKE_a%mom_src_bh_a%associated()) &
6352 MEKE_mom_src_bh(i,j) = MEKE_mom_src_bh(i,j) &
63530 + (FrictWork_bh(i,j,k) - RoScl * FrictWork_bh(i,j,k))
6354 enddo ; enddo
6355 else
63560 do concurrent (j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(kk, k))
63570 do kk=1,kmax
63580 k = kstart + kk - 1
63590 MEKE_mom_src(i,j) = MEKE_mom_src(i,j) + FrictWork(i,j,k)
6360 enddo ; enddo
6361
63620 if (MEKE_a%mom_src_bh_a%associated()) then
63630 do concurrent (j=bxH%idxS(2):bxH%idxE(2), i=bxH%idxS(1):bxH%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(kk, k))
63640 do kk=1,kmax
63650 k = kstart + kk - 1
63660 MEKE_mom_src_bh(i,j) = MEKE_mom_src_bh(i,j) + FrictWork_bh(i,j,k)
6367 enddo ; enddo
6368 endif
6369 endif ! MEKE_a%backscatter_Ro_c
6370
6371 endif ! find_FrictWork and associated(mom_src)
6372
63731875end subroutine hor_visc_stress_div_fortran

63771875subroutine hor_visc_stress_div(MEKE_a, Gcore, CS, metrics, OBC, STOCH_a, bxH, bxU, bxV, bxHstr, bxQstr, nkblock, &
6378 kstart, h_neglect, apply_OBC, find_FrictWork, find_FrictWork_bh, backscat_subround, &
6379 skeb_use_frict, u_a, v_a, h_a, uh_a, vh_a, diffu_a, diffv_a, str_xx_GME_a, &
6380 str_xy_GME_a, FrictWork_a, FrictWork_bh_a, FrictWork_GME_a, visc_limit_h_flag_a, h_u_a, &
6381 h_v_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, bhstr_xx_a, sh_xy_a, str_xy_a, bhstr_xy_a, hq_a, H_to_RZ, &
6382 s_to_T)
6383 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields
6384 !! related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
6385 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields

6387 !! of mass per unit area [R Z H-1 ~> kg m-3 or 1]
6388 real, intent(in) :: s_to_T !< A constant that translates time intervals in seconds to
6389 !! the units of time [T s-1 ~> 1]
6390 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
6391 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
6392 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
6393 type(ocean_OBC_type), optional, pointer :: OBC !< Pointer to an open boundary condition type
6394 type(hor_visc_STOCH_type), intent(inout) :: STOCH_a !< Stochastic control structure

6396 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
6397 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxU !< The u-point iteration box of this tile,
6398 !! [IscB:IecB, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]

6400 !! [isc:iec, JscB:JecB, 1:kmax]
6401 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
6402 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
6403 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
6404 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]

6406 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
6407 real, intent(in) :: h_neglect !< thickness so small it can be lost in roundoff and so neglected
6408 !! [H ~> m or kg m-2]
6409 logical, intent(in) :: apply_OBC !< If true, open boundary conditions are applied on this PE
6410 logical, intent(in) :: find_FrictWork !< If true, the work done by lateral friction is calculated
6411 logical, intent(in) :: find_FrictWork_bh !< If true, the work done by biharmonic lateral friction is calculated
6412 real, intent(in) :: backscat_subround !< The ratio of f over Shear_mag that is so small that the backscatter

6420 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: diffu_a !< Zonal acceleration due to convergence of along-coordinate

6423 !! along-coordinate stress tensor [L T-2 ~> m s-2].

6427 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
6428 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: FrictWork_a !< work done by MKE dissipation mechanisms
6429 !! [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2]
6430 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: FrictWork_bh_a !< work done by the biharmonic MKE dissipation mechanisms
6431 !! [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2]
6432 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: FrictWork_GME_a !< work done by GME [R Z L2 T-3 ~> W m-2]

6444 !! contribution [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]

6454 !! thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2] This form guarantees that hq/hu <

6674!> Calculates the magnitude of the vorticity and divergence gradients, and the
6675!! Laplacian of vorticity, that are used within horizontal_viscosity by the Leith,
6676!! modified Leith, Leith+E, and QG Leith viscosity schemes. The caller must only
6677!! invoke this routine when CS%Leith_Kh, CS%Leith_Ah, or CS%use_Leithy is true.
66780subroutine hor_visc_Leith_grad_a_fortran(bxH, bxKh, bxKh_i, bxKh_j, bxQstr, bxQvsmooth, Gcore, CS, nkblock, dudx_a, &
6679 dvdy_a, vort_xy_a, vort_xy_smooth_a, grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a, grad_div_mag_h_a, &
6680 grad_vort_mag_q_2d_a, grad_div_mag_q_a, Del2vort_q_a, vort_xy_dx_a, &
6681 vort_xy_dx_smooth_a, div_xx_dy_a, vort_xy_dy_a, vort_xy_dy_smooth_a, &
6682 div_xx_dx_a)
6683 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
6684 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
6685 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
6686 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
6687 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh_i !< The thickness-point viscosity range in i
6688 !! only, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
6689 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh_j !< The thickness-point viscosity range in j
6690 !! only, [isc:iec, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
6691 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
6692 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
6693 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQvsmooth !< The q points of this tile where the smoothed vorticity
6694 !! terms are computed,
6695 !! [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh, js_Kh-1:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
6696 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
6697 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
6698 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
6699 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: dudx_a !< x-derivative of the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
6700 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: dvdy_a !< y-derivative of the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
6701 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_a !< Vertical vorticity (dv/dx - du/dy) including
6702 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
6703 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_smooth_a !< Vertical vorticity including metric
6704 !! terms, smoothed [T-1 ~> s-1]
6705 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient
6706 !! at h-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6707 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_h_a !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at
6708 !! h-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6709 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q_2d_a !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient
6710 !! at q-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6711 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_q_a !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at
6712 !! q-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6713 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points
6714 !! [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
6715 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_a !< x-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dx(dv/dx - du/dy))
6716 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6717 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_smooth_a !< x-derivative of smoothed vertical vorticity
6718 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6719 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: div_xx_dy_a !< y-derivative of horizontal divergence (d/dy(du/dx +
6720 !! dv/dy)) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6721 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_a !< y-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dy(dv/dx - du/dy))
6722 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6723 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_smooth_a !< y-derivative of smoothed vertical vorticity
6724 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6725 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: div_xx_dx_a !< x-derivative of horizontal divergence (d/dx(du/dx +
6726 !! dv/dy)) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6727 ! Local variables
67280 type(Box_t) :: bxHdiv ! h points [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh+1, js_Kh-1:je_Kh+1] where div_xx is computed: the divergence gradients
6729 ! at u and v points difference it
67300 type(Box_t) :: bxVvortdx ! v points [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh+1, js-2:je+1] where vort_xy_dx is computed: the gradient magnitudes
6731 ! over bxKh and over the q points read it on both sides
67320 type(Box_t) :: bxUdivdx ! u points [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh, js-1:je+1] where div_xx_dx is computed: the gradient magnitudes
6733 ! over bxKh and bxQstr read it on both sides
67340 type(Box_t) :: bxUvortdy ! u points [is-2:ie+1, js_Kh-1:je_Kh+1] where vort_xy_dy is computed: the gradient magnitudes
6735 ! over bxKh and over the q points read it on both sides
67360 type(Box_t) :: bxVdivdy ! v points [is-1:ie+1, js_Kh-1:je_Kh] where div_xx_dy is computed: the gradient magnitudes
6737 ! over bxKh and bxQstr read it on both sides
67380 type(Box_t) :: bxUvortdysm ! u points [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh] where vort_xy_dy_smooth is computed:
6739 ! hor_visc_Leith_grad_b reads it on both sides of each bxKh point in i
67400 type(Box_t) :: bxVvortdxsm ! v points [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh-1:je_Kh] where vort_xy_dx_smooth is computed:
6741 ! hor_visc_Leith_grad_b reads it on both sides of each bxKh point in j
67420 type(Box_t) :: bxUbeta ! u points [is-2:ie+1, js-1:je+1] where beta is added to vort_xy_dy; built from bxH because
6743 ! this range does not follow the option-dependent halo of bxKh
67440 type(Box_t) :: bxVbeta ! v points [is-1:ie+1, js-2:je+1] where beta is added to vort_xy_dx; built from bxH because
6745 ! this range does not follow the option-dependent halo of bxKh
67460 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: div_xx_dx, vort_xy_dy_smooth, vort_xy_dy, &
67470 div_xx_dy, vort_xy_dx_smooth, vort_xy_dx, Del2vort_q, grad_div_mag_q, grad_vort_mag_q_2d, &
67480 grad_div_mag_h, grad_vort_mag_h_2d, vort_xy_smooth, vort_xy, dvdy, dudx
67490 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: dyBu, IdxBu, IdyCu, dxBu, IdyBu, IdxCv, IdyCv, &
67500 IdxCu, dF_dx, dF_dy
6751 real, dimension(dudx_a%lb(1):dudx_a%ub(1),dudx_a%lb(2):dudx_a%ub(2),nkblock) :: &
67520 div_xx ! Estimate of horizontal divergence at h-points [T-1 ~> s-1]
6753 real :: DY_dxBu ! Ratio of meridional over zonal grid spacing at vertices [nondim]
6754 real :: DX_dyBu ! Ratio of zonal over meridional grid spacing at vertices [nondim]
6755 integer :: i, j, kk
6756
67570 call div_xx_dx_a%view(div_xx_dx) ; call vort_xy_dy_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_dy_smooth)
67580 call vort_xy_dy_a%view(vort_xy_dy) ; call div_xx_dy_a%view(div_xx_dy)
67590 call vort_xy_dx_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_dx_smooth) ; call vort_xy_dx_a%view(vort_xy_dx)
67600 call Del2vort_q_a%view(Del2vort_q) ; call grad_div_mag_q_a%view(grad_div_mag_q)
67610 call grad_vort_mag_q_2d_a%view(grad_vort_mag_q_2d) ; call grad_div_mag_h_a%view(grad_div_mag_h)
67620 call grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a%view(grad_vort_mag_h_2d) ; call vort_xy_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_smooth)
67630 call vort_xy_a%view(vort_xy) ; call dvdy_a%view(dvdy) ; call dudx_a%view(dudx)
67640 bxHdiv = bxKh%growBy(lo=[1,1,0], hi=[1,1,0])
67650 bxVvortdx = bxKh_i%growBy(lo=[1,2,0], hi=[1,1,0])
67660 bxUdivdx = bxKh_i%growBy(lo=[1,1,0], hi=[0,1,0])
67670 bxUvortdy = bxKh_j%growBy(lo=[2,1,0], hi=[1,1,0])
67680 bxVdivdy = bxKh_j%growBy(lo=[1,1,0], hi=[1,0,0])
67690 bxUvortdysm = bxKh%growBy(lo=[1,0,0], hi=[0,0,0])
67700 bxVvortdxsm = bxKh%growBy(lo=[0,1,0], hi=[0,0,0])
67710 bxUbeta = bxH%growBy(lo=[2,1,0], hi=[1,1,0])
67720 bxVbeta = bxH%growBy(lo=[1,2,0], hi=[1,1,0])
67730 call Gcore%dyBu%view(dyBu) ; call Gcore%IdxBu%view(IdxBu) ; call Gcore%IdyCu%view(IdyCu)
67740 call Gcore%dxBu%view(dxBu) ; call Gcore%IdyBu%view(IdyBu) ; call Gcore%IdxCv%view(IdxCv)
67750 call Gcore%IdyCv%view(IdyCv) ; call Gcore%IdxCu%view(IdxCu) ; call Gcore%dF_dx%view(dF_dx)
67760 call Gcore%dF_dy%view(dF_dy)
6777
6778 ! Vorticity gradient
6779 do concurrent (kk=bxVvortdx%idxS(3):bxVvortdx%idxE(3), &
6780 J=bxVvortdx%idxS(2):bxVvortdx%idxE(2), &
67810 i=bxVvortdx%idxS(1):bxVvortdx%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(DY_dxBu))
67820 DY_dxBu = dyBu(I,J) * IdxBu(I,J)
67830 vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) = DY_dxBu * ((vort_xy(I,J,kk) * IdyCu(I,j)) - (vort_xy(I-1,J,kk) * IdyCu(I-1,j)))
6784 enddo
6785
6786 do concurrent (kk=bxUvortdy%idxS(3):bxUvortdy%idxE(3), &
6787 j=bxUvortdy%idxS(2):bxUvortdy%idxE(2), &
67880 I=bxUvortdy%idxS(1):bxUvortdy%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(DX_dyBu))
67890 DX_dyBu = dxBu(I,J) * IdyBu(I,J)
67900 vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) = DX_dyBu * ((vort_xy(I,J,kk) * IdxCv(i,J)) - (vort_xy(I,J-1,kk) * IdxCv(i,J-1)))
6791 enddo
6792
67930 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
6794 ! Gradient of smoothed vorticity
6795 do concurrent (kk=bxVvortdxsm%idxS(3):bxVvortdxsm%idxE(3), J=bxVvortdxsm%idxS(2):bxVvortdxsm%idxE(2), &
67960 i=bxVvortdxsm%idxS(1):bxVvortdxsm%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(DY_dxBu))
67970 DY_dxBu = dyBu(I,J) * IdxBu(I,J)
6798 vort_xy_dx_smooth(i,J,kk) = DY_dxBu * &
67990 ((vort_xy_smooth(I,J,kk) * IdyCu(I,j)) - (vort_xy_smooth(I-1,J,kk) * IdyCu(I-1,j)))
6800 enddo
6801
6802 do concurrent (kk=bxUvortdysm%idxS(3):bxUvortdysm%idxE(3), j=bxUvortdysm%idxS(2):bxUvortdysm%idxE(2), &
68030 I=bxUvortdysm%idxS(1):bxUvortdysm%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(DX_dyBu))
68040 DX_dyBu = dxBu(I,J) * IdyBu(I,J)
6805 vort_xy_dy_smooth(I,j,kk) = DX_dyBu * &
68060 ((vort_xy_smooth(I,J,kk) * IdxCv(i,J)) - (vort_xy_smooth(I,J-1,kk) * IdxCv(i,J-1)))
6807 enddo
6808 endif ! If Leithy
6809
6810 ! Laplacian of vorticity
6811 ! if (CS%Leith_Ah .or. CS%use_Leithy) then
6812 do concurrent (kk=bxQvsmooth%idxS(3):bxQvsmooth%idxE(3), J=bxQvsmooth%idxS(2):bxQvsmooth%idxE(2), &
68130 I=bxQvsmooth%idxS(1):bxQvsmooth%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(DY_dxBu, DX_dyBu))
68140 DY_dxBu = dyBu(I,J) * IdxBu(I,J)
68150 DX_dyBu = dxBu(I,J) * IdyBu(I,J)
6816
6817 Del2vort_q(I,J,kk) = DY_dxBu * ((vort_xy_dx(i+1,J,kk) * IdyCv(i+1,J)) - (vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) * IdyCv(i,J))) + &
68180 DX_dyBu * ((vort_xy_dy(I,j+1,kk) * IdyCu(I,j+1)) - (vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) * IdyCu(I,j)))
6819 enddo
6820 ! endif
6821
68220 if (CS%modified_Leith) then
6823
6824 ! Divergence
6825 do concurrent (kk=bxHdiv%idxS(3):bxHdiv%idxE(3), j=bxHdiv%idxS(2):bxHdiv%idxE(2), &
68260 i=bxHdiv%idxS(1):bxHdiv%idxE(1))
68270 div_xx(i,j,kk) = dudx(i,j,kk) + dvdy(i,j,kk)
6828 enddo
6829
6830 ! Divergence gradient
6831 do concurrent (kk=bxUdivdx%idxS(3):bxUdivdx%idxE(3), j=bxUdivdx%idxS(2):bxUdivdx%idxE(2), &
68320 I=bxUdivdx%idxS(1):bxUdivdx%idxE(1))
68330 div_xx_dx(I,j,kk) = IdxCu(I,j)*(div_xx(i+1,j,kk) - div_xx(i,j,kk))
6834 enddo
6835 do concurrent (kk=bxVdivdy%idxS(3):bxVdivdy%idxE(3), J=bxVdivdy%idxS(2):bxVdivdy%idxE(2), &
68360 i=bxVdivdy%idxS(1):bxVdivdy%idxE(1))
68370 div_xx_dy(i,J,kk) = IdyCv(i,J)*(div_xx(i,j+1,kk) - div_xx(i,j,kk))
6838 enddo
6839
6840 ! Magnitude of divergence gradient
68410 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
6842 grad_div_mag_h(i,j,kk) = sqrt(((0.5*(div_xx_dx(I,j,kk) + div_xx_dx(I-1,j,kk)))**2) + &
68430 ((0.5*(div_xx_dy(i,J,kk) + div_xx_dy(i,J-1,kk)))**2))
6844 enddo
6845 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
68460 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
6847 grad_div_mag_q(I,J,kk) = sqrt(((0.5*(div_xx_dx(I,j,kk) + div_xx_dx(I,j+1,kk)))**2) + &
68480 ((0.5*(div_xx_dy(i,J,kk) + div_xx_dy(i+1,J,kk)))**2))
6849 enddo
6850
6851 else
6852
6853 do concurrent (kk=bxUdivdx%idxS(3):bxUdivdx%idxE(3), j=bxUdivdx%idxS(2):bxUdivdx%idxE(2), &
68540 I=bxUdivdx%idxS(1):bxUdivdx%idxE(1))
68550 div_xx_dx(I,j,kk) = 0.0
6856 enddo
6857 do concurrent (kk=bxVdivdy%idxS(3):bxVdivdy%idxE(3), J=bxVdivdy%idxS(2):bxVdivdy%idxE(2), &
68580 i=bxVdivdy%idxS(1):bxVdivdy%idxE(1))
68590 div_xx_dy(i,J,kk) = 0.0
6860 enddo
68610 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
68620 grad_div_mag_h(i,j,kk) = 0.0
6863 enddo
6864 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
68650 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
68660 grad_div_mag_q(I,J,kk) = 0.0
6867 enddo
6868
6869 endif ! CS%modified_Leith
6870
6871 ! Add in beta for the Leith viscosity
68720 if (CS%use_beta_in_Leith) then
6873 do concurrent (kk=bxVbeta%idxS(3):bxVbeta%idxE(3), J=bxVbeta%idxS(2):bxVbeta%idxE(2), &
68740 i=bxVbeta%idxS(1):bxVbeta%idxE(1))
68750 vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) = vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) + 0.5 * ( dF_dx(i,j) + dF_dx(i,j+1))
6876 enddo
6877 do concurrent (kk=bxUbeta%idxS(3):bxUbeta%idxE(3), j=bxUbeta%idxS(2):bxUbeta%idxE(2), &
68780 I=bxUbeta%idxS(1):bxUbeta%idxE(1))
68790 vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) = vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) + 0.5 * ( dF_dy(i,j) + dF_dy(i+1,j))
6880 enddo
6881 endif ! CS%use_beta_in_Leith
6882
68830 if (CS%use_QG_Leith_visc) then
6884
68850 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
6886 grad_vort_mag_h_2d(i,j,kk) = SQRT(((0.5*(vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) + vort_xy_dx(i,J-1,kk)))**2) + &
68870 ((0.5*(vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) + vort_xy_dy(I-1,j,kk)))**2) )
6888 enddo
6889 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
68900 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
6891 grad_vort_mag_q_2d(I,J,kk) = SQRT(((0.5*(vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) + vort_xy_dx(i+1,J,kk)))**2) + &
68920 ((0.5*(vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) + vort_xy_dy(I,j+1,kk)))**2) )
6893 enddo
6894 endif
6895
68960 call bxUbeta%free() ; call bxVbeta%free()
68970 call bxHdiv%free()
68980 call bxVvortdx%free()
68990 call bxUdivdx%free()
69000 call bxUvortdy%free()
69010 call bxVdivdy%free()
69020 call bxUvortdysm%free()
69030 call bxVvortdxsm%free()
69040end subroutine hor_visc_Leith_grad_a_fortran
6905
6906!> Dispatches hor_visc_Leith_grad_a to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
6907!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by HOR_VISC_LEITH_GRAD_A_MODE.
69080subroutine hor_visc_Leith_grad_a(bxH, bxKh, bxKh_i, bxKh_j, bxQstr, bxQvsmooth, Gcore, CS, nkblock, dudx_a, dvdy_a, &
6909 vort_xy_a, vort_xy_smooth_a, grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a, grad_div_mag_h_a, &
6910 grad_vort_mag_q_2d_a, grad_div_mag_q_a, Del2vort_q_a, vort_xy_dx_a, &
6911 vort_xy_dx_smooth_a, div_xx_dy_a, vort_xy_dy_a, vort_xy_dy_smooth_a, div_xx_dx_a)
6912 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH !< The h-point iteration box of this tile,
6913 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
6914 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
6915 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
6916 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh_i !< The thickness-point viscosity range in i
6917 !! only, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, jsc:jec, 1:kmax]
6918 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh_j !< The thickness-point viscosity range in j
6919 !! only, [isc:iec, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
6920 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
6921 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
6922 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQvsmooth !< The q points of this tile where the smoothed vorticity
6923 !! terms are computed,
6924 !! [is_Kh-1:ie_Kh, js_Kh-1:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
6925 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
6926 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
6927 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
6928 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: dudx_a !< x-derivative of the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
6929 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: dvdy_a !< y-derivative of the horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
6930 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_a !< Vertical vorticity (dv/dx - du/dy) including
6931 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
6932 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_smooth_a !< Vertical vorticity including metric
6933 !! terms, smoothed [T-1 ~> s-1]
6934 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_h_2d_a !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient
6935 !! at h-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6936 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_h_a !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at
6937 !! h-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6938 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q_2d_a !< Magnitude of 2d vorticity gradient
6939 !! at q-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6940 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_div_mag_q_a !< Magnitude of divergence gradient at
6941 !! q-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6942 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points
6943 !! [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
6944 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_a !< x-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dx(dv/dx - du/dy))
6945 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6946 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_smooth_a !< x-derivative of smoothed vertical vorticity
6947 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6948 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: div_xx_dy_a !< y-derivative of horizontal divergence (d/dy(du/dx +
6949 !! dv/dy)) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6950 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_a !< y-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dy(dv/dx - du/dy))
6951 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6952 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_smooth_a !< y-derivative of smoothed vertical vorticity
6953 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6954 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: div_xx_dx_a !< x-derivative of horizontal divergence (d/dx(du/dx +
6955 !! dv/dy)) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
6956
6957 ! Local variables
6958 integer :: mode, rc
69590 type(io_recorder) :: rec
6960 logical :: capture
6961 character(len=80) :: kernel
6962 character(len=100) :: dir
6963 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
6964 type(Box_C) :: bxH_c
6965 type(Box_C) :: bxKh_c
6966 type(Box_C) :: bxKh_i_c
6967 type(Box_C) :: bxKh_j_c
6968 type(Box_C) :: bxQstr_c
6969 type(Box_C) :: bxQvsmooth_c
6970 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
6971 type(RealArray_C) :: dudx_c
6972 type(RealArray_C) :: dvdy_c
6973 type(RealArray_C) :: vort_xy_c
6974 type(RealArray_C) :: vort_xy_smooth_c
6975 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_vort_mag_h_2d_c
6976 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_div_mag_h_c
6977 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_vort_mag_q_2d_c
6978 type(RealArray_C) :: grad_div_mag_q_c
6979 type(RealArray_C) :: Del2vort_q_c
6980 type(RealArray_C) :: vort_xy_dx_c
6981 type(RealArray_C) :: vort_xy_dx_smooth_c
6982 type(RealArray_C) :: div_xx_dy_c

7100!> Calculates the magnitudes of the vorticity gradients used within horizontal_viscosity by the
7101!! Leith viscosity schemes, after any QG Leith contribution has been added.
71020subroutine hor_visc_Leith_grad_b_fortran(bxKh, bxQstr, CS, nkblock, grad_vort_mag_h_a, grad_vort_mag_q_a, &
7103 vert_vort_mag_smooth_a, vort_xy_dx_a, vort_xy_dx_smooth_a, vort_xy_dy_a, &
7104 vort_xy_dy_smooth_a)
7105 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
7106 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
7107 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
7108 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
7109 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7110 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7111 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_h_a !< Magnitude of vorticity gradient at
7112 !! h-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7113 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: grad_vort_mag_q_a !< Magnitude of vorticity gradient at
7114 !! q-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7115 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vert_vort_mag_smooth_a !< Magnitude of gradient of smoothed
7116 !! vertical vorticity (h or q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7117 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_a !< x-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dx(dv/dx - du/dy))
7118 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7119 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_smooth_a !< x-derivative of smoothed vertical vorticity
7120 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7121 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_a !< y-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dy(dv/dx - du/dy))
7122 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7123 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_smooth_a !< y-derivative of smoothed vertical vorticity
7124 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7125 ! Local variables
71260 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: vort_xy_dy_smooth, vort_xy_dy, vort_xy_dx_smooth, &
71270 vort_xy_dx, vert_vort_mag_smooth, grad_vort_mag_q, grad_vort_mag_h
7128 integer :: i, j, kk
7129
71300 call vort_xy_dy_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_dy_smooth) ; call vort_xy_dy_a%view(vort_xy_dy)
71310 call vort_xy_dx_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_dx_smooth) ; call vort_xy_dx_a%view(vort_xy_dx)
71320 call vert_vort_mag_smooth_a%view(vert_vort_mag_smooth)
71330 call grad_vort_mag_q_a%view(grad_vort_mag_q) ; call grad_vort_mag_h_a%view(grad_vort_mag_h)
7134
71350 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
7136 grad_vort_mag_h(i,j,kk) = SQRT(((0.5*(vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) + vort_xy_dx(i,J-1,kk)))**2) + &
71370 ((0.5*(vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) + vort_xy_dy(I-1,j,kk)))**2) )
7138 enddo
7139 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
71400 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
7141 grad_vort_mag_q(I,J,kk) = SQRT(((0.5*(vort_xy_dx(i,J,kk) + vort_xy_dx(i+1,J,kk)))**2) + &
71420 ((0.5*(vort_xy_dy(I,j,kk) + vort_xy_dy(I,j+1,kk)))**2) )
7143 enddo
7144
71450 if (CS%use_Leithy) then
71460 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
7147 vert_vort_mag_smooth(i,j,kk) = SQRT(((0.5*(vort_xy_dx_smooth(i,J,kk) + &
7148 vort_xy_dx_smooth(i,J-1,kk)))**2) + &
7149 ((0.5*(vort_xy_dy_smooth(I,j,kk) + &
71500 vort_xy_dy_smooth(I-1,j,kk)))**2) )
7151 enddo
7152 endif ! Leithy
7153
7154
71550end subroutine hor_visc_Leith_grad_b_fortran

7169 !! h-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]

7171 !! q-points [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]

7173 !! vertical vorticity (h or q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]

7175 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]

7179 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]

7203

7268
7269!> Adds the QG Leith contribution to the vorticity gradients for each layer of one tile.
7270!! This calls into MOM_lateral_mixing_coeffs, so it always runs in Fortran.
72710subroutine hor_visc_QG_Leith_host(host, nkblock, kstart, kmax, h_a, dz_a, slope_x_a, slope_y_a, &
7272 div_xx_dx_a, div_xx_dy_a, vort_xy_dx_a, vort_xy_dy_a)
7273 type(c_ptr), value, intent(in) :: host !< Opaque pointer to the hv_host_ctx that holds the Fortran
7274 !! objects used by the host helpers
7275 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7276 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
7277 integer, intent(in) :: kmax !< The number of active k-layers in the current k-block
7278 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
7279 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: dz_a !< Height change across layers [Z ~> m]
7280 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: slope_x_a !< Isopycnal slope in i-direction [Z L-1 ~> nondim]
7281 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: slope_y_a !< Isopycnal slope in j-direction [Z L-1 ~> nondim]
7282 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: div_xx_dx_a !< x-derivative of horizontal divergence (d/dx(du/dx +
7283 !! dv/dy)) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7284 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: div_xx_dy_a !< y-derivative of horizontal divergence (d/dy(du/dx +
7285 !! dv/dy)) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7286 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dx_a !< x-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dx(dv/dx - du/dy))
7287 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7288 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: vort_xy_dy_a !< y-derivative of vertical vorticity (d/dy(dv/dx - du/dy))
7289 !! [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7290 ! Local variables
7291 type(hv_host_ctx), pointer :: ctx ! The objects behind host
7292 type(ocean_grid_type), pointer :: G ! The ocean's grid structure.
7293 type(verticalGrid_type), pointer :: GV ! The ocean's vertical grid structure.
7294 type(unit_scale_type), pointer :: US ! A dimensional unit scaling type
7295 type(VarMix_CS), pointer :: VarMix ! Variable mixing control structure
72960 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: vort_xy_dy, vort_xy_dx, div_xx_dy, div_xx_dx, &
72970 slope_y, slope_x, dz, h
7298 integer :: k, kk
7299
73000 call c_f_pointer(host, ctx)
73010 G => ctx%G ; GV => ctx%GV ; US => ctx%US ; VarMix => ctx%VarMix
7302
73030 call vort_xy_dy_a%view(vort_xy_dy) ; call vort_xy_dx_a%view(vort_xy_dx)
73040 call div_xx_dy_a%view(div_xx_dy) ; call div_xx_dx_a%view(div_xx_dx)
73050 call slope_y_a%view(slope_y) ; call slope_x_a%view(slope_x) ; call dz_a%view(dz)
73060 call h_a%view(h)
7307
7308 ! This accumulates terms, some of which are in VarMix.
73090 do kk=1,kmax
73100 k = kstart + kk - 1
7311 call calc_QG_Leith_viscosity(VarMix, G, GV, US, h, dz, k, div_xx_dx(:,:,kk), div_xx_dy(:,:,kk), &
73120 slope_x, slope_y, vort_xy_dx(:,:,kk), vort_xy_dy(:,:,kk))
7313 enddo
7314
73150end subroutine hor_visc_QG_Leith_host
7316
7317!> Adds the MEKE-based (EY24_EBT_BS) backscatter contribution to the diagonal term of
7318!! the stress tensor at h-points. The caller must only invoke this routine when
7319!! CS%EY24_EBT_BS is true.
73200subroutine hor_visc_backscatter_h_fortran(bxHstr, CS, MEKE_a, VarMix_a, use_kh_struct, nkblock, kstart, &
7321 visc_limit_h_flag_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, BS_coeff_h_a)
7322 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
7323 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
7324 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7325 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(in) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
7326 type(hor_visc_VarMix_type), intent(in) :: VarMix_a !< Variable mixing control structure
7327 logical, intent(in) :: use_kh_struct !< If true, shape the backscatter coefficient
7328 !! with VarMix%BS_struct
7329 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7330 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
7331 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: visc_limit_h_flag_a !< determines whether backscatter is shut off [nondim]
7332 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including
7333 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
7334 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xx_a !< The diagonal term in the stress tensor
7335 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
7336 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: BS_coeff_h_a !< A diagnostic array of the backscatter
7337 !! coefficient [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
7338 ! Local variables
73390 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: BS_coeff_h, str_xx, sh_xx, visc_limit_h_flag
73400 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: MEKE_Ku
73410 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: BS_struct
7342 real, dimension(sh_xx_a%lb(1):sh_xx_a%ub(1),sh_xx_a%lb(2):sh_xx_a%ub(2),nkblock) :: &
73430 Kh_BS, & ! Laplacian antiviscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
73440 str_xx_BS ! The diagonal term in the stress tensor due to backscatter [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
7345 integer :: i, j, k, kk
7346
73470 call BS_coeff_h_a%view(BS_coeff_h) ; call str_xx_a%view(str_xx) ; call sh_xx_a%view(sh_xx)
73480 call visc_limit_h_flag_a%view(visc_limit_h_flag)
7349
73500 nullify(MEKE_Ku, BS_struct)
73510 if (MEKE_a%Ku_a%associated()) call MEKE_a%Ku_a%view(MEKE_Ku)
73520 if (VarMix_a%BS_struct_a%associated()) call VarMix_a%BS_struct_a%view(BS_struct)
7353
7354 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
73550 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
73560 k = kstart + kk - 1
73570 if (visc_limit_h_flag(i,j,k) > 0) then
73580 Kh_BS(i,j,kk) = 0.
7359 else
73600 if (use_kh_struct) then
73610 Kh_BS(i,j,kk) = MEKE_Ku(i,j) * BS_struct(i,j,k)
7362 else
73630 Kh_BS(i,j,kk) = MEKE_Ku(i,j)
7364 endif
7365 endif
7366 enddo
7367
7368 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
73690 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1))
73700 str_xx_BS(i,j,kk) = -Kh_BS(i,j,kk) * sh_xx(i,j,kk)
7371 enddo
7372
73730 if (CS%do_BS_coeff_h) then
7374 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
73750 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
73760 k = kstart + kk - 1
73770 BS_coeff_h(i,j,k) = Kh_BS(i,j,kk)
7378 enddo
7379 endif
7380
7381 do concurrent (kk=bxHstr%idxS(3):bxHstr%idxE(3), j=bxHstr%idxS(2):bxHstr%idxE(2), &
73820 i=bxHstr%idxS(1):bxHstr%idxE(1))
73830 str_xx(i,j,kk) = str_xx(i,j,kk) + str_xx_BS(i,j,kk)
7384 enddo
7385
73860end subroutine hor_visc_backscatter_h_fortran
7387
7388!> Dispatches hor_visc_backscatter_h to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
7389!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by HOR_VISC_BACKSCATTER_H_MODE.
73900subroutine hor_visc_backscatter_h(bxHstr, CS, MEKE_a, VarMix_a, use_kh_struct, nkblock, kstart, visc_limit_h_flag_a, &
7391 sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, BS_coeff_h_a)
7392 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxHstr !< The h points of this tile where the normal stresses are
7393 !! computed, [IscB:IecB+1, JscB:JecB+1, 1:kmax]
7394 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7395 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(in) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
7396 type(hor_visc_VarMix_type), intent(in) :: VarMix_a !< Variable mixing control structure
7397 logical, intent(in) :: use_kh_struct !< If true, shape the backscatter coefficient
7398 !! with VarMix%BS_struct
7399 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7400 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
7401 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: visc_limit_h_flag_a !< determines whether backscatter is shut off [nondim]
7402 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including
7403 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
7404 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xx_a !< The diagonal term in the stress tensor
7405 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
7406 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: BS_coeff_h_a !< A diagnostic array of the backscatter
7407 !! coefficient [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
7408
7409 ! Local variables
7410 integer :: mode, rc
74110 type(io_recorder) :: rec
7412 logical :: capture
7413 character(len=80) :: kernel
7414 character(len=100) :: dir
7415 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
7416 type(Box_C) :: bxHstr_c
7417 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
7418 type(hor_visc_MEKE_C) :: MEKE_c
7419 type(hor_visc_VarMix_C) :: VarMix_c
7420 logical(c_bool) :: use_kh_struct_c
7421 type(RealArray_C) :: visc_limit_h_flag_c
7422 type(RealArray_C) :: sh_xx_c
7423 type(RealArray_C) :: str_xx_c
7424 type(RealArray_C) :: BS_coeff_h_c
7425
74260 kernel = "hor_visc_backscatter_h"
74270 mode = getenv_mode("HOR_VISC_BACKSCATTER_H_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
7428
74290 select case (mode)
7430
7431 case (TIMH_capture)
74320 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
74330 if (capture) then
74340 dir = "capture"
74350 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
74360 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
74370 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
74380 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
74390 call rec%add("_bxHstr", bxHstr)
74400 call record_hv_opts_CS(rec, "_CS", CS)
74410 call record_hor_visc_MEKE(rec, "_MEKE", MEKE_a, "")
74420 call record_hor_visc_MEKE(rec, "_MEKE", MEKE_a, "_before")
74430 call record_hor_visc_VarMix(rec, "_VarMix", VarMix_a, "")
74440 call record_hor_visc_VarMix(rec, "_VarMix", VarMix_a, "_before")
74450 call rec%add("_use_kh_struct", use_kh_struct)
74460 call rec%add("_nkblock", nkblock)
74470 call rec%add("_kstart", kstart)
74480 call rec%add("_visc_limit_h_flag", visc_limit_h_flag_a)
74490 call rec%add("_sh_xx", sh_xx_a)
74500 call rec%add("_str_xx_before", str_xx_a)
74510 call rec%add("_BS_coeff_h_before", BS_coeff_h_a)
7452 endif
7453
7454 call hor_visc_backscatter_h_fortran(bxHstr, CS, MEKE_a, VarMix_a, use_kh_struct, nkblock, kstart, &
74550 visc_limit_h_flag_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, BS_coeff_h_a)
7456
74570 if (capture) then
74580 call rec%add("_str_xx_after", str_xx_a)
74590 call rec%add("_BS_coeff_h_after", BS_coeff_h_a)
74600 call rec%close()
74610 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
7462 endif
7463
7464#ifdef _TIM
7465 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
7466 bxHstr_c = bxHstr%to_c()
7467 CS_c = hv_opts_CS_to_c(CS)
7468 MEKE_c = hor_visc_MEKE_to_c(MEKE_a)
7469 VarMix_c = hor_visc_VarMix_to_c(VarMix_a)
7470 use_kh_struct_c = use_kh_struct
7471 visc_limit_h_flag_c = visc_limit_h_flag_a%to_c()
7472 sh_xx_c = sh_xx_a%to_c()
7473 str_xx_c = str_xx_a%to_c()
7474 BS_coeff_h_c = BS_coeff_h_a%to_c()
7475 call turbotmp_hor_visc_backscatter_h_bridge(bxHstr_c, CS_c, MEKE_c, VarMix_c, use_kh_struct_c, &
7476 int(nkblock, c_int), int(kstart, c_int), visc_limit_h_flag_c, &
7477 sh_xx_c, str_xx_c, BS_coeff_h_c)
7478#endif
7479
7480 case default
7481 call hor_visc_backscatter_h_fortran(bxHstr, CS, MEKE_a, VarMix_a, use_kh_struct, nkblock, kstart, &
74820 visc_limit_h_flag_a, sh_xx_a, str_xx_a, BS_coeff_h_a)
7483
7484 end select

7487
7488!> Adds the MEKE-based (EY24_EBT_BS) backscatter contribution to the cross term of
7489!! the stress tensor at q-points. The caller must only invoke this routine when
7490!! CS%EY24_EBT_BS is true.
74910subroutine hor_visc_backscatter_q_fortran(bxQstr, CS, MEKE_a, VarMix_a, use_kh_struct, nkblock, kstart, &
7492 visc_limit_q_flag_a, sh_xy_a, str_xy_a, BS_coeff_q_a)
7493 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQstr !< The q points of this tile where the shear stresses are
7494 !! computed, [isc-1:iec, jsc-1:jec, 1:kmax]
7495 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7496 type(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(in) :: MEKE_a !< MEKE fields related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
7497 type(hor_visc_VarMix_type), intent(in) :: VarMix_a !< Variable mixing control structure
7498 logical, intent(in) :: use_kh_struct !< If true, shape the backscatter coefficient
7499 !! with VarMix%BS_struct
7500 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7501 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
7502 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: visc_limit_q_flag_a !< determines whether backscatter is shut off [nondim]
7503 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including
7504 !! metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
7505 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xy_a !< The cross term in the stress tensor
7506 !! [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
7507 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: BS_coeff_q_a !< A diagnostic array of the backscatter
7508 !! coefficient [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
7509 ! Local variables
75100 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: BS_coeff_q, str_xy, sh_xy, visc_limit_q_flag
75110 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: MEKE_Ku
75120 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: BS_struct
7513 real, dimension(sh_xy_a%lb(1):sh_xy_a%ub(1),sh_xy_a%lb(2):sh_xy_a%ub(2),nkblock) :: &
75140 Kh_BS, & ! Laplacian antiviscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
75150 str_xy_BS ! The cross term in the stress tensor due to backscatter [H L2 T-2 ~> m3 s-2 or kg s-2]
7516 integer :: i, j, k, kk
7517
75180 call BS_coeff_q_a%view(BS_coeff_q) ; call str_xy_a%view(str_xy) ; call sh_xy_a%view(sh_xy)
75190 call visc_limit_q_flag_a%view(visc_limit_q_flag)
7520
75210 nullify(MEKE_Ku, BS_struct)
75220 if (MEKE_a%Ku_a%associated()) call MEKE_a%Ku_a%view(MEKE_Ku)
75230 if (VarMix_a%BS_struct_a%associated()) call VarMix_a%BS_struct_a%view(BS_struct)
7524
7525 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
75260 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
75270 k = kstart + kk - 1
75280 if (visc_limit_q_flag(I,J,k) > 0) then
75290 Kh_BS(I,J,kk) = 0.
7530 else
75310 if (use_kh_struct) then
7532 Kh_BS(I,J,kk) = 0.25*( ((MEKE_Ku(i,j)*BS_struct(i,j,k)) + &
7533 (MEKE_Ku(i+1,j+1)*BS_struct(i+1,j+1,k))) + &
7534 ((MEKE_Ku(i+1,j)*BS_struct(i+1,j,k)) + &
75350 (MEKE_Ku(i,j+1)*BS_struct(i,j+1,k))) )
7536 else
7537 Kh_BS(I,J,kk) = 0.25*( (MEKE_Ku(i,j) + MEKE_Ku(i+1,j+1)) + &
75380 (MEKE_Ku(i+1,j) + MEKE_Ku(i,j+1)) )
7539 endif
7540 endif
7541 enddo
7542
7543 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
75440 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
75450 str_xy_BS(I,J,kk) = -Kh_BS(I,J,kk) * (sh_xy(I,J,kk))
7546 enddo
7547
75480 if (CS%do_BS_coeff_q) then
7549 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
75500 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
75510 k = kstart + kk - 1
75520 BS_coeff_q(I,J,k) = Kh_BS(I,J,kk)
7553 enddo
7554 endif
7555
7556 do concurrent (kk=bxQstr%idxS(3):bxQstr%idxE(3), J=bxQstr%idxS(2):bxQstr%idxE(2), &
75570 I=bxQstr%idxS(1):bxQstr%idxE(1))
75580 str_xy(I,J,kk) = str_xy(I,J,kk) + str_xy_BS(I,J,kk)
7559 enddo
7560
75610end subroutine hor_visc_backscatter_q_fortran

7662
7663!> Computes the Leith+E antisymmetric-viscosity ratio m_leithy, before any smoothing. The
7664!! caller must only invoke this routine when CS%use_Leithy is true.
76650subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_m_fortran(bxKh, Gcore, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, vert_vort_mag_a, &
7666 vort_xy_smooth_a, m_leithy_a)
7667 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
7668 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
7669 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
7670 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7671 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
7672 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
7673 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7674 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI6 !< The inverse of pi to the sixth power [nondim]
7675 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
7676 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vert_vort_mag_a !< Magnitude of the vertical vorticity
7677 !! gradient (h or q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7678 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_smooth_a !< Vertical vorticity including metric
7679 !! terms, smoothed [T-1 ~> s-1]
7680 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: m_leithy_a !< Kh=m_leithy*Ah in Leith+E parameterization [L-2 ~> m-2]
7681 ! Local variables
76820 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: m_leithy, vort_xy_smooth, vert_vort_mag, Del2vort_q
76830 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: mask2dBu
76840 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: Ah_bg_xx, m_const_leithy, m_leithy_max, Biharm6_const_xx
7685 real :: Del2vort_h ! Laplacian of vorticity at h-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
7686 real :: AhLth ! 2D Leith biharmonic viscosity [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
7687 integer :: i, j, kk
7688
76890 call m_leithy_a%view(m_leithy) ; call vort_xy_smooth_a%view(vort_xy_smooth)
76900 call vert_vort_mag_a%view(vert_vort_mag) ; call Del2vort_q_a%view(Del2vort_q)
76910 call Gcore%mask2dBu%view(mask2dBu)
7692
76930 nullify(Ah_bg_xx, m_const_leithy, m_leithy_max, Biharm6_const_xx)
76940 if (metrics%Ah_bg_xx%associated()) call metrics%Ah_bg_xx%view(Ah_bg_xx)
76950 if (metrics%m_const_leithy%associated()) call metrics%m_const_leithy%view(m_const_leithy)
76960 if (metrics%m_leithy_max%associated()) call metrics%m_leithy_max%view(m_leithy_max)
76970 if (metrics%Biharm6_const_xx%associated()) call metrics%Biharm6_const_xx%view(Biharm6_const_xx)
7698
7699 ! Get m_leithy
77000 if (CS%smooth_Ah) then
77010 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3))
77020 m_leithy(:,:,kk) = 0.0 ! This is here to initialize domain edge halo values.
7703 enddo
7704 endif
7705 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
77060 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Del2vort_h, AhLth))
7707 Del2vort_h = 0.25 * ((Del2vort_q(I,J,kk) + Del2vort_q(I-1,J-1,kk)) + &
77080 (Del2vort_q(I-1,J,kk) + Del2vort_q(I,J-1,kk)))
77090 AhLth = Biharm6_const_xx(i,j) * inv_PI6 * abs(Del2vort_h)
77100 if (AhLth <= Ah_bg_xx(i,j)) then
77110 m_leithy(i,j,kk) = 0.0
7712 else
77130 if ((m_const_leithy(i,j)*vert_vort_mag(i,j,kk)) < abs(vort_xy_smooth(i,j,kk))) then
77140 m_leithy(i,j,kk) = CS%c_K * (vert_vort_mag(i,j,kk) / vort_xy_smooth(i,j,kk))**2
7715 else
77160 m_leithy(i,j,kk) = m_leithy_max(i,j)
7717 endif
77180 m_leithy(i,j,kk) = mask2dBu(i,j) * m_leithy(i,j,kk)
7719 endif
7720 enddo
7721
77220end subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_m_fortran
7723

77260subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_m(bxKh, Gcore, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, &
7727 vert_vort_mag_a, vort_xy_smooth_a, m_leithy_a)
7728 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
7729 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
7730 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
7731 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7732 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
7733 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays

7735 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI6 !< The inverse of pi to the sixth power [nondim]
7736 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
7737 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vert_vort_mag_a !< Magnitude of the vertical vorticity
7738 !! gradient (h or q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7739 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_smooth_a !< Vertical vorticity including metric
7740 !! terms, smoothed [T-1 ~> s-1]
7741 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: m_leithy_a !< Kh=m_leithy*Ah in Leith+E parameterization [L-2 ~> m-2]

7743 ! Local variables
7744 integer :: mode, rc
77450 type(io_recorder) :: rec
7746 logical :: capture
7747 character(len=80) :: kernel
7748 character(len=100) :: dir
7749 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
7750 type(Box_C) :: bxKh_c
7751 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
7752 type(hv_metrics_CS_C) :: metrics_c
7753 type(RealArray_C) :: Del2vort_q_c
7754 type(RealArray_C) :: vert_vort_mag_c
7755 type(RealArray_C) :: vort_xy_smooth_c
7756 type(RealArray_C) :: m_leithy_c
7757
77580 kernel = "hor_visc_leithy_m"
77590 mode = getenv_mode("HOR_VISC_LEITHY_M_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
7760
77610 select case (mode)
7762

77640 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
77650 if (capture) then
77660 dir = "capture"
77670 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))

77750 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "_before")
77760 call rec%add("_nkblock", nkblock)
77770 call rec%add("_inv_PI6", inv_PI6)

7782 endif

77850 vort_xy_smooth_a, m_leithy_a)
7786
77870 if (capture) then
77880 call rec%add("_m_leithy_after", m_leithy_a)

7800 vort_xy_smooth_c = vort_xy_smooth_a%to_c()
7801 m_leithy_c = m_leithy_a%to_c()
7802 call turbotmp_hor_visc_leithy_m_bridge(bxKh_c, Gcore%C, CS_c, metrics_c, int(nkblock, c_int), inv_PI6, &
7803 Del2vort_q_c, vert_vort_mag_c, vort_xy_smooth_c, m_leithy_c)

7805

7807 call hor_visc_Leithy_m_fortran(bxKh, Gcore, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, vert_vort_mag_a, &
78080 vort_xy_smooth_a, m_leithy_a)

7813
7814!> Computes the Leith+E antisymmetric-viscosity ratio m_leithy, and updates the
7815!! biharmonic viscosity Ah (and Ah_h) to include the Leith+E contribution, optionally
7816!! smoothing m_leithy and Ah in the process. The caller must only invoke this
7817!! routine when CS%use_Leithy is true.
78180subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_fortran(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, vert_vort_mag_smooth_a, Ah_a, &
7819 m_leithy_a, Ah_sq_a)
7820 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
7821 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
7822 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7823 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
7824 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
7825 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7826 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI6 !< The inverse of pi to the sixth power [nondim]
7827 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
7828 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vert_vort_mag_smooth_a !< Magnitude of gradient of smoothed
7829 !! vertical vorticity (h or q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7830 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_a !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
7831 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: m_leithy_a !< Kh=m_leithy*Ah in Leith+E parameterization [L-2 ~> m-2]
7832 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_sq_a !< The square of the biharmonic viscosity [L8 T-2 ~> m8 s-2]
7833 ! Local variables
78340 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: Ah_sq, m_leithy, Ah, vert_vort_mag_smooth, &
78350 Del2vort_q
78360 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: Ah_bg_xx, Biharm6_const_xx
7837 real :: Del2vort_h ! Laplacian of vorticity at h-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
7838 real :: AhLthy ! 2D Leith+E biharmonic viscosity [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
7839 integer :: i, j, kk
7840
78410 call Ah_sq_a%view(Ah_sq) ; call m_leithy_a%view(m_leithy) ; call Ah_a%view(Ah)
78420 call vert_vort_mag_smooth_a%view(vert_vort_mag_smooth) ; call Del2vort_q_a%view(Del2vort_q)
7843
78440 nullify(Ah_bg_xx, Biharm6_const_xx)
78450 if (metrics%Ah_bg_xx%associated()) call metrics%Ah_bg_xx%view(Ah_bg_xx)
78460 if (metrics%Biharm6_const_xx%associated()) call metrics%Biharm6_const_xx%view(Biharm6_const_xx)
7847
7848 ! Get Ah
7849 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
78500 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Del2vort_h, AhLthy))
7851 Del2vort_h = 0.25 * ((Del2vort_q(I,J,kk) + Del2vort_q(I-1,J-1,kk)) + &
78520 (Del2vort_q(I-1,J,kk) + Del2vort_q(I,J-1,kk)))
7853 AhLthy = Biharm6_const_xx(i,j) * inv_PI6 * &
78540 sqrt(max(0.,Del2vort_h**2 - m_leithy(i,j,kk)*vert_vort_mag_smooth(i,j,kk)**2))
78550 Ah(i,j,kk) = max(Ah_bg_xx(i,j), AhLthy)
7856 enddo
78570 if (CS%smooth_Ah) then
7858 ! Smooth Ah before applying upper bound. Square Ah, then smooth, then take its square root.
78590 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3))
78600 Ah_sq(:,:,kk) = 0.0 ! This is here to initialize domain edge halo values.
7861 enddo
78620 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1))
78630 Ah_sq(i,j,kk) = Ah(i,j,kk)**2
7864 enddo
7865 endif
7866
78670end subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_fortran
7868
7869!> Dispatches hor_visc_Leithy_Ah to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and

78710subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, &

7873 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
7874 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
7875 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7876 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
7877 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
7878 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7879 real, intent(in) :: inv_PI6 !< The inverse of pi to the sixth power [nondim]
7880 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: Del2vort_q_a !< Laplacian of vorticity at q-points [L-2 T-1 ~> m-2 s-1]
7881 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vert_vort_mag_smooth_a !< Magnitude of gradient of smoothed
7882 !! vertical vorticity (h or q) [L-1 T-1 ~> m-1 s-1]
7883 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_a !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
7884 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: m_leithy_a !< Kh=m_leithy*Ah in Leith+E parameterization [L-2 ~> m-2]
7885 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_sq_a !< The square of the biharmonic viscosity [L8 T-2 ~> m8 s-2]
7886
7887 ! Local variables

7892 character(len=100) :: dir
7893 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
7894 type(Box_C) :: bxKh_c
7895 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
7896 type(hv_metrics_CS_C) :: metrics_c
7897 type(RealArray_C) :: Del2vort_q_c
7898 type(RealArray_C) :: vert_vort_mag_smooth_c
7899 type(RealArray_C) :: Ah_c
7900 type(RealArray_C) :: m_leithy_c
7901 type(RealArray_C) :: Ah_sq_c
7902
79030 kernel = "hor_visc_leithy_ah"
79040 mode = getenv_mode("HOR_VISC_LEITHY_AH_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
7905
79060 select case (mode)
7907
7908 case (TIMH_capture)
79090 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
79100 if (capture) then
79110 dir = "capture"
79120 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
79130 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
79140 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
79150 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
79160 call rec%add("_bxKh", bxKh)
79170 call record_hv_opts_CS(rec, "_CS", CS)
79180 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "")
79190 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "_before")
79200 call rec%add("_nkblock", nkblock)
79210 call rec%add("_inv_PI6", inv_PI6)
79220 call rec%add("_Del2vort_q", Del2vort_q_a)
79230 call rec%add("_vert_vort_mag_smooth", vert_vort_mag_smooth_a)

7927 endif
7928
7929 call hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_fortran(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, vert_vort_mag_smooth_a, Ah_a, &
79300 m_leithy_a, Ah_sq_a)
7931
79320 if (capture) then
79330 call rec%add("_Ah_after", Ah_a)
79340 call rec%add("_Ah_sq_after", Ah_sq_a)

7937 endif
7938
7939#ifdef _TIM

7941 bxKh_c = bxKh%to_c()
7942 CS_c = hv_opts_CS_to_c(CS)
7943 metrics_c = hv_metrics_CS_to_c(metrics)
7944 Del2vort_q_c = Del2vort_q_a%to_c()
7945 vert_vort_mag_smooth_c = vert_vort_mag_smooth_a%to_c()

7947 m_leithy_c = m_leithy_a%to_c()
7948 Ah_sq_c = Ah_sq_a%to_c()
7949 call turbotmp_hor_visc_leithy_ah_bridge(bxKh_c, CS_c, metrics_c, int(nkblock, c_int), inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_c, &
7950 vert_vort_mag_smooth_c, Ah_c, m_leithy_c, Ah_sq_c)
7951#endif
7952
7953 case default
7954 call hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_fortran(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, inv_PI6, Del2vort_q_a, vert_vort_mag_smooth_a, Ah_a, &
79550 m_leithy_a, Ah_sq_a)

7960
7961!> Sets the Leith+E biharmonic viscosity Ah and Ah_h, from the smoothed square of Ah if
7962!! CS%smooth_Ah is true. The caller must only invoke this routine when CS%use_Leithy is true.
79630subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_h_fortran(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, kstart, Ah_a, Ah_h_a, Ah_sq_a)
7964 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
7965 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]
7966 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
7967 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
7968 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
7969 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
7970 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
7971 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_a !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
7972 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_h_a !< biharmonic viscosity at thickness points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
7973 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: Ah_sq_a !< The square of the biharmonic viscosity [L8 T-2 ~> m8 s-2]
7974 ! Local variables
79750 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: Ah_sq, Ah_h, Ah
79760 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: Ah_bg_xx
7977 integer :: i, j, k, kk
7978
79790 call Ah_sq_a%view(Ah_sq) ; call Ah_h_a%view(Ah_h) ; call Ah_a%view(Ah)
7980
79810 nullify(Ah_bg_xx)
79820 if (metrics%Ah_bg_xx%associated()) call metrics%Ah_bg_xx%view(Ah_bg_xx)
7983
79840 if (CS%smooth_Ah) then
7985 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
79860 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
79870 k = kstart + kk - 1
79880 Ah_h(i,j,k) = max(Ah_bg_xx(i,j), sqrt(max(0., Ah_sq(i,j,kk))))
79890 Ah(i,j,kk) = Ah_h(i,j,k)
7990 enddo
7991 else
7992 do concurrent (kk=bxKh%idxS(3):bxKh%idxE(3), j=bxKh%idxS(2):bxKh%idxE(2), &
79930 i=bxKh%idxS(1):bxKh%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
79940 k = kstart + kk - 1
79950 Ah_h(i,j,k) = Ah(i,j,kk)
7996 enddo
7997 endif
7998
79990end subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_h_fortran
8000

80030subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_h(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, kstart, Ah_a, Ah_h_a, Ah_sq_a)
8004 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxKh !< The thickness-point viscosity box of this
8005 !! tile, [is_Kh:ie_Kh, js_Kh:je_Kh, 1:kmax]

8007 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
8008 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays

8010 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
8011 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_a !< biharmonic viscosity (h or q) [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
8012 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_h_a !< biharmonic viscosity at thickness points [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
8013 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: Ah_sq_a !< The square of the biharmonic viscosity [L8 T-2 ~> m8 s-2]

80170 type(io_recorder) :: rec
8018 logical :: capture
8019 character(len=80) :: kernel
8020 character(len=100) :: dir
8021 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile

8023 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
8024 type(hv_metrics_CS_C) :: metrics_c

8026 type(RealArray_C) :: Ah_h_c
