8028
80290 kernel = "hor_visc_leithy_ah_h"
80300 mode = getenv_mode("HOR_VISC_LEITHY_AH_H_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
8031
80320 select case (mode)
8033
8034 case (TIMH_capture)
80350 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
80360 if (capture) then
80370 dir = "capture"
80380 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
80390 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
80400 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
80410 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
80420 call rec%add("_bxKh", bxKh)
80430 call record_hv_opts_CS(rec, "_CS", CS)
80440 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "")
80450 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "_before")
80460 call rec%add("_nkblock", nkblock)
80470 call rec%add("_kstart", kstart)
80480 call rec%add("_Ah_before", Ah_a)
80490 call rec%add("_Ah_h_before", Ah_h_a)
80500 call rec%add("_Ah_sq", Ah_sq_a)
8051 endif
8052
80530 call hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_h_fortran(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, kstart, Ah_a, Ah_h_a, Ah_sq_a)
8054
80550 if (capture) then
80560 call rec%add("_Ah_after", Ah_a)
80570 call rec%add("_Ah_h_after", Ah_h_a)
80580 call rec%close()
80590 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
8060 endif
8061
8062#ifdef _TIM
8063 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
8064 bxKh_c = bxKh%to_c()
8065 CS_c = hv_opts_CS_to_c(CS)
8066 metrics_c = hv_metrics_CS_to_c(metrics)
8067 Ah_c = Ah_a%to_c()
8068 Ah_h_c = Ah_h_a%to_c()
8069 Ah_sq_c = Ah_sq_a%to_c()
8070 call turbotmp_hor_visc_leithy_ah_h_bridge(bxKh_c, CS_c, metrics_c, int(nkblock, c_int), int(kstart, c_int), &
8071 Ah_c, Ah_h_c, Ah_sq_c)
8072#endif
8073
8074 case default
80750 call hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_h_fortran(bxKh, CS, metrics, nkblock, kstart, Ah_a, Ah_h_a, Ah_sq_a)
8076
8077 end select
8078
80790end subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_h
8080
8081!> Smooths m_leithy for each layer of one tile.
8082!! This includes halo updates, so it always runs in Fortran.
80830subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_m_smooth_host(host, Gcore, bxH0, nkblock, kmax, m_leithy_a)
8084 type(c_ptr), value, intent(in) :: host !< Opaque pointer to the hv_host_ctx that holds the Fortran
8085 !! objects used by the host helpers
8086 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
8087 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
8088 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
8089 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
8090 integer, intent(in) :: kmax !< The number of active k-layers in the current k-block
8091 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: m_leithy_a !< Kh=m_leithy*Ah in Leith+E parameterization [L-2 ~> m-2]
8092 ! Local variables
8093 type(hv_host_ctx), pointer :: ctx ! The objects behind host
8094 type(ocean_grid_type), pointer :: G ! The ocean's grid structure.
80950 type(RealArray_t) :: layer_a ! One layer of the field being smoothed [arbitrary]
80960 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: m_leithy
8097 integer :: kk
8098
80990 call c_f_pointer(host, ctx)
81000 G => ctx%G
8101
81020 call m_leithy_a%view(m_leithy)
8103
81040 do kk=1,kmax
8105 ! Smooth m_leithy. A single call smoothes twice.
81060 call pass_var(m_leithy(:,:,kk), G%Domain, halo=2)
8107 call layer_a%alloc(lb=m_leithy_a%lb(1:2), ub=m_leithy_a%ub(1:2), &
81080 source=m_leithy(:,:,kk))
81090 call smooth_x9_h(Gcore, bxH0, layer_a, zero_land=.true.)
81100 call layer_a%copy2F(m_leithy(:,:,kk)) ; call layer_a%free()
81110 call pass_var(m_leithy(:,:,kk), G%Domain)
8112 enddo
8113
81140end subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_m_smooth_host
8115
8116!> Smooths the square of Ah for each layer of one tile.
8117!! This includes halo updates, so it always runs in Fortran.
81180subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_sq_smooth_host(host, Gcore, bxH0, nkblock, kmax, Ah_sq_a)
8119 type(c_ptr), value, intent(in) :: host !< Opaque pointer to the hv_host_ctx that holds the Fortran
8120 !! objects used by the host helpers
8121 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
8122 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
8123 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
8124 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
8125 integer, intent(in) :: kmax !< The number of active k-layers in the current k-block
8126 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: Ah_sq_a !< The square of the biharmonic viscosity [L8 T-2 ~> m8 s-2]
8127 ! Local variables
8128 type(hv_host_ctx), pointer :: ctx ! The objects behind host
8129 type(ocean_grid_type), pointer :: G ! The ocean's grid structure.
81300 type(RealArray_t) :: layer_a ! One layer of the field being smoothed [arbitrary]
81310 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: Ah_sq
8132 integer :: kk
8133
81340 call c_f_pointer(host, ctx)
81350 G => ctx%G
8136
81370 call Ah_sq_a%view(Ah_sq)
8138
81390 do kk=1,kmax
81400 call pass_var(Ah_sq(:,:,kk), G%Domain, halo=2)
8141 ! A single call smoothes twice.
8142 call layer_a%alloc(lb=Ah_sq_a%lb(1:2), ub=Ah_sq_a%ub(1:2), &
81430 source=Ah_sq(:,:,kk))
81440 call smooth_x9_h(Gcore, bxH0, layer_a, zero_land=.false.)
81450 call layer_a%copy2F(Ah_sq(:,:,kk)) ; call layer_a%free()
81460 call pass_var(Ah_sq(:,:,kk), G%Domain)
8147 enddo

81490end subroutine hor_visc_Leithy_Ah_sq_smooth_host

8151!> Returns the effective k-block size for horizontal_viscosity calls.

8157
8158!> Calculates the barotropic tension and shearing strain fields and the GME
8159!! efficiency and isopycnal height diffusivity fields that are used within
8160!! horizontal_viscosity when GME (CS%use_GME) is active. The caller must
8161!! only invoke this routine when CS%use_GME is true.
81620subroutine hor_visc_GME_setup(G, GV, US, CS, Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, h, BT, TD, nkblock, dudx_bt, &
81630 dvdy_bt, dvdx_bt, dudy_bt, sh_xx_bt, sh_xy_bt, GME_effic_h, &
81640 GME_effic_q, KH_u_GME, KH_v_GME, GME_coeff_h, GME_coeff_q, &
81650 str_xx_GME, str_xy_GME)
8166 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
8167 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure.
8168 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
8169 type(hor_visc_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Horizontal viscosity control structure
8170 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
8171 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
8172 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
8173 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ0 !< The B-grid-index box of the whole column,
8174 !! [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
8175 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
8176 intent(inout) :: h !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
8177 type(barotropic_CS), optional, intent(in) :: BT !< Barotropic control structure
8178 type(thickness_diffuse_CS), optional, intent(in) :: TD !< Thickness diffusion control structure
8179 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The k-block size used to size the following arrays [nondim]
8180 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)), &
8181 intent(out) :: dudx_bt !< x-component in the barotropic
8182 !! horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
8183 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)), &
8184 intent(out) :: dvdy_bt !< y-component in the barotropic
8185 !! horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
8186 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G)), &
8187 intent(out) :: dvdx_bt !< x-component in the barotropic
8188 !! shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
8189 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G)), &
8190 intent(out) :: dudy_bt !< y-component in the barotropic
8191 !! shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
8192 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), &
8193 intent(out) :: sh_xx_bt !< Barotropic horizontal tension
8194 !! (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
8195 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G)), &
8196 intent(out) :: sh_xy_bt !< Barotropic horizontal shearing strain
8197 !! (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
8198 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), &
8199 intent(out) :: GME_effic_h !< The filtered efficiency of the
8200 !! GME terms at h points [nondim]
8201 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G)), &
8202 intent(out) :: GME_effic_q !< The filtered efficiency of the
8203 !! GME terms at q points [nondim]
8204 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(GV)+1), &
8205 intent(out) :: KH_u_GME !< Isopycnal height diffusivities in
8206 !! u-columns [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
8207 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)+1), &
8208 intent(out) :: KH_v_GME !< Isopycnal height diffusivities in
8209 !! v-columns [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
8210 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),SZK_(G)), &
8211 intent(out) :: GME_coeff_h !< GME coefficient at h-points
8212 !! [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
8213 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G),SZK_(GV)), &
8214 intent(out) :: GME_coeff_q !< GME coeff. at q-points [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
8215 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G),nkblock), &
8216 intent(out) :: str_xx_GME !< Smoothed diagonal term in the
8217 !! stress tensor from GME [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
8218 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G),nkblock), &
8219 intent(out) :: str_xy_GME !< Smoothed cross term in the
8220 !! stress tensor from GME [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
8221 ! Local variables
82220 type(RealArray_t) :: h_a, ubtav_a, vbtav_a, dudx_bt_a, dvdy_bt_a, dvdx_bt_a, dudy_bt_a, &
82230 sh_xx_bt_a, sh_xy_bt_a, GME_effic_h_a, GME_effic_q_a
8224 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G)) :: &
82250 ubtav ! zonal barotropic velocity averaged over a baroclinic time-step [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8226 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)) :: &
82270 vbtav ! meridional barotropic velocity averaged over a baroclinic time-step [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8228
8229 ! Initialize diagnostic arrays with zeros
82300 GME_coeff_h(:,:,:) = 0.0
82310 GME_coeff_q(:,:,:) = 0.0
82320 str_xx_GME(:,:,:) = 0.0
82330 str_xy_GME(:,:,:) = 0.0
8234
8235 ! Get barotropic velocities and their gradients
82360 call barotropic_get_tav(BT, ubtav, vbtav, G, US)
8237
82380 call pass_vector(ubtav, vbtav, G%Domain)
82390 call pass_var(h, G%domain, halo=2)
8240
8241 call h_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(h), ub=UBOUND(h), &
82420 source=h)
8243 call ubtav_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(ubtav), ub=UBOUND(ubtav), &
82440 source=ubtav)
8245 call vbtav_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(vbtav), ub=UBOUND(vbtav), &
82460 source=vbtav)
8247 call dudx_bt_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(dudx_bt), ub=UBOUND(dudx_bt), &
82480 source=dudx_bt)
8249 call dvdy_bt_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(dvdy_bt), ub=UBOUND(dvdy_bt), &
82500 source=dvdy_bt)
8251 call dvdx_bt_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(dvdx_bt), ub=UBOUND(dvdx_bt), &
82520 source=dvdx_bt)
8253 call dudy_bt_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(dudy_bt), ub=UBOUND(dudy_bt), &
82540 source=dudy_bt)
8255 call sh_xx_bt_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(sh_xx_bt), ub=UBOUND(sh_xx_bt), &
82560 source=sh_xx_bt)
8257 call sh_xy_bt_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(sh_xy_bt), ub=UBOUND(sh_xy_bt), &
82580 source=sh_xy_bt)
8259 call GME_effic_h_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(GME_effic_h), ub=UBOUND(GME_effic_h), &
82600 source=GME_effic_h)
8261 call GME_effic_q_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(GME_effic_q), ub=UBOUND(GME_effic_q), &
82620 source=GME_effic_q)
8263 call hor_visc_GME_bt(Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, CS%hv_opts_CS, CS%hv_metrics_CS, h_a, ubtav_a, vbtav_a, &
8264 dudx_bt_a, dvdy_bt_a, dvdx_bt_a, dudy_bt_a, sh_xx_bt_a, sh_xy_bt_a, &
82650 GME_effic_h_a, GME_effic_q_a)
82660 call h_a%copy2F(h) ; call dudx_bt_a%copy2F(dudx_bt) ; call dvdy_bt_a%copy2F(dvdy_bt)
82670 call dvdx_bt_a%copy2F(dvdx_bt) ; call dudy_bt_a%copy2F(dudy_bt)
82680 call sh_xx_bt_a%copy2F(sh_xx_bt) ; call sh_xy_bt_a%copy2F(sh_xy_bt)
82690 call GME_effic_h_a%copy2F(GME_effic_h) ; call GME_effic_q_a%copy2F(GME_effic_q)
82700 call h_a%free() ; call ubtav_a%free() ; call vbtav_a%free() ; call dudx_bt_a%free()
82710 call dvdy_bt_a%free() ; call dvdx_bt_a%free() ; call dudy_bt_a%free() ; call sh_xx_bt_a%free()
82720 call sh_xy_bt_a%free() ; call GME_effic_h_a%free() ; call GME_effic_q_a%free()
8273
82740 call thickness_diffuse_get_KH(TD, KH_u_GME, KH_v_GME, G, GV)
8275
82760 call pass_vector(KH_u_GME, KH_v_GME, G%domain, To_All+Scalar_Pair)
8277
82780 if (CS%hv_opts_CS%debug) &
82790 call uvchksum("GME KH[u,v]_GME", KH_u_GME, KH_v_GME, G%HI, haloshift=2, unscale=US%L_to_m**2*US%s_to_T)
8280
82810end subroutine hor_visc_GME_setup
8282
8283!> Calculates the barotropic tension and shearing strain fields and the GME efficiency
8284!! fields from the barotropic velocities, for use within horizontal_viscosity when GME
8285!! (CS%use_GME) is active.
82860subroutine hor_visc_GME_bt_fortran(Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, CS, metrics, h_a, ubtav_a, vbtav_a, dudx_bt_a, dvdy_bt_a, &
8287 dvdx_bt_a, dudy_bt_a, sh_xx_bt_a, sh_xy_bt_a, GME_effic_h_a, GME_effic_q_a)
8288 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
8289 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
8290 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
8291 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ0 !< The B-grid-index box of the whole column,
8292 !! [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
8293 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
8294 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
8295 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
8296 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
8297 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: ubtav_a !< zonal barotropic velocity averaged over a baroclinic
8298 !! time-step [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8299 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vbtav_a !< meridional barotropic velocity averaged over a baroclinic
8300 !! time-step [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8301 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudx_bt_a !< x-component in the barotropic
8302 !! horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
8303 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdy_bt_a !< y-component in the barotropic
8304 !! horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
8305 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdx_bt_a !< x-component in the barotropic
8306 !! shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
8307 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudy_bt_a !< y-component in the barotropic
8308 !! shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
8309 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_bt_a !< Barotropic horizontal tension
8310 !! (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
8311 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_bt_a !< Barotropic horizontal shearing strain
8312 !! (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
8313 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_effic_h_a !< The filtered efficiency of the
8314 !! GME terms at h points [nondim]
8315 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_effic_q_a !< The filtered efficiency of the
8316 !! GME terms at q points [nondim]
8317 ! Local variables
83180 type(Box_t) :: bxQ0dvdx ! q points [Isq-2:Ieq+2, Jsq-2:Jeq+2] where dvdx_bt and dudy_bt are computed: GME_effic_h over
8319 ! bxH0grad averages them from the four surrounding q points
83200 type(Box_t) :: bxH0grad ! h points [Isq-1:Ieq+2, Jsq-1:Jeq+2] where sh_xx_bt and GME_effic_h are computed: the range
8321 ! over which hor_visc_q_coeffs builds str_xx_GME (bxHgrad); built from bxQ0 because the range
8322 ! is set in q indices
83230 type(Box_t) :: bxH0dudx ! h points [is-2:ie+2, js-2:je+2] where dudx_bt, dvdy_bt and htot are computed: GME_effic_q
8324 ! over bxQ0shear averages them from the four surrounding h points
83250 type(Box_t) :: bxQ0shear ! q points [is-2:ie+1, js-2:je+1] where sh_xy_bt and GME_effic_q are computed: the range over
8326 ! which hor_visc_q_coeffs builds str_xy_GME (bxQshear); built from bxH0 because the range
8327 ! starts at is-2 in both memory modes
83280 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: GME_effic_q, GME_effic_h, sh_xy_bt, sh_xx_bt, &
83290 dudy_bt, dvdx_bt, dvdy_bt, dudx_bt, vbtav, ubtav
83300 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: IdyCu, IdxCv, IdyCv, IdxCu, mask2dBu, mask2dCu, &
83310 mask2dCv, mask2dT
83320 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: h
83330 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: dx_dyT, dy_dxT, dx_dyBu, dy_dxBu
8334 real, dimension(h_a%lb(1):h_a%ub(1),h_a%lb(2):h_a%ub(2)) :: &
83350 htot ! The total thickness of all layers [H ~> m or kg m-2]
8336 real :: grad_vel_mag_bt_h ! Magnitude of the barotropic velocity gradient tensor squared at h-points [T-2 ~> s-2]
8337 real :: boundary_mask_h ! A mask that zeroes out cells with at least one land edge [nondim]
8338 real :: grad_vel_mag_bt_q ! Magnitude of the barotropic velocity gradient tensor squared at q-points [T-2 ~> s-2]
8339 real :: boundary_mask_q ! A mask that zeroes out cells with at least one land edge [nondim]
8340 real :: h_arith_q ! The arithmetic mean total thickness at q points [H ~> m or kg m-2]
8341 real :: I_GME_h0 ! The inverse of GME tapering scale [H-1 ~> m-1 or m2 kg-1]
8342 integer :: i, j, k, nz
8343
83440 call GME_effic_q_a%view(GME_effic_q) ; call GME_effic_h_a%view(GME_effic_h)
83450 call sh_xy_bt_a%view(sh_xy_bt) ; call sh_xx_bt_a%view(sh_xx_bt) ; call dudy_bt_a%view(dudy_bt)
83460 call dvdx_bt_a%view(dvdx_bt) ; call dvdy_bt_a%view(dvdy_bt) ; call dudx_bt_a%view(dudx_bt)
83470 call vbtav_a%view(vbtav) ; call ubtav_a%view(ubtav) ; call h_a%view(h)
83480 call Gcore%IdyCu%view(IdyCu) ; call Gcore%IdxCv%view(IdxCv) ; call Gcore%IdyCv%view(IdyCv)
83490 call Gcore%IdxCu%view(IdxCu) ; call Gcore%mask2dBu%view(mask2dBu)
83500 call Gcore%mask2dCu%view(mask2dCu) ; call Gcore%mask2dCv%view(mask2dCv)
83510 call Gcore%mask2dT%view(mask2dT)
8352
83530 nullify(dx_dyT, dy_dxT, dx_dyBu, dy_dxBu)
83540 if (metrics%dx_dyT%associated()) call metrics%dx_dyT%view(dx_dyT)
83550 if (metrics%dy_dxT%associated()) call metrics%dy_dxT%view(dy_dxT)
83560 if (metrics%dx_dyBu%associated()) call metrics%dx_dyBu%view(dx_dyBu)
83570 if (metrics%dy_dxBu%associated()) call metrics%dy_dxBu%view(dy_dxBu)
8358
83590 nz = bxH0%idxE(3)
83600 bxQ0dvdx = bxQ0%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[2,2,0])
83610 bxH0grad = bxQ0%growBy(lo=[1,1,0], hi=[2,2,0])
83620 bxH0dudx = bxH0%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[2,2,0])
83630 bxQ0shear = bxH0%growBy(lo=[2,2,0], hi=[1,1,0])
8364
8365 ! Calculate the barotropic horizontal tension
83660 do concurrent (j=bxH0dudx%idxS(2):bxH0dudx%idxE(2), i=bxH0dudx%idxS(1):bxH0dudx%idxE(1))
8367 dudx_bt(i,j) = DY_dxT(i,j)*((IdyCu(I,j) * ubtav(I,j)) - &
83680 (IdyCu(I-1,j) * ubtav(I-1,j)))
8369 dvdy_bt(i,j) = DX_dyT(i,j)*((IdxCv(i,J) * vbtav(i,J)) - &
83700 (IdxCv(i,J-1) * vbtav(i,J-1)))
8371 enddo
83720 do concurrent (j=bxH0grad%idxS(2):bxH0grad%idxE(2), i=bxH0grad%idxS(1):bxH0grad%idxE(1))
83730 sh_xx_bt(i,j) = dudx_bt(i,j) - dvdy_bt(i,j)
8374 enddo
8375
8376 ! Components for the barotropic shearing strain
83770 do concurrent (J=bxQ0dvdx%idxS(2):bxQ0dvdx%idxE(2), I=bxQ0dvdx%idxS(1):bxQ0dvdx%idxE(1))
8378 dvdx_bt(I,J) = DY_dxBu(I,J)*((vbtav(i+1,J)*IdyCv(i+1,J)) &
83790 - (vbtav(i,J)*IdyCv(i,J)))
8380 dudy_bt(I,J) = DX_dyBu(I,J)*((ubtav(I,j+1)*IdxCu(I,j+1)) &
83810 - (ubtav(I,j)*IdxCu(I,j)))
8382 enddo
8383
83840 if (CS%no_slip) then
83850 do concurrent (J=bxQ0shear%idxS(2):bxQ0shear%idxE(2), I=bxQ0shear%idxS(1):bxQ0shear%idxE(1))
83860 sh_xy_bt(I,J) = (2.0-mask2dBu(I,J)) * ( dvdx_bt(I,J) + dudy_bt(I,J) )
8387 enddo
8388 else
83890 do concurrent (J=bxQ0shear%idxS(2):bxQ0shear%idxE(2), I=bxQ0shear%idxS(1):bxQ0shear%idxE(1))
83900 sh_xy_bt(I,J) = mask2dBu(I,J) * ( dvdx_bt(I,J) + dudy_bt(I,J) )
8391 enddo
8392 endif
8393
83940 do concurrent (j=bxH0dudx%idxS(2):bxH0dudx%idxE(2), i=bxH0dudx%idxS(1):bxH0dudx%idxE(1))
83950 htot(i,j) = 0.0
8396 enddo
83970 do concurrent (j=bxH0dudx%idxS(2):bxH0dudx%idxE(2), i=bxH0dudx%idxS(1):bxH0dudx%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(k))
83980 do k=1,nz
83990 htot(i,j) = htot(i,j) + h(i,j,k)
8400 enddo ; enddo
8401
84020 I_GME_h0 = 1.0 / CS%GME_h0
8403 do concurrent (j=bxH0grad%idxS(2):bxH0grad%idxE(2), &
84040 i=bxH0grad%idxS(1):bxH0grad%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(boundary_mask_h, grad_vel_mag_bt_h))
84050 boundary_mask_h = (mask2dCu(I,j) * mask2dCu(I-1,j)) * (mask2dCv(i,J) * mask2dCv(i,J-1))
8406 grad_vel_mag_bt_h = mask2dT(I,J) * boundary_mask_h * (dudx_bt(i,j)**2 + dvdy_bt(i,j)**2 + &
8407 (0.25*((dvdx_bt(I,J)+dvdx_bt(I-1,J-1)) + (dvdx_bt(I,J-1)+dvdx_bt(I-1,J))))**2 + &
84080 (0.25*((dudy_bt(I,J)+dudy_bt(I-1,J-1)) + (dudy_bt(I,J-1)+dudy_bt(I-1,J))))**2)
8409 ! Probably the following test could be simplified to
8410 ! if (boundary_mask_h * G%mask2dT(I,J) > 0.0) then
84110 if (grad_vel_mag_bt_h > 0.0) then
84120 GME_effic_h(i,j) = CS%GME_efficiency * mask2dT(I,J) * (MIN(htot(i,j) * I_GME_h0, 1.0)**2)
8413 else
84140 GME_effic_h(i,j) = 0.0
8415 endif
8416 enddo
8417
8418 do concurrent (J=bxQ0shear%idxS(2):bxQ0shear%idxE(2), &
8419 I=bxQ0shear%idxS(1):bxQ0shear%idxE(1)) &
84200 DO_LOCALITY(local(boundary_mask_q, grad_vel_mag_bt_q, h_arith_q))
84210 boundary_mask_q = (mask2dCv(i,J) * mask2dCv(i+1,J)) * (mask2dCu(I,j) * mask2dCu(I,j+1))
8422 grad_vel_mag_bt_q = mask2dBu(I,J) * boundary_mask_q * (dvdx_bt(I,J)**2 + dudy_bt(I,J)**2 + &
8423 (0.25*((dudx_bt(i,j)+dudx_bt(i+1,j+1)) + (dudx_bt(i,j+1)+dudx_bt(i+1,j))))**2 + &
84240 (0.25*((dvdy_bt(i,j)+dvdy_bt(i+1,j+1)) + (dvdy_bt(i,j+1)+dvdy_bt(i+1,j))))**2)
8425 ! Probably the following test could be simplified to
8426 ! if (boundary_mask_q * G%mask2dBu(I,J) > 0.0) then
84270 if (grad_vel_mag_bt_q > 0.0) then
84280 h_arith_q = 0.25 * ((htot(i,j) + htot(i+1,j+1)) + (htot(i+1,j) + htot(i,j+1)))
84290 GME_effic_q(I,J) = CS%GME_efficiency * mask2dBu(I,J) * (MIN(h_arith_q * I_GME_h0, 1.0)**2)
8430 else
84310 GME_effic_q(I,J) = 0.0
8432 endif
8433 enddo
8434
84350 call bxH0dudx%free() ; call bxQ0shear%free()
84360 call bxQ0dvdx%free() ; call bxH0grad%free()
84370end subroutine hor_visc_GME_bt_fortran
8438
8439!> Dispatches hor_visc_GME_bt to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
8440!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by HOR_VISC_GME_BT_MODE.
84410subroutine hor_visc_GME_bt(Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, CS, metrics, h_a, ubtav_a, vbtav_a, dudx_bt_a, &
8442 dvdy_bt_a, dvdx_bt_a, dudy_bt_a, sh_xx_bt_a, sh_xy_bt_a, GME_effic_h_a, &
8443 GME_effic_q_a)
8444 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
8445 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
8446 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
8447 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ0 !< The B-grid-index box of the whole column,
8448 !! [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
8449 type(hv_opts_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Options used by the horizontal viscosity kernels
8450 type(hv_metrics_CS), intent(in) :: metrics !< Persistent copies of the horizontal
8451 !! viscosity metric and coefficient arrays
8452 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: h_a !< Layer thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2].
8453 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: ubtav_a !< zonal barotropic velocity averaged over a baroclinic
8454 !! time-step [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8455 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vbtav_a !< meridional barotropic velocity averaged over a baroclinic
8456 !! time-step [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8457 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudx_bt_a !< x-component in the barotropic
8458 !! horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
8459 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdy_bt_a !< y-component in the barotropic
8460 !! horizontal tension [T-1 ~> s-1]
8461 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dvdx_bt_a !< x-component in the barotropic
8462 !! shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
8463 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: dudy_bt_a !< y-component in the barotropic
8464 !! shearing strain [T-1 ~> s-1]
8465 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xx_bt_a !< Barotropic horizontal tension
8466 !! (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
8467 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: sh_xy_bt_a !< Barotropic horizontal shearing strain
8468 !! (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
8469 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_effic_h_a !< The filtered efficiency of the
8470 !! GME terms at h points [nondim]
8471 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_effic_q_a !< The filtered efficiency of the
8472 !! GME terms at q points [nondim]
8473
8474 ! Local variables
8475 integer :: mode, rc
84760 type(io_recorder) :: rec
8477 logical :: capture
8478 character(len=80) :: kernel
8479 character(len=100) :: dir
8480 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
8481 type(Box_C) :: bxH0_c
8482 type(Box_C) :: bxQ0_c
8483 type(hv_opts_CS_C) :: CS_c
8484 type(hv_metrics_CS_C) :: metrics_c
8485 type(RealArray_C) :: h_c
8486 type(RealArray_C) :: ubtav_c
8487 type(RealArray_C) :: vbtav_c
8488 type(RealArray_C) :: dudx_bt_c
8489 type(RealArray_C) :: dvdy_bt_c
8490 type(RealArray_C) :: dvdx_bt_c
8491 type(RealArray_C) :: dudy_bt_c
8492 type(RealArray_C) :: sh_xx_bt_c
8493 type(RealArray_C) :: sh_xy_bt_c
8494 type(RealArray_C) :: GME_effic_h_c
8495 type(RealArray_C) :: GME_effic_q_c
8496
84970 kernel = "hor_visc_gme_bt"
84980 mode = getenv_mode("HOR_VISC_GME_BT_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
8499
85000 select case (mode)
8501
8502 case (TIMH_capture)
85030 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
85040 if (capture) then
85050 dir = "capture"
85060 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
85070 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
85080 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
85090 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
85100 call rec%add("_IdyCu", Gcore%IdyCu)
85110 call rec%add("_IdxCv", Gcore%IdxCv)
85120 call rec%add("_IdyCv", Gcore%IdyCv)
85130 call rec%add("_IdxCu", Gcore%IdxCu)
85140 call rec%add("_mask2dBu", Gcore%mask2dBu)
85150 call rec%add("_mask2dCu", Gcore%mask2dCu)
85160 call rec%add("_mask2dCv", Gcore%mask2dCv)
85170 call rec%add("_mask2dT", Gcore%mask2dT)
85180 call rec%add("_bxH0", bxH0)
85190 call rec%add("_bxQ0", bxQ0)
85200 call record_hv_opts_CS(rec, "_CS", CS)
85210 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "")
85220 call record_hv_metrics_CS(rec, "_metrics", metrics, "_before")
85230 call rec%add("_h_before", h_a)
85240 call rec%add("_ubtav", ubtav_a)
85250 call rec%add("_vbtav", vbtav_a)
85260 call rec%add("_dudx_bt_before", dudx_bt_a)
85270 call rec%add("_dvdy_bt_before", dvdy_bt_a)
85280 call rec%add("_dvdx_bt_before", dvdx_bt_a)
85290 call rec%add("_dudy_bt_before", dudy_bt_a)
85300 call rec%add("_sh_xx_bt_before", sh_xx_bt_a)
85310 call rec%add("_sh_xy_bt_before", sh_xy_bt_a)
85320 call rec%add("_GME_effic_h_before", GME_effic_h_a)
85330 call rec%add("_GME_effic_q_before", GME_effic_q_a)
8534 endif
8535
8536 call hor_visc_GME_bt_fortran(Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, CS, metrics, h_a, ubtav_a, vbtav_a, dudx_bt_a, dvdy_bt_a, &
85370 dvdx_bt_a, dudy_bt_a, sh_xx_bt_a, sh_xy_bt_a, GME_effic_h_a, GME_effic_q_a)
8538
85390 if (capture) then
85400 call rec%add("_h_after", h_a)
85410 call rec%add("_dudx_bt_after", dudx_bt_a)
85420 call rec%add("_dvdy_bt_after", dvdy_bt_a)
85430 call rec%add("_dvdx_bt_after", dvdx_bt_a)
85440 call rec%add("_dudy_bt_after", dudy_bt_a)
85450 call rec%add("_sh_xx_bt_after", sh_xx_bt_a)
85460 call rec%add("_sh_xy_bt_after", sh_xy_bt_a)
85470 call rec%add("_GME_effic_h_after", GME_effic_h_a)
85480 call rec%add("_GME_effic_q_after", GME_effic_q_a)
85490 call rec%close()
85500 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
8551 endif
8552
8553#ifdef _TIM
8554 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
8555 bxH0_c = bxH0%to_c()
8556 bxQ0_c = bxQ0%to_c()
8557 CS_c = hv_opts_CS_to_c(CS)
8558 metrics_c = hv_metrics_CS_to_c(metrics)
8559 h_c = h_a%to_c()
8560 ubtav_c = ubtav_a%to_c()
8561 vbtav_c = vbtav_a%to_c()
8562 dudx_bt_c = dudx_bt_a%to_c()
8563 dvdy_bt_c = dvdy_bt_a%to_c()
8564 dvdx_bt_c = dvdx_bt_a%to_c()
8565 dudy_bt_c = dudy_bt_a%to_c()
8566 sh_xx_bt_c = sh_xx_bt_a%to_c()
8567 sh_xy_bt_c = sh_xy_bt_a%to_c()
8568 GME_effic_h_c = GME_effic_h_a%to_c()
8569 GME_effic_q_c = GME_effic_q_a%to_c()
8570 call turbotmp_hor_visc_gme_bt_bridge(Gcore%C, bxH0_c, bxQ0_c, CS_c, metrics_c, h_c, ubtav_c, vbtav_c, dudx_bt_c, &
8571 dvdy_bt_c, dvdx_bt_c, dudy_bt_c, sh_xx_bt_c, sh_xy_bt_c, GME_effic_h_c, &
8572 GME_effic_q_c)
8573#endif
8574
8575 case default
8576 call hor_visc_GME_bt_fortran(Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, CS, metrics, h_a, ubtav_a, vbtav_a, dudx_bt_a, dvdy_bt_a, &
85770 dvdx_bt_a, dudy_bt_a, sh_xx_bt_a, sh_xy_bt_a, GME_effic_h_a, GME_effic_q_a)
8578
8579 end select
8580
85810end subroutine hor_visc_GME_bt
8582
8583!> Allocates space for and calculates static variables used by horizontal_viscosity.
8584!! hor_visc_init calculates and stores the values of a number of metric functions that
8585!! are used in horizontal_viscosity.
85861subroutine hor_visc_init(Time, G, GV, US, param_file, diag, CS, ADp)
8587 type(time_type), intent(in) :: Time !< Current model time.
8588 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(inout) :: G !< The ocean's grid structure.
8589 type(verticalGrid_type), intent(in) :: GV !< The ocean's vertical grid structure
8590 type(unit_scale_type), intent(in) :: US !< A dimensional unit scaling type
8591 type(param_file_type), intent(in) :: param_file !< A structure to parse for run-time
8592 !! parameters.
8593 type(diag_ctrl), target, intent(inout) :: diag !< Structure to regulate diagnostic output.
8594 type(hor_visc_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Horizontal viscosity control structure
8595 type(accel_diag_ptrs), intent(in), optional :: ADp !< Acceleration diagnostics
8596
8597 ! u0v is the Laplacian sensitivities to the v velocities at u points, with u0u, v0u, and v0v defined analogously.
85983 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJ_(G)) :: u0u, u0v ! Laplacian sensitivities at u points [L-2 ~> m-2]
85991 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJB_(G)) :: v0u, v0v ! Laplacian sensitivities at v points [L-2 ~> m-2]
8600 real :: grid_sp_h2 ! Harmonic mean of the squares of the grid [L2 ~> m2]
8601 real :: grid_sp_h3 ! Harmonic mean of the squares of the grid^(3/2) [L3 ~> m3]
8602 real :: grid_sp_q2 ! spacings at h and q points [L2 ~> m2]
8603 real :: grid_sp_q3 ! spacings at h and q points^(3/2) [L3 ~> m3]
8604 real :: min_grid_sp_h2 ! Minimum value of grid_sp_h2 [L2 ~> m2]
8605 real :: min_grid_sp_h4 ! Minimum value of grid_sp_h2**2 [L4 ~> m4]
8606 real :: Kh_Limit ! A coefficient [T-1 ~> s-1] used, along with the
8607 ! grid spacing, to limit Laplacian viscosity.
8608 real :: fmax ! maximum absolute value of f at the four
8609 ! vorticity points around a thickness point [T-1 ~> s-1]
8610 real :: BoundCorConst ! A constant used when using viscosity to bound the Coriolis accelerations
8611 ! [T2 L-2 ~> s2 m-2]
8612 real :: Ah_Limit ! coefficient [T-1 ~> s-1] used, along with the
8613 ! grid spacing, to limit biharmonic viscosity
8614 real :: Kh ! Lapacian horizontal viscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
8615 real :: Ah ! biharmonic horizontal viscosity [L4 T-1 ~> m4 s-1]
8616 real :: Kh_vel_scale ! this speed [L T-1 ~> m s-1] times grid spacing gives Laplacian viscosity
8617 real :: Ah_vel_scale ! this speed [L T-1 ~> m s-1] times grid spacing cubed gives biharmonic viscosity
8618 real :: Ah_time_scale ! damping time-scale for biharmonic visc [T ~> s]
8619 real :: Smag_Lap_const ! nondimensional Laplacian Smagorinsky constant [nondim]
8620 real :: Smag_bi_const ! nondimensional biharmonic Smagorinsky constant [nondim]
8621 real :: Leith_Lap_const ! nondimensional Laplacian Leith constant [nondim]
8622 real :: Leith_bi_const ! nondimensional biharmonic Leith constant [nondim]
8623 real :: dt ! The dynamics time step [T ~> s]
8624 real :: Idt ! The inverse of dt [T-1 ~> s-1]
8625 real :: denom ! work variable; the denominator of a fraction [L-2 ~> m-2] or [L-4 ~> m-4]
8626 real :: maxvel ! largest permitted velocity components [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8627 real :: bound_Cor_vel ! grid-scale velocity variations at which value
8628 ! the quadratically varying biharmonic viscosity
8629 ! balances Coriolis acceleration [L T-1 ~> m s-1]
8630 real :: Kh_sin_lat ! Amplitude of latitudinally dependent viscosity [L2 T-1 ~> m2 s-1]
8631 real :: Kh_pwr_of_sine ! Power used to raise sin(lat) when using Kh_sin_lat [nondim]
8632 logical :: bound_Cor_def ! parameter setting of BOUND_CORIOLIS
8633 logical :: split ! If true, use the split time stepping scheme.
8634 ! If false and USE_GME = True, issue a FATAL error.
8635 logical :: use_MEKE ! If true, the MEKE parameterization is in use.
8636 logical :: enable_bugs ! If true, the defaults for recently added bug-fix flags are set to
8637 ! recreate the bugs, or if false bugs are only used if actively selected.
8638 real :: backscatter_Ro_c ! Coefficient in Rossby number function for backscatter [nondim]
8639 integer :: default_answer_date ! The default setting for the various ANSWER_DATE flags
8640 character(len=200) :: inputdir, filename ! Input file names and paths
8641 character(len=80) :: Kh_var ! Input variable names
8642 real :: deg2rad ! Converts degrees to radians [radians degree-1]
8643 real :: slat_fn ! sin(lat)**Kh_pwr_of_sine [nondim]
8644 real :: aniso_grid_dir(2) ! Vector (n1,n2) for anisotropic direction [nondim]
8645 integer :: aniso_mode ! Selects the mode for setting the anisotropic direction
8646 integer :: is, ie, js, je, Isq, Ieq, Jsq, Jeq, nz
8647 integer :: isd, ied, jsd, jed, IsdB, IedB, JsdB, JedB
8648 integer :: i, j
8649#ifdef __NVCOMPILER_OPENMP_GPU
8650 integer, parameter :: default_nkblock = 0
8651#else
8652 integer, parameter :: default_nkblock = 1
8653#endif
8654 ! This include declares and sets the variable "version".
8655# include "version_variable.h"
8656 character(len=40) :: mdl = "MOM_hor_visc" ! module name
86571 is = G%isc ; ie = G%iec ; js = G%jsc ; je = G%jec ; nz = GV%ke
86581 Isq = G%IscB ; Ieq = G%IecB ; Jsq = G%JscB ; Jeq = G%JecB
86591 isd = G%isd ; ied = G%ied ; jsd = G%jsd ; jed = G%jed
86601 IsdB = G%IsdB ; IedB = G%IedB ; JsdB = G%JsdB ; JedB = G%JedB
8661
8662 ! init control structure
86631 call ZB2020_init(Time, G, GV, US, param_file, diag, CS%ZB2020, CS%hv_opts_CS%use_ZB2020)
8664
86651 CS%initialized = .true.
8666
86671 CS%diag => diag
8668 ! Read parameters and write them to the model log.
86691 call log_version(param_file, mdl, version, "")
8670
8671 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "HORVISC_NKBLOCK", CS%nkblock, &
8672 "The k-direction block size used in horizontal viscosity calculations. "//&
8673 "The default 0 setting dynamically uses the full vertical column.", &
86741 default=default_nkblock, layoutParam=.true.)
86751 if (CS%nkblock < 0) call MOM_error(FATAL, "HORVISC_NKBLOCK must be >= 0.")
8676
8677 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "USE_CIRCULATION_IN_HORVISC", CS%hv_opts_CS%use_circulation, &
8678 "Use circulation theorem to compute vorticity in horvisc module (for ZB20 or Leith)", &
86791 default=.False.)
8680
8681 ! All parameters are read in all cases to enable parameter spelling checks.
8682 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "DEFAULT_ANSWER_DATE", default_answer_date, &
8683 "This sets the default value for the various _ANSWER_DATE parameters.", &
86841 default=99991231)
8685
8686 ! Determine whether HOR_VISC_ANSWER_DATE is used, and avoid logging it if it is not used.
8687 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "USE_MEKE", use_MEKE, &
86881 default=.false., do_not_log=.true.)
86891 backscatter_Ro_c = 0.0
86901 if (use_MEKE) call get_param(param_file, mdl, "MEKE_BACKSCAT_RO_C", backscatter_Ro_c, &
8691 "The coefficient in the Rossby number function for scaling the biharmonic "//&
8692 "frictional energy source. Setting to non-zero enables the Rossby number function.", &
86931 units="nondim", default=0.0, do_not_log=.true.)
8694
8695 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "HOR_VISC_ANSWER_DATE", CS%hv_opts_CS%answer_date, &
8696 "The vintage of the order of arithmetic and expressions in the horizontal "//&
8697 "viscosity calculations. Values between 20190102 and 20241201 recover the "//&
8698 "answers from the end of 2018, while higher values use updated and more robust "//&
8699 "forms of the same expressions.", &
87001 default=default_answer_date, do_not_log=(.not.GV%Boussinesq).or.(backscatter_Ro_c==0.0))
87011 if (.not.GV%Boussinesq) CS%hv_opts_CS%answer_date = max(CS%hv_opts_CS%answer_date, 20241201)
8702
87031 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "DEBUG", CS%hv_opts_CS%debug, default=.false.)
8704 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "USE_CONT_THICKNESS", CS%hv_opts_CS%use_cont_thick, &
8705 "If true, use thickness at velocity points from continuity solver. This option "//&
87061 "currently only works with split mode.", default=.false.)
8707 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "USE_CONT_THICKNESS_BUG", CS%use_cont_thick_bug, &
8708 "If true, retain an answer-changing halo update bug when "//&
8709 "USE_CONT_THICKNESS=True. This is not recommended.", &
87101 default=.false., do_not_log=.not.CS%hv_opts_CS%use_cont_thick)
8711
8712 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "LAPLACIAN", CS%hv_opts_CS%Laplacian, &
8713 "If true, use a Laplacian horizontal viscosity.", &
87141 default=.false.)
8715
8716 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "KH", Kh, &
8717 "The background Laplacian horizontal viscosity.", &
8718 units="m2 s-1", default=0.0, scale=US%m_to_L**2*US%T_to_s, &
87191 do_not_log=.not.CS%hv_opts_CS%Laplacian)
8720 call get_param(param_file, mdl, "KH_BG_MIN", CS%hv_opts_CS%Kh_bg_min, &

9318 u0u(I,j) = ((CS%Idxdy2u(I,j)*((CS%dy2h(i+1,j)*CS%DY_dxT(i+1,j)*(G%IdyCu(I+1,j) + G%IdyCu(I,j))) + &
9319 (CS%dy2h(i,j) * CS%DY_dxT(i,j) * (G%IdyCu(I,j) + G%IdyCu(I-1,j))) )) + &
9320 (CS%Idx2dyCu(I,j)*((CS%dx2q(I,J) * CS%DX_dyBu(I,J) * (G%IdxCu(I,j+1) + G%IdxCu(I,j))) + &
93217626 (CS%dx2q(I,J-1)*CS%DX_dyBu(I,J-1)*(G%IdxCu(I,j) + G%IdxCu(I,j-1))) )) )
9322 u0v(I,j) = ((CS%Idxdy2u(I,j)*((CS%dy2h(i+1,j)*CS%DX_dyT(i+1,j)*(G%IdxCv(i+1,J) + G%IdxCv(i+1,J-1))) + &
9323 (CS%dy2h(i,j) * CS%DX_dyT(i,j) * (G%IdxCv(i,J) + G%IdxCv(i,J-1))) )) + &
9324 (CS%Idx2dyCu(I,j)*((CS%dx2q(I,J) * CS%DY_dxBu(I,J) * (G%IdyCv(i+1,J) + G%IdyCv(i,J))) + &
93257688 (CS%dx2q(I,J-1)*CS%DY_dxBu(I,J-1)*(G%IdyCv(i+1,J-1) + G%IdyCv(i,J-1))) )) )
9326 enddo ; enddo
93277750 do J=js-2,Jeq+1 ; do i=is-1,Ieq+1
9328 v0u(i,J) = ((CS%Idxdy2v(i,J)*((CS%dy2q(I,J) * CS%DX_dyBu(I,J) * (G%IdxCu(I,j+1) + G%IdxCu(I,j))) + &

93317686 (CS%dx2h(i,j) * CS%DY_dxT(i,j) * (G%IdyCu(I,j) + G%IdyCu(I-1,j))) ) ))
9332 v0v(i,J) = ((CS%Idxdy2v(i,J)*((CS%dy2q(I,J) * CS%DY_dxBu(I,J) * (G%IdyCv(i+1,J) + G%IdyCv(i,J))) + &
9333 (CS%dy2q(I-1,J)*CS%DY_dxBu(I-1,J)*(G%IdyCv(i,J) + G%IdyCv(i-1,J))) )) + &
9334 (CS%Idx2dyCv(i,J)*((CS%dx2h(i,j+1)*CS%DX_dyT(i,j+1)*(G%IdxCv(i,J+1) + G%IdxCv(i,J))) + &
93357749 (CS%dx2h(i,j) * CS%DX_dyT(i,j) * (G%IdxCv(i,J) + G%IdxCv(i,J-1))) )) )
9336 enddo ; enddo
93377627 do j=js-1,Jeq+1 ; do i=is-1,Ieq+1
9338 denom = max( &
9339 (CS%dy2h(i,j) * &
9340 ((CS%DY_dxT(i,j)*((G%IdyCu(I,j)*u0u(I,j)) + (G%IdyCu(I-1,j)*u0u(I-1,j)))) + &
9341 (CS%DX_dyT(i,j)*((G%IdxCv(i,J)*v0u(i,J)) + (G%IdxCv(i,J-1)*v0u(i,J-1))))) * &

9343 (CS%dx2h(i,j) * &

9360 (CS%DY_dxBu(I,J)*((v0u(i+1,J)*G%IdyCv(i+1,J)) + (v0u(i,J)*G%IdyCv(i,J))))) * &

9364 (CS%DY_dxBu(I,J)*((v0v(i+1,J)*G%IdyCv(i+1,J)) + (v0v(i,J)*G%IdyCv(i,J))))) * &

9718

9725
9726!> Calculates factors in the anisotropic orientation tensor to be align with the grid.
9727!! With n1=1 and n2=0, this recovers the approach of Large et al, 2001.
97280subroutine align_aniso_tensor_to_grid(CS, n1, n2)
9729 type(hor_visc_CS), intent(inout) :: CS !< Control structure for horizontal viscosity
9730 real, intent(in) :: n1 !< i-component of direction vector [nondim]
9731 real, intent(in) :: n2 !< j-component of direction vector [nondim]
9732 ! Local variables
9733 real :: recip_n2_norm ! The inverse of the squared magnitude of n1 and n2 [nondim]
9734 ! For normalizing n=(n1,n2) in case arguments are not a unit vector
97350 recip_n2_norm = (n1**2) + (n2**2)
97360 if (recip_n2_norm > 0.) recip_n2_norm = 1. / recip_n2_norm
97370 CS%n1n2_h(:,:) = 2. * ( n1 * n2 ) * recip_n2_norm
97380 CS%n1n2_q(:,:) = 2. * ( n1 * n2 ) * recip_n2_norm
97390 CS%n1n1_m_n2n2_h(:,:) = ( (n1 * n1) - (n2 * n2) ) * recip_n2_norm
97400 CS%n1n1_m_n2n2_q(:,:) = ( (n1 * n1) - (n2 * n2) ) * recip_n2_norm
97410end subroutine align_aniso_tensor_to_grid
9742
9743!> Apply a 1-1-4-1-1 Laplacian filter one time on GME diffusive flux to reduce any
9744!! horizontal two-grid-point noise
97450subroutine smooth_GME(CS, G, Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, GME_flux_h, GME_flux_q)
9746 type(hor_visc_CS), intent(in) :: CS !< Control structure
9747 type(ocean_grid_type), intent(in) :: G !< Ocean grid
9748 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
9749 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
9750 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
9751 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ0 !< The B-grid-index box of the whole column,
9752 !! [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
9753 real, dimension(SZI_(G),SZJ_(G)), optional, intent(inout) :: GME_flux_h!< GME diffusive flux
9754 !! at h points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9755 real, dimension(SZIB_(G),SZJB_(G)), optional, intent(inout) :: GME_flux_q!< GME diffusive flux
9756 !! at q points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9757 ! local variables
97580 type(RealArray_t) :: GME_flux_h_a ! The GME diffusive flux at h points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
97590 type(RealArray_t) :: GME_flux_q_a ! The GME diffusive flux at q points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9760 integer :: s, halosz
9761 integer :: xh, xq ! The number of valid extra halo points for h and q points.
97620 type(Box_t) :: bxPass ! The range of one smoothing pass
9763
97640 xh = 0 ; xq = 0
9765
97660 do s=1,CS%num_smooth_gme
97670 if (present(GME_flux_h)) then
97680 if (xh < 0) then
9769 ! Update halos if needed, but avoid doing so more often than is needed.
97700 halosz = min(G%isc-G%isd, G%jsc-G%jsd, 2+CS%num_smooth_gme-s)
97710 call pass_var(GME_flux_h, G%Domain, halo=halosz)
97720 xh = halosz - 2
9773 endif
9774 call GME_flux_h_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(GME_flux_h), ub=UBOUND(GME_flux_h), &
97750 source=GME_flux_h)
97760 bxPass = bxQ0%growBy(lo=[xh,xh,0], hi=[1+xh,1+xh,0])
97770 call smooth_GME_h_pass(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_h_a)
97780 call bxPass%free()
97790 call GME_flux_h_a%copy2F(GME_flux_h) ; call GME_flux_h_a%free()
97800 xh = xh - 1
9781 endif
97820 if (present(GME_flux_q)) then
97830 if (xq < 0) then
9784 ! Update halos if needed, but avoid doing so more often than is needed.
97850 halosz = min(G%isc-G%isd, G%jsc-G%jsd, 2+CS%num_smooth_gme-s)
97860 call pass_var(GME_flux_q, G%Domain, position=CORNER, complete=.true., halo=halosz)
97870 xq = halosz - 2
9788 endif
9789 call GME_flux_q_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(GME_flux_q), ub=UBOUND(GME_flux_q), &
97900 source=GME_flux_q)
97910 bxPass = bxH0%growBy(lo=[1+xq,1+xq,0], hi=[xq,xq,0])
97920 call smooth_GME_q_pass(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_q_a)
97930 call bxPass%free()
97940 call GME_flux_q_a%copy2F(GME_flux_q) ; call GME_flux_q_a%free()
97950 xq = xq - 1
9796 endif
9797 enddo ! s-loop
97980end subroutine smooth_GME
9799
9800!> Applies one pass of the 1-1-4-1-1 Laplacian filter to a GME diffusive flux at h points,
9801!! over the computational domain extended by xh points.
98020subroutine smooth_GME_h_pass_fortran(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_h_a)
9803 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
9804 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxPass !< The h-point range of this smoothing pass, the
9805 !! computational domain extended by the valid halo
9806 !! points
9807 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_flux_h_a !< GME diffusive flux
9808 !! at h points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9809 ! local variables
98100 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: GME_flux_h
98110 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: mask2dT
9812 real, dimension(GME_flux_h_a%lb(1):GME_flux_h_a%ub(1),GME_flux_h_a%lb(2):GME_flux_h_a%ub(2)) :: &
98130 GME_flux_h_original ! The previous value of GME_flux_h [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9814 real :: wc, ww, we, wn, ws ! averaging weights for smoothing [nondim]
9815 integer :: i, j
9816
98170 call GME_flux_h_a%view(GME_flux_h)
98180 call Gcore%mask2dT%view(mask2dT)
9819
98200 GME_flux_h_original(:,:) = GME_flux_h(:,:)
9821 ! apply smoothing on GME
9822 do concurrent (j=bxPass%idxS(2):bxPass%idxE(2), i=bxPass%idxS(1):bxPass%idxE(1)) &
98230 DO_LOCALITY(local(ww, we, ws, wn, wc))
9824 ! skip land points
98250 if (mask2dT(i,j)==0.) cycle
9826 ! compute weights
98270 ww = 0.125 * mask2dT(i-1,j)
98280 we = 0.125 * mask2dT(i+1,j)
98290 ws = 0.125 * mask2dT(i,j-1)
98300 wn = 0.125 * mask2dT(i,j+1)
98310 wc = 1.0 - ((ww+we)+(wn+ws))
9832 GME_flux_h(i,j) = wc * GME_flux_h_original(i,j) &
9833 + ((ww * GME_flux_h_original(i-1,j) + we * GME_flux_h_original(i+1,j)) &
98340 + (ws * GME_flux_h_original(i,j-1) + wn * GME_flux_h_original(i,j+1)))
9835 enddo
9836
98370end subroutine smooth_GME_h_pass_fortran
9838
9839!> Dispatches smooth_GME_h_pass to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
9840!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by SMOOTH_GME_H_PASS_MODE.
98410subroutine smooth_GME_h_pass(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_h_a)
9842 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
9843 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxPass !< The h-point range of this smoothing pass, the
9844 !! computational domain extended by the valid halo
9845 !! points
9846 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_flux_h_a !< GME diffusive flux
9847 !! at h points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9848
9849 ! Local variables
9850 integer :: mode, rc
98510 type(io_recorder) :: rec
9852 logical :: capture
9853 character(len=80) :: kernel
9854 character(len=100) :: dir
9855 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
9856 type(Box_C) :: bxPass_c
9857 type(RealArray_C) :: GME_flux_h_c
9858
98590 kernel = "smooth_gme_h_pass"
98600 mode = getenv_mode("SMOOTH_GME_H_PASS_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
9861
98620 select case (mode)
9863
9864 case (TIMH_capture)
98650 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
98660 if (capture) then
98670 dir = "capture"
98680 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
98690 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
98700 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
98710 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
98720 call rec%add("_mask2dT", Gcore%mask2dT)
98730 call rec%add("_bxPass", bxPass)
98740 call rec%add("_GME_flux_h_before", GME_flux_h_a)
9875 endif
9876
98770 call smooth_GME_h_pass_fortran(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_h_a)
9878
98790 if (capture) then
98800 call rec%add("_GME_flux_h_after", GME_flux_h_a)
98810 call rec%close()
98820 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
9883 endif
9884
9885#ifdef _TIM
9886 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
9887 bxPass_c = bxPass%to_c()
9888 GME_flux_h_c = GME_flux_h_a%to_c()
9889 call turbotmp_smooth_gme_h_pass_bridge(Gcore%C, bxPass_c, GME_flux_h_c)
9890#endif
9891
9892 case default
98930 call smooth_GME_h_pass_fortran(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_h_a)
9894
9895 end select
9896
98970end subroutine smooth_GME_h_pass
9898
9899!> Applies one pass of the 1-1-4-1-1 Laplacian filter to a GME diffusive flux at q points,
9900!! over the computational domain extended by xq points.
99010subroutine smooth_GME_q_pass_fortran(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_q_a)
9902 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
9903 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxPass !< The q-point range of this smoothing pass, the
9904 !! computational domain extended by the valid halo

9908 ! local variables

99100 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: mask2dBu
9911 real, dimension(GME_flux_q_a%lb(1):GME_flux_q_a%ub(1),GME_flux_q_a%lb(2):GME_flux_q_a%ub(2)) :: &
99120 GME_flux_q_original ! The previous value of GME_flux_q [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9913 real :: wc, ww, we, wn, ws ! averaging weights for smoothing [nondim]
9914 integer :: i, j
9915
99160 call GME_flux_q_a%view(GME_flux_q)
99170 call Gcore%mask2dBu%view(mask2dBu)
9918
99190 GME_flux_q_original(:,:) = GME_flux_q(:,:)
9920 ! apply smoothing on GME
9921 do concurrent (J=bxPass%idxS(2):bxPass%idxE(2), I=bxPass%idxS(1):bxPass%idxE(1)) &
99220 DO_LOCALITY(local(ww, we, ws, wn, wc))
9923 ! skip land points
99240 if (mask2dBu(I,J)==0.) cycle
9925 ! compute weights
99260 ww = 0.125 * mask2dBu(I-1,J)
99270 we = 0.125 * mask2dBu(I+1,J)
99280 ws = 0.125 * mask2dBu(I,J-1)
99290 wn = 0.125 * mask2dBu(I,J+1)
99300 wc = 1.0 - ((ww+we)+(wn+ws))
9931 GME_flux_q(I,J) = wc * GME_flux_q_original(I,J) &
9932 + ((ww * GME_flux_q_original(I-1,J) + we * GME_flux_q_original(I+1,J)) &
99330 + (ws * GME_flux_q_original(I,J-1) + wn * GME_flux_q_original(I,J+1)))
9934 enddo
9935
99360end subroutine smooth_GME_q_pass_fortran
9937
9938!> Dispatches smooth_GME_q_pass to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
9939!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by SMOOTH_GME_Q_PASS_MODE.
99400subroutine smooth_GME_q_pass(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_q_a)
9941 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
9942 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxPass !< The q-point range of this smoothing pass, the
9943 !! computational domain extended by the valid halo
9944 !! points
9945 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: GME_flux_q_a !< GME diffusive flux
9946 !! at q points [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
9947
9948 ! Local variables
9949 integer :: mode, rc
99500 type(io_recorder) :: rec
9951 logical :: capture
9952 character(len=80) :: kernel
9953 character(len=100) :: dir
9954 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
9955 type(Box_C) :: bxPass_c
9956 type(RealArray_C) :: GME_flux_q_c
9957
99580 kernel = "smooth_gme_q_pass"
99590 mode = getenv_mode("SMOOTH_GME_Q_PASS_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
9960
99610 select case (mode)
9962
9963 case (TIMH_capture)
99640 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
99650 if (capture) then
99660 dir = "capture"
99670 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
99680 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
99690 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
99700 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
99710 call rec%add("_mask2dBu", Gcore%mask2dBu)
99720 call rec%add("_bxPass", bxPass)
99730 call rec%add("_GME_flux_q_before", GME_flux_q_a)
9974 endif
9975
99760 call smooth_GME_q_pass_fortran(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_q_a)
9977
99780 if (capture) then
99790 call rec%add("_GME_flux_q_after", GME_flux_q_a)
99800 call rec%close()
99810 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
9982 endif
9983
9984#ifdef _TIM
9985 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
9986 bxPass_c = bxPass%to_c()
9987 GME_flux_q_c = GME_flux_q_a%to_c()
9988 call turbotmp_smooth_gme_q_pass_bridge(Gcore%C, bxPass_c, GME_flux_q_c)
9989#endif
9990
9991 case default
99920 call smooth_GME_q_pass_fortran(Gcore, bxPass, GME_flux_q_a)
9993
9994 end select
9995
99960end subroutine smooth_GME_q_pass
9997
9998!> Smooths the GME stress terms for each layer of one tile.
9999!! This includes halo updates, so it always runs in Fortran.
100000subroutine hor_visc_GME_smooth_host(host, Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, nkblock, kmax, str_xx_GME_a, &
10001 str_xy_GME_a)
10002 type(c_ptr), value, intent(in) :: host !< Opaque pointer to the hv_host_ctx that holds the Fortran
10003 !! objects used by the host helpers
10004 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
10005 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
10006 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
10007 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxQ0 !< The B-grid-index box of the whole column,
10008 !! [IscB:IecB, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
10009 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
10010 integer, intent(in) :: kmax !< The number of active k-layers in the current k-block
10011 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xx_GME_a !< smoothed diagonal term in the stress tensor from GME
10012 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
10013 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: str_xy_GME_a !< smoothed cross term in the stress tensor from GME
10014 !! [L2 T-2 ~> m2 s-2]
10015 ! Local variables
10016 type(hv_host_ctx), pointer :: ctx ! The objects behind host
10017 type(ocean_grid_type), pointer :: G ! The ocean's grid structure.
10018 type(hor_visc_CS), pointer :: CS ! Horizontal viscosity control structure
100190 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: str_xy_GME, str_xx_GME
10020 integer :: kk
10021
100220 call c_f_pointer(host, ctx)
100230 G => ctx%G ; CS => ctx%CS
10024
100250 call str_xy_GME_a%view(str_xy_GME) ; call str_xx_GME_a%view(str_xx_GME)
10026
100270 do kk=1,kmax
100280 call smooth_GME(CS, G, Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, GME_flux_h=str_xx_GME(:,:,kk))
100290 call smooth_GME(CS, G, Gcore, bxH0, bxQ0, GME_flux_q=str_xy_GME(:,:,kk))
10030 enddo
10031
100320end subroutine hor_visc_GME_smooth_host
10033
10034!> Passes the velocity gradients and thickness of each layer of one tile to ZB2020.
10035!! This calls into MOM_Zanna_Bolton, so it always runs in Fortran.
100360subroutine hor_visc_ZB2020_copy_host(host, nkblock, kstart, kmax, sh_xx_a, sh_xy_a, vort_xy_a, hq_a)
10037 type(c_ptr), value, intent(in) :: host !< Opaque pointer to the hv_host_ctx that holds the Fortran
10038 !! objects used by the host helpers
10039 integer, intent(in) :: nkblock !< The effective k-block size [nondim]
10040 integer, intent(in) :: kstart !< The first absolute k-layer of the current k-block
10041 integer, intent(in) :: kmax !< The number of active k-layers in the current k-block
10042 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: sh_xx_a !< horizontal tension (du/dx - dv/dy) including metric terms
10043 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
10044 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: sh_xy_a !< horizontal shearing strain (du/dy + dv/dx) including metric
10045 !! terms [T-1 ~> s-1]
10046 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: vort_xy_a !< Vertical vorticity (dv/dx - du/dy) including metric terms
10047 !! [T-1 ~> s-1]
10048 type(RealArray_t), intent(in) :: hq_a !< harmonic mean of the harmonic means of the u- & v point
10049 !! thicknesses [H ~> m or kg m-2] This form guarantees that hq/hu <
10050 !! 4.
10051 ! Local variables
10052 type(hv_host_ctx), pointer :: ctx ! The objects behind host
10053 type(ocean_grid_type), pointer :: G ! The ocean's grid structure.
10054 type(verticalGrid_type), pointer :: GV ! The ocean's vertical grid structure.
10055 type(hor_visc_CS), pointer :: CS ! Horizontal viscosity control structure
100560 real, dimension(:,:,:), contiguous, pointer :: hq, vort_xy, sh_xy, sh_xx
10057 integer :: k, kk
10058
100590 call c_f_pointer(host, ctx)
100600 G => ctx%G ; GV => ctx%GV ; CS => ctx%CS
10061
100620 call hq_a%view(hq) ; call vort_xy_a%view(vort_xy) ; call sh_xy_a%view(sh_xy)
100630 call sh_xx_a%view(sh_xx)
10064
100650 do kk=1,kmax
100660 k = kstart + kk - 1
10067 call ZB2020_copy_gradient_and_thickness(sh_xx(:,:,kk), sh_xy(:,:,kk), vort_xy(:,:,kk), hq(:,:,kk), &
100680 G, GV, CS%ZB2020, k)
10069 enddo
10070
100710end subroutine hor_visc_ZB2020_copy_host
10072
10073!> Apply a 9-point smoothing filter twice to a field staggered at a thickness point to reduce
10074!! horizontal two-grid-point noise.
10075!! Note that this subroutine does not conserve mass, so don't use it in situations where you
10076!! need conservation. Also note that it assumes that the input field has valid values in the
10077!! first two halo points upon entry.
100780subroutine smooth_x9_h_fortran(Gcore, bxH0, field_h_a, zero_land)
10079 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
10080 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
10081 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
10082 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: field_h_a !< h-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
10083 logical, intent(in) :: zero_land !< If present and false, return the average
10084 !! of the surrounding ocean points when
10085 !! smoothing, otherwise use a value of 0 for
10086 !! land points and include them in the averages.
10087
10088 ! Local variables
100890 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: field_h
100900 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: mask2dT
10091 real, dimension(field_h_a%lb(1):field_h_a%ub(1),field_h_a%lb(2):field_h_a%ub(2)) :: &
100920 fh_prev ! The value of the h-point field at the previous iteration [arbitrary]
10093 real :: Iwts ! The inverse of the sum of the weights [nondim]
10094 logical :: zero_land_val ! The value of the zero_land optional argument or .true. if it is absent.
10095 integer :: i, j, s
100960 type(Box_t) :: bxH0pass ! h points smoothed in pass s, [is-s:ie+s, js-s:je+s]: pass 1 also smooths the halo row that
10097 ! pass 0 reads
10098
100990 call field_h_a%view(field_h)
101000 call Gcore%mask2dT%view(mask2dT)
10101
101020 zero_land_val = zero_land
10103
101040 do s=1,0,-1
101050 bxH0pass = bxH0%growBy(lo=[s,s,0], hi=[s,s,0])
101060 fh_prev(:,:) = field_h(:,:)
10107 ! apply smoothing on field_h using rotationally symmetric expressions.
101080 do concurrent (j=bxH0pass%idxS(2):bxH0pass%idxE(2), i=bxH0pass%idxS(1):bxH0pass%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Iwts))
101090 if (mask2dT(i,j) > 0.0) then
101100 Iwts = 0.0625
101110 if (.not. zero_land_val) &
10112 Iwts = 1.0 / ( (4.0*mask2dT(i,j) + &
10113 ( 2.0*((mask2dT(i-1,j) + mask2dT(i+1,j)) + &
10114 (mask2dT(i,j-1) + mask2dT(i,j+1))) + &
10115 ((mask2dT(i-1,j-1) + mask2dT(i+1,j+1)) + &
101160 (mask2dT(i-1,j+1) + mask2dT(i+1,j-1))) ) ) + 1.0e-16 )
10117 field_h(i,j) = Iwts * ( 4.0*mask2dT(i,j) * fh_prev(i,j) &
10118 + (2.0*((mask2dT(i-1,j) * fh_prev(i-1,j) + mask2dT(i+1,j) * fh_prev(i+1,j)) + &
10119 (mask2dT(i,j-1) * fh_prev(i,j-1) + mask2dT(i,j+1) * fh_prev(i,j+1))) &
10120 + ((mask2dT(i-1,j-1) * fh_prev(i-1,j-1) + mask2dT(i+1,j+1) * fh_prev(i+1,j+1)) + &
101210 (mask2dT(i-1,j+1) * fh_prev(i-1,j+1) + mask2dT(i+1,j-1) * fh_prev(i-1,j-1))) ))
10122 endif ; enddo
101230 call bxH0pass%free()
10124 enddo
10125
101260end subroutine smooth_x9_h_fortran
10127
10128!> Dispatches smooth_x9_h to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
10129!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by SMOOTH_X9_H_MODE.
101300subroutine smooth_x9_h(Gcore, bxH0, field_h_a, zero_land)
10131 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
10132 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxH0 !< The h-point box of the whole column,
10133 !! [isc:iec, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
10134 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: field_h_a !< h-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
10135 logical, intent(in) :: zero_land !< If present and false, return the average
10136 !! of the surrounding ocean points when
10137 !! smoothing, otherwise use a value of 0 for
10138 !! land points and include them in the averages.
10139
10140 ! Local variables
10141 integer :: mode, rc
101420 type(io_recorder) :: rec
10143 logical :: capture
10144 character(len=80) :: kernel
10145 character(len=100) :: dir
10146 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
10147 type(Box_C) :: bxH0_c
10148 type(RealArray_C) :: field_h_c
10149 logical(c_bool) :: zero_land_c
10150
101510 kernel = "smooth_x9_h"
101520 mode = getenv_mode("SMOOTH_X9_H_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
10153
101540 select case (mode)
10155
10156 case (TIMH_capture)
101570 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
101580 if (capture) then
101590 dir = "capture"
101600 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
101610 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
101620 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
101630 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
101640 call rec%add("_mask2dT", Gcore%mask2dT)
101650 call rec%add("_bxH0", bxH0)
101660 call rec%add("_field_h_before", field_h_a)
101670 call rec%add("_zero_land", zero_land)
10168 endif
10169
101700 call smooth_x9_h_fortran(Gcore, bxH0, field_h_a, zero_land)
10171
101720 if (capture) then
101730 call rec%add("_field_h_after", field_h_a)
101740 call rec%close()
101750 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
10176 endif
10177
10178#ifdef _TIM
10179 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
10180 bxH0_c = bxH0%to_c()
10181 field_h_c = field_h_a%to_c()
10182 zero_land_c = zero_land
10183 call turbotmp_smooth_x9_h_bridge(Gcore%C, bxH0_c, field_h_c, zero_land_c)
10184#endif
10185
10186 case default
101870 call smooth_x9_h_fortran(Gcore, bxH0, field_h_a, zero_land)
10188
10189 end select
10190
101910end subroutine smooth_x9_h
10192
10193!> Apply a 9-point smoothing filter twice to a pair of velocity components to reduce
10194!! horizontal two-grid-point noise.
10195!! Note that this subroutine does not conserve angular momentum, so don't use it
10196!! in situations where you need conservation. Also note that it assumes that the
10197!! input fields have valid values in the first two halo points upon entry.
101980subroutine smooth_x9_uv_fortran(Gcore, bxU0, bxV0, field_u_a, field_v_a, zero_land)
10199 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
10200 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxU0 !< The u-point box of the whole column,
10201 !! [IscB:IecB, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
10202 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxV0 !< The v-point box of the whole column,
10203 !! [isc:iec, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
10204 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: field_u_a !< u-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
10205 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: field_v_a !< v-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
10206 logical, intent(in) :: zero_land !< If present and false, return the average
10207 !! of the surrounding ocean points when
10208 !! smoothing, otherwise use a value of 0 for
10209 !! land points and include them in the averages.
10210
10211 ! Local variables.
102120 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: field_v, field_u
102130 real, dimension(:,:), contiguous, pointer :: mask2dCu, mask2dCv
10214 real, dimension(field_u_a%lb(1):field_u_a%ub(1),field_u_a%lb(2):field_u_a%ub(2)) :: &
102150 fu_prev ! The value of the u-point field at the previous iteration [arbitrary]
10216 real, dimension(field_v_a%lb(1):field_v_a%ub(1),field_v_a%lb(2):field_v_a%ub(2)) :: &
102170 fv_prev ! The value of the v-point field at the previous iteration [arbitrary]
10218 real :: Iwts ! The inverse of the sum of the weights [nondim]
10219 logical :: zero_land_val ! The value of the zero_land optional argument or .true. if it is absent.
10220 integer :: i, j, s
102210 type(Box_t) :: bxU0pass ! u points smoothed in pass s, [Isq-s:Ieq+s, js-s:je+s]: pass 1 also smooths the halo row that
10222 ! pass 0 reads
102230 type(Box_t) :: bxV0pass ! v points smoothed in pass s, [is-s:ie+s, Jsq-s:Jeq+s]: pass 1 also smooths the halo row that
10224 ! pass 0 reads
10225
102260 call field_v_a%view(field_v) ; call field_u_a%view(field_u)
102270 call Gcore%mask2dCu%view(mask2dCu) ; call Gcore%mask2dCv%view(mask2dCv)
10228
102290 zero_land_val = zero_land
10230
102310 do s=1,0,-1
102320 bxU0pass = bxU0%growBy(lo=[s,s,0], hi=[s,s,0])
102330 bxV0pass = bxV0%growBy(lo=[s,s,0], hi=[s,s,0])
102340 fu_prev(:,:) = field_u(:,:)
10235 ! apply smoothing on field_u using the original non-rotationally symmetric expressions.
102360 do concurrent (j=bxU0pass%idxS(2):bxU0pass%idxE(2), I=bxU0pass%idxS(1):bxU0pass%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Iwts))
102370 if (mask2dCu(I,j) > 0.0) then
102380 Iwts = 0.0625
102390 if (.not. zero_land_val) &
10240 Iwts = 1.0 / ( (4.0*mask2dCu(I,j) + &
10241 ( 2.0*((mask2dCu(I-1,j) + mask2dCu(I+1,j)) + &
10242 (mask2dCu(I,j-1) + mask2dCu(I,j+1))) + &
10243 ((mask2dCu(I-1,j-1) + mask2dCu(I+1,j+1)) + &
102440 (mask2dCu(I-1,j+1) + mask2dCu(I+1,j-1))) ) ) + 1.0e-16 )
10245 field_u(I,j) = Iwts * ( 4.0*mask2dCu(I,j) * fu_prev(I,j) &
10246 + (2.0*((mask2dCu(I-1,j) * fu_prev(I-1,j) + mask2dCu(I+1,j) * fu_prev(I+1,j)) + &
10247 (mask2dCu(I,j-1) * fu_prev(I,j-1) + mask2dCu(I,j+1) * fu_prev(I,j+1))) &
10248 + ((mask2dCu(I-1,j-1) * fu_prev(I-1,j-1) + mask2dCu(I+1,j+1) * fu_prev(I+1,j+1)) + &
102490 (mask2dCu(I-1,j+1) * fu_prev(I-1,j+1) + mask2dCu(I+1,j-1) * fu_prev(I-1,j-1))) ))
10250 endif ; enddo
10251
102520 fv_prev(:,:) = field_v(:,:)
10253 ! apply smoothing on field_v using the original non-rotationally symmetric expressions.
102540 do concurrent (J=bxV0pass%idxS(2):bxV0pass%idxE(2), i=bxV0pass%idxS(1):bxV0pass%idxE(1)) DO_LOCALITY(local(Iwts))
102550 if (mask2dCv(i,J) > 0.0) then
102560 Iwts = 0.0625
102570 if (.not. zero_land_val) &
10258 Iwts = 1.0 / ( (4.0*mask2dCv(i,J) + &
10259 ( 2.0*((mask2dCv(i-1,J) + mask2dCv(i+1,J)) + &
10260 (mask2dCv(i,J-1) + mask2dCv(i,J+1))) + &
10261 ((mask2dCv(i-1,J-1) + mask2dCv(i+1,J+1)) + &
102620 (mask2dCv(i-1,J+1) + mask2dCv(i+1,J-1))) ) ) + 1.0e-16 )
10263 field_v(i,J) = Iwts * ( 4.0*mask2dCv(i,J) * fv_prev(i,J) &
10264 + (2.0*((mask2dCv(i-1,J) * fv_prev(i-1,J) + mask2dCv(i+1,J) * fv_prev(i+1,J)) + &
10265 (mask2dCv(i,J-1) * fv_prev(i,J-1) + mask2dCv(i,J+1) * fv_prev(i,J+1))) &
10266 + ((mask2dCv(i-1,J-1) * fv_prev(i-1,J-1) + mask2dCv(i+1,J+1) * fv_prev(i+1,J+1)) + &
102670 (mask2dCv(i-1,J+1) * fv_prev(i-1,J+1) + mask2dCv(i+1,J-1) * fv_prev(i-1,J-1))) ))
10268 endif ; enddo
102690 call bxU0pass%free() ; call bxV0pass%free()
10270 enddo
10271
102720end subroutine smooth_x9_uv_fortran
10273
10274!> Dispatches smooth_x9_uv to the Fortran implementation, to a capture of its inputs and
10275!! outputs, or to the C++/AMReX bridge, as selected by SMOOTH_X9_UV_MODE.
102760subroutine smooth_x9_uv(Gcore, bxU0, bxV0, field_u_a, field_v_a, zero_land)
10277 type(grid_core_type), intent(in) :: Gcore !< Persistent copies of the core ocean grid fields
10278 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxU0 !< The u-point box of the whole column,
10279 !! [IscB:IecB, jsc:jec, 1:nz]
10280 type(Box_t), intent(in) :: bxV0 !< The v-point box of the whole column,
10281 !! [isc:iec, JscB:JecB, 1:nz]
10282 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: field_u_a !< u-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
10283 type(RealArray_t), intent(inout) :: field_v_a !< v-point field to be smoothed [arbitrary]
10284 logical, intent(in) :: zero_land !< If present and false, return the average
10285 !! of the surrounding ocean points when
10286 !! smoothing, otherwise use a value of 0 for
10287 !! land points and include them in the averages.
10288
10289 ! Local variables
10290 integer :: mode, rc
102910 type(io_recorder) :: rec
10292 logical :: capture
10293 character(len=80) :: kernel
10294 character(len=100) :: dir
10295 character(len=256) :: binFile, metaFile
10296 type(Box_C) :: bxU0_c
10297 type(Box_C) :: bxV0_c
10298 type(RealArray_C) :: field_u_c
10299 type(RealArray_C) :: field_v_c
10300 logical(c_bool) :: zero_land_c
10301
103020 kernel = "smooth_x9_uv"
103030 mode = getenv_mode("SMOOTH_X9_UV_MODE", default=TIMH_runFORTRAN)
10304
103050 select case (mode)
10306
10307 case (TIMH_capture)
103080 capture = (.not. already_recorded(trim(kernel))) .and. is_root_pe()
103090 if (capture) then
103100 dir = "capture"
103110 rc = mkdir_posix(trim(dir) // c_null_char, int(o'755', c_int))
103120 binFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".bin"
103130 metaFile = trim(dir) // "/" // trim(kernel) // ".meta"
103140 call rec%open_write(binFile, metaFile)
103150 call rec%add("_mask2dCu", Gcore%mask2dCu)
103160 call rec%add("_mask2dCv", Gcore%mask2dCv)
103170 call rec%add("_bxU0", bxU0)
103180 call rec%add("_bxV0", bxV0)
103190 call rec%add("_field_u_before", field_u_a)
103200 call rec%add("_field_v_before", field_v_a)
103210 call rec%add("_zero_land", zero_land)
10322 endif
10323
103240 call smooth_x9_uv_fortran(Gcore, bxU0, bxV0, field_u_a, field_v_a, zero_land)
10325
103260 if (capture) then
103270 call rec%add("_field_u_after", field_u_a)
103280 call rec%add("_field_v_after", field_v_a)
103290 call rec%close()
103300 call mark_recorded(trim(kernel))
10331 endif
10332
10333#ifdef _TIM
10334 case (TIMH_runAMREX)
10335 bxU0_c = bxU0%to_c()
10336 bxV0_c = bxV0%to_c()
10337 field_u_c = field_u_a%to_c()
10338 field_v_c = field_v_a%to_c()
10339 zero_land_c = zero_land
10340 call turbotmp_smooth_x9_uv_bridge(Gcore%C, bxU0_c, bxV0_c, field_u_c, field_v_c, zero_land_c)
10341#endif
10342
10343 case default
103440 call smooth_x9_uv_fortran(Gcore, bxU0, bxV0, field_u_a, field_v_a, zero_land)
10345
10346 end select
10347
103480end subroutine smooth_x9_uv

10431 class(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: this !< Copies of the MEKE fields used by horizontal_viscosity

10433
1043425 if (allocated(MEKE%Ku)) call this%Ku_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(MEKE%Ku), ub=UBOUND(MEKE%Ku), source=MEKE%Ku)
1043525 if (allocated(MEKE%Au)) call this%Au_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(MEKE%Au), ub=UBOUND(MEKE%Au), source=MEKE%Au)
1043625 if (allocated(MEKE%mom_src)) &
104370 call this%mom_src_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(MEKE%mom_src), ub=UBOUND(MEKE%mom_src), source=MEKE%mom_src)
1043825 if (allocated(MEKE%mom_src_bh)) &
10439 call this%mom_src_bh_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(MEKE%mom_src_bh), ub=UBOUND(MEKE%mom_src_bh), &
104400 source=MEKE%mom_src_bh)
1044125 if (allocated(MEKE%GME_snk)) &
104420 call this%GME_snk_a%alloc(lb=LBOUND(MEKE%GME_snk), ub=UBOUND(MEKE%GME_snk), source=MEKE%GME_snk)
1044325 this%backscatter_Ro_pow = MEKE%backscatter_Ro_pow
1044425 this%backscatter_Ro_c = MEKE%backscatter_Ro_c
1044525end subroutine hor_visc_MEKE_build_from

10447!> Copies the MEKE source and sink fields written by horizontal_viscosity back into MEKE, then frees
10448!! every container.
1044925subroutine hor_visc_MEKE_copy_back(this, MEKE)
10450 class(hor_visc_MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: this !< Copies of the MEKE fields used by horizontal_viscosity
10451 type(MEKE_type), intent(inout) :: MEKE !< MEKE fields related to Mesoscale Eddy Kinetic Energy.
10452
1045325 if (this%mom_src_a%associated()) call this%mom_src_a%copy2F(MEKE%mom_src)
1045425 if (this%mom_src_bh_a%associated()) call this%mom_src_bh_a%copy2F(MEKE%mom_src_bh)
1045525 if (this%GME_snk_a%associated()) call this%GME_snk_a%copy2F(MEKE%GME_snk)
1045625 call this%Ku_a%free() ; call this%Au_a%free()
1045725 call this%mom_src_a%free() ; call this%mom_src_bh_a%free() ; call this%GME_snk_a%free()
1045825end subroutine hor_visc_MEKE_copy_back

110200 call rec%add(prefix//"_Re_Ah_const_xx_allocated", metrics%Re_Ah_const_xx%associated())
110210 elseif (metrics%Re_Ah_const_xx%associated()) then
110220 call rec%add(prefix//"_Re_Ah_const_xx"//suffix, metrics%Re_Ah_const_xx)
11023 endif
110240 if (len(suffix) == 0) then
110250 call rec%add(prefix//"_Laplac2_const_xy_allocated", metrics%Laplac2_const_xy%associated())
110260 elseif (metrics%Laplac2_const_xy%associated()) then
110270 call rec%add(prefix//"_Laplac2_const_xy"//suffix, metrics%Laplac2_const_xy)
11028 endif
110290 if (len(suffix) == 0) then
110300 call rec%add(prefix//"_Biharm6_const_xy_allocated", metrics%Biharm6_const_xy%associated())
110310 elseif (metrics%Biharm6_const_xy%associated()) then
110320 call rec%add(prefix//"_Biharm6_const_xy"//suffix, metrics%Biharm6_const_xy)
11033 endif
110340 if (len(suffix) == 0) then
110350 call rec%add(prefix//"_Laplac3_const_xy_allocated", metrics%Laplac3_const_xy%associated())
110360 elseif (metrics%Laplac3_const_xy%associated()) then
110370 call rec%add(prefix//"_Laplac3_const_xy"//suffix, metrics%Laplac3_const_xy)
11038 endif
110390 if (len(suffix) == 0) then
110400 call rec%add(prefix//"_Biharm_const_xy_allocated", metrics%Biharm_const_xy%associated())
110410 elseif (metrics%Biharm_const_xy%associated()) then
110420 call rec%add(prefix//"_Biharm_const_xy"//suffix, metrics%Biharm_const_xy)
11043 endif
110440 if (len(suffix) == 0) then
110450 call rec%add(prefix//"_Biharm_const2_xy_allocated", metrics%Biharm_const2_xy%associated())
110460 elseif (metrics%Biharm_const2_xy%associated()) then
110470 call rec%add(prefix//"_Biharm_const2_xy"//suffix, metrics%Biharm_const2_xy)
11048 endif
110490 if (len(suffix) == 0) then
110500 call rec%add(prefix//"_Re_Ah_const_xy_allocated", metrics%Re_Ah_const_xy%associated())
110510 elseif (metrics%Re_Ah_const_xy%associated()) then
110520 call rec%add(prefix//"_Re_Ah_const_xy"//suffix, metrics%Re_Ah_const_xy)
11053 endif
110540end subroutine record_hv_metrics_CS
